body.en: Principal curvatures are extreme normal curvatures. Their product is Gaussian curvature. A geodesic has zero tangential acceleration when parameterized by arc length.
body.zh: 主曲率为法曲率极值，其乘积是高斯曲率；弧长参数测地线切向加速度零。

body.en:
Normal curvature varies with the tangent direction. Its extreme values are the principal curvatures, eigenvalues of the shape operator under a consistent normal convention. Their product is Gaussian curvature K, and half their sum is mean curvature. Reversing the normal changes both principal signs and mean curvature sign, but preserves their product.

A sphere of radius R has equal principal-curvature magnitudes 1/R and positive Gaussian curvature 1/R². A cylinder has one curved circumferential direction and one straight axial direction, so one principal curvature vanishes and K=0. A saddle can have principal curvatures of opposite sign, producing negative K. These classifications concern local bending rather than the global topology alone.

A geodesic has zero tangential component of acceleration when parametrized by arc length; its acceleration, if nonzero, is normal to the surface. It is locally length-stationary, and sufficiently short geodesic segments minimize length in an appropriate neighborhood, but an arbitrarily long geodesic need not be the globally shortest connection. Great circles are sphere geodesics, yet the long arc between two nonantipodal points is longer than the short arc. A latitude circle other than the equator is generally not a geodesic because following it requires tangential turning on the sphere.
body.zh:
法曲率随切方向变，极值为主曲率，是一致法向约定下形算子特征值。积为高斯K，半和为平均曲率。反法向改两主符号和平均符号，不改积。

半径R球主曲率绝对值1/R，K=1/R²；柱周向弯轴向直，一主为0故K0；鞍两主异号K负，是局部弯曲分类不只全局拓扑。

弧长参数测地线加速度切向分量0，非零时全法向。它局部长驻，足够短段在适当邻域最短，但任意长不必全局最短。球大圆测地，非对跖两点长弧仍大于短弧。非赤道纬圈一般非测地，因为需沿球切向转弯。

body.en: Intrinsic geometry uses lengths measured within the surface. A local isometry preserves those lengths and Gaussian curvature.
body.zh: 内在几何使用表面内测量的长度，局部等距保持长度与高斯曲率。

body.en:
Intrinsic geometry uses distances, angles, and areas determined by the surface’s own metric, without referring to how the surface sits in surrounding space. A local isometry preserves that metric. Bending a sheet into a cylinder without stretching changes its extrinsic shape while retaining local intrinsic geometry. This distinction separates visible bending from metric curvature.

Gauss’s remarkable theorem states that Gaussian curvature can be determined from the first fundamental form alone. Therefore local isometries preserve it. A plane and cylinder both have zero Gaussian curvature and can be related locally by unrolling. A sphere with positive curvature cannot be flattened into a plane by a local isometry on an open region; some distortion of lengths is unavoidable.

On a sphere of radius R, a geodesic triangle’s angle excess A+B+C−π equals its area divided by R². An octant triangle bounded by three mutually perpendicular great-circle arcs has three right angles, excess π/2, and area πR²/2. This connects curvature to an observable measurement made entirely within the surface. Global identifications still matter: a flat torus can have zero local curvature but a different topology from the plane. Matching local curvature alone does not establish a global isometry or homeomorphism.
body.zh:
内在几何只用曲面自身度量的距离角面积，不依嵌入外界。局部等距保度量，无伸缩卷纸成柱改外形却保局部内在，区别可见弯和度量曲率。

高斯绝妙定理说K仅由第一形式决定，故局部等距保K。平面柱皆K0可局部展开，正K球不能在开区域无伸缩平铺，长必有畸变。

球R上测地三角角超A+B+C−π等面积/R²。三互垂大圆弧八分区三角各直角，超π/2，面积πR²/2，把曲率与面内可测量连接。全局识别仍重要，平坦环面局部K0却拓扑异于平面，仅同局部K不证全局等距同胚。

body.en: A manifold is locally modeled on Euclidean space through compatible charts. Differential forms encode oriented integration and transform consistently between charts.
body.zh: 流形由相容坐标图局部仿欧氏空间；微分形式编码有向积分并在换图中一致变换。

body.en:
A manifold is a space locally described by Euclidean coordinates. A chart maps a neighborhood to an open subset of R^n, and overlapping charts are related by transition maps. A smooth structure requires these transitions to be smooth so derivatives computed in one chart can be consistently translated to another. One global coordinate system need not exist, as familiar sphere coordinates already illustrate.

Tangent vectors represent velocities of curves through a point, while a differential one-form acts linearly on tangent vectors to produce a scalar. For a smooth function f, its differential df records first-order change: in coordinates df=Σ(∂f/∂xᵢ)dxᵢ. The coordinate symbols dxᵢ are covectors, not independent infinitesimal numbers to manipulate without transformation rules.

The wedge product combines forms antisymmetrically: dx∧dy=−dy∧dx and dx∧dx=0. The exterior derivative d extends differentiation and satisfies d(df)=0. A generalized Stokes theorem relates the integral of dω over an appropriately oriented smooth region to the integral of ω over its oriented boundary, under the relevant regularity assumptions. This framework unifies familiar fundamental, Green, divergence, and curl theorems. Orientation, dimension, and boundary conventions are essential parts of the statement, not optional notation.
body.zh:
流形局部用欧氏坐标，图把邻域映R^n开集，重叠由转移映射关联。光滑结构要求转移光滑，使导数可跨图一致翻译，不必有全局一图，球坐标已说明。

切向量是过点曲线速度，一形式线性作用切向量给标量。df=Σ偏导dxᵢ记一阶变化，dxᵢ是协向量，不是可无变换规则操作的独立无穷小数。

楔积反对称dx∧dy=−dy∧dx，dx∧dx=0。外微分推广求导且d(df)=0。广义Stokes在适当光滑定向正则下把区域∫dω与定向边界∫ω相连，统一微积分基本、Green、散度、旋度定理；定向维数边界约定都是必要部分。

body.en: Floating-point numbers approximate real values with finite precision. Conditioning measures how much output changes relative to input perturbations.
body.zh: 浮点以有限精度近似实数；条件性度量输入扰动引起的相对输出变化。

body.en:
Floating-point arithmetic represents a finite set of numbers through a sign, significand, and exponent. Many decimal fractions have no exact finite binary representation, so rounding enters even before later operations. Relative error compares an absolute perturbation with the magnitude of the true quantity, and becomes inappropriate or unstable near a true value of zero unless treated carefully.

Conditioning belongs to the mathematical problem: how strongly does its output change when the input is perturbed? Numerical stability belongs to an algorithm: does the computation introduce only small effective perturbations or otherwise control error? A stable method applied to an ill-conditioned problem can still produce a large forward error because the data themselves do not determine the answer robustly.

Subtraction of nearly equal approximate numbers can reveal large relative uncertainty in their small difference. For sqrt(1+x)−1 at tiny x, rationalizing gives x/(sqrt(1+x)+1), avoiding that harmful subtraction while preserving the exact mathematical expression. This reformulation does not improve every possible conditioning issue, but it improves the computation of that expression. Report units, absolute and relative error, and a trustworthy reference. More printed digits do not create information lost through measurement uncertainty or earlier rounding.
body.zh:
浮点以符号、有效数和指数表示有限数集，许多十进制小数无有限二进制精确表示，后续运算前已舍入。相对误差用绝对扰动除真值幅度，真零附近需谨慎。

summary.en: Bisection halves a sign-changing interval for a continuous function. Newton uses x_new=x−f(x)/f′(x), requiring a nonzero derivative.

body.en: Bisection halves a sign-changing interval for a continuous function. Newton uses x_new=x−f(x)/f′(x), requiring a nonzero derivative.
body.zh: 二分对连续函数异号区间折半；牛顿为x_new=x−f/f′，要求导数非零。

body.en:
Bisection begins with a continuous function whose endpoint values have opposite signs. The intermediate value theorem guarantees a root inside, and selecting the half that retains a sign change preserves this guarantee. After k halvings, the bracket width is the initial width divided by 2^k. Continuity is essential: a jump can change sign without crossing zero.

Newton’s method replaces the function locally by its tangent line and uses that line’s root: x_next=x−f(x)/f′(x). Near a simple root, with suitable smoothness and a sufficiently close starting point, convergence can be quadratic. A zero or tiny derivative, a poor initial guess, or an unfavorable function shape can instead cause failure, divergence, or cycling. These possibilities do not contradict the local convergence theorem because its assumptions were not met.

For f(x)=x²−9 and x=2, one step gives 2−(4−9)/4=3.25, already beyond the root three; a Newton step need not stay inside an initial interval. Safeguarded methods combine fast local steps with a valid bracket. Stop using criteria tied to the requested accuracy: a small step is not always a small residual, and a small residual does not guarantee small root error when the function is flat.
body.zh:
二分要求连续且端值异号，介值保证内部根，保异号半区保持保证。k次区间宽初宽/2^k；连续必要，跳跃可异号不穿零。

Newton以切线根替代：x_new=x−f/f′。简单根附近、足光滑、初猜足近可二次收敛；导数零或小、差初猜、坏形状可失败发散循环，未满足假设不违局部定理。

x²−9从2一步得3.25，越过根3，Newton不一定留初区间。保护方法结合快局部步与有效夹逼。停止需对应目标精度，小步不总小残差，平坦处小残差也不保证根误差小。

body.en: For x²−2 and x=1.5, one Newton step gives 1.5−0.25/3=17/12. Bisection of [1,2] uses midpoint 1.5.
Newton can diverge or leave the valid domain; a small step alone need not mean a small residual.
body.zh: 牛顿可能发散或离域，小步不必意味着小残差。

summary.en: Solving Ax=b numerically usually uses a factorization rather than explicitly forming A⁻¹. Pivoting avoids dangerous small divisors in elimination.
summary.zh: 数值解Ax=b通常用分解而非显式求逆；选主元避免消元中的危险小除数。

objectives.en: Explain pivoting and its conditions.

objectives.en: Use residual in a worked solution.

body.en: Solving Ax=b numerically usually uses a factorization rather than explicitly forming A⁻¹. Pivoting avoids dangerous small divisors in elimination.
body.zh: 数值解Ax=b通常用分解而非显式求逆；选主元避免消元中的危险小除数。

body.en:
A linear system Ax=b should usually be solved through a matrix factorization rather than by explicitly computing an inverse. Gaussian elimination produces triangular systems, and substitution then recovers the solution. Partial pivoting chooses a sufficiently large available pivot in the current column to reduce dangerous division by tiny values and control many common rounding problems.

The residual r=Axhat−b measures how well an approximate solution satisfies the equations. A small residual is evidence of a small backward perturbation under suitable scaling, but not necessarily a small forward error xhat−x. Ill-conditioned matrices can map a large solution error to a tiny residual. A condition number quantifies that amplification relative to the chosen norm.

For A=diag(1,10^(−6)) and b=(1,10^(−6)), the exact solution is (1,1). Approximation (1,0) has a residual of magnitude only 10^(−6) in the second coordinate but solution error one there. This illustrates why residuals must be interpreted with conditioning. For least squares, QR factorization avoids explicitly forming normal equations, which square the two-norm condition number for full-column-rank problems. Singular value decomposition reveals near-rank deficiency and supports regularization. Precision, scaling, algorithm choice, and data uncertainty all contribute to the final numerical interpretation.
body.zh:
Ax=b通常用分解而非显式逆。高斯消元成三角再回代，部分选主元选当前列较大可用元，减少小量除法危险并控制常见舍入。

残差r=Axhat−b看满足方程程度，适当缩放下小残差支持小后向扰动，却不一定小解前向误差。病态矩阵可把大解错映为小残差，条件数按范数量化放大。

A=diag(1,10^−6)、b=(1,10^−6)真解(1,1)，近似(1,0)第二残差仅10^−6却解错1。最小二乘QR避免正规方程在满列秩下平方二范数条件数。SVD揭近秩缺并支持正则。精度缩放算法与数据不确定共同影响解释。

summary.en: Quadrature approximates an integral using sampled values and weights. The trapezoid rule replaces a curve by straight segments.

body.en: Quadrature approximates an integral using sampled values and weights. The trapezoid rule replaces a curve by straight segments.
body.zh: 数值求积以采样值加权近似积分，梯形法以线段替代曲线。

body.en:
Interpolation constructs a function matching given sample values exactly. A polynomial through n+1 distinct nodes has degree at most n and is unique, but higher degree does not guarantee a better approximation between the nodes. Equally spaced high-degree interpolation can oscillate near interval ends. Piecewise low-degree interpolation or carefully chosen nodes can behave more reliably.

Quadrature estimates an integral from sampled values and weights. The trapezoid rule integrates the straight line joining endpoint values. For a convex function, that chord lies above the graph, so the one-panel trapezoid overestimates the integral; for a concave function it underestimates. Composite rules apply the same idea on smaller subintervals. With sufficient smoothness and bounded derivatives, error estimates quantify improvement as the step shrinks.

For f(x)=x² on [0,2], one trapezoid gives width two times average endpoint height two, or four, while the exact integral is 8/3. Splitting at one gives trapezoid areas 1/2 and 5/2, total three. The estimate improves but is not exact. Simpson’s rule integrates a fitted quadratic and is exact for cubic polynomials under its usual equally spaced panel setup. Singularities or discontinuities require adapted treatment; a smooth-function error formula cannot be applied across an unexamined singular point.
body.zh:
插值精确匹配样本，n+1异节点唯一次数≤n多项式，但高次数不保证节点间更好，等距高次端部可振荡；分段低次或精心节点可更稳。

求积用样本权估积分，梯形积端点弦。凸函数弦在上故高估，凹则低估；复合在小区间用，同足光滑和导数界下可估缩步误差。

x²在[0,2]单梯形4，真8/3；在1分两段面积1/2、5/2，总3，改善非精确。Simpson拟二次却在通常等距面板对三次也精确。奇点不连续需适配，不能跨未查奇点套光滑误差公式。

body.en: A differentiable convex function lies above every tangent plane. Any zero-gradient point is a global minimum on an unconstrained convex domain.
body.zh: 可微凸函数在所有切平面上方；无约束凸域中零梯度点为全局最小。

body.en:
A convex feasible set contains every segment between its points. A differentiable convex objective satisfies f(y)≥f(x)+∇f(x)·(y−x), meaning every tangent plane lies below its graph. If an unconstrained interior point has zero gradient, this inequality immediately proves global optimality. For a nonconvex function, zero gradient can instead indicate a maximum or saddle.

Gradient descent chooses x_next=x−η∇f(x), moving against the local direction of fastest increase in the Euclidean metric. Step size controls whether the local approximation remains useful. For a smooth convex objective with L-Lipschitz gradient, appropriate bounded step choices yield descent guarantees; choosing η arbitrarily large removes those guarantees. Poor scaling can make level sets elongated and progress slow.

For f(x)=(x−4)², starting at zero with η=1/4 gives x_next=2. The objective drops from sixteen to four. Starting with η=2 gives x_next=16 and objective 144, illustrating overshoot despite convexity. Strong convexity supplies additional uniqueness and convergence properties, while merely convex objectives may have whole sets of minimizers. Check gradient calculations with independent finite-difference comparisons at suitable step sizes, but remember that such checks are numerical evidence rather than a symbolic proof.
body.zh:
凸可行集含两点线段。可微凸目标满足f(y)≥f(x)+∇f(x)·(y−x)，切平面在图下。无约束内点梯度0直接全局最优；非凸0梯度也可极大或鞍。

梯降x_new=x−η∇f，欧氏度量下逆局部最快上升。步长决定局部近似适用，L-Lipschitz梯度等光滑条件配合适步有下降保证，任意大η无保证。差缩放使等高线狭长而慢。

(x−4)²从0、η1/4到2，目标16降4；η2到16、目标144，凸也可越过。强凸增唯一和收敛性质，一般凸可多最优。可用合适步有限差分独立查梯度，但数值证据非符号证明。

summary.en: A candidate must satisfy constraints before its objective can be compared. KKT conditions combine stationarity, feasibility, dual signs, and complementary slackness under suitable assumptions.
summary.zh: 候选先须满足约束才比较目标；KKT在适用假设下结合平稳、可行、对偶符号与互补松弛。

objectives.en: Explain feasibility and its conditions.
objectives.zh: 解释可行性及其适用条件。

objectives.en: Use KKT conditions in a worked solution.
objectives.zh: 在解题中使用KKT条件。

body.en: A candidate must satisfy constraints before its objective can be compared. KKT conditions combine stationarity, feasibility, dual signs, and complementary slackness under suitable assumptions.
body.zh: 候选先须满足约束才比较目标；KKT在适用假设下结合平稳、可行、对偶符号与互补松弛。

body.en:
Constrained optimization requires feasibility before optimality: a low objective value at an illegal point is not a candidate solution. For inequalities g_i(x)≤0, form the Lagrangian L=f+Σλ_i g_i with λ_i≥0, together with unrestricted multipliers for equality constraints. The sign convention must match the direction of the inequalities.

KKT conditions combine stationarity of the Lagrangian, primal feasibility, dual nonnegativity, and complementary slackness λ_i g_i=0. Complementary slackness means an inactive strict inequality has zero multiplier, while an active constraint may carry a nonzero multiplier. Necessity requires suitable constraint qualifications; convex problems with appropriate assumptions make feasible KKT points globally optimal. The conditions are not an unconditional recipe for every nonconvex problem.

For minimizing (x−3)² subject to x−1≤0, the unconstrained optimum three is infeasible. At x=1, stationarity gives 2(1−3)+λ=0, so λ=4≥0 and complementary slackness holds. The boundary optimum has objective four. A numerical solver’s success flag should be checked against constraint residuals, stationarity, and objective comparisons or bounds. Near-feasible values can violate a strict application requirement, so specify tolerances and verify the returned solution in the original units and constraints.
body.zh:
约束优化先可行后最优，非法点目标再低也非候选。g_i≤0时L=f+Σλ_i g_i且λ_i≥0，等式乘子不限，符号须匹配不等式方向。

KKT含拉格朗日驻点、原可行、对偶非负、互补λ_i g_i=0。严格未激活约束乘子0，激活可非零。必要需适当约束规范，凸与适当假设使可行KKT全局最优，非所有非凸无条件配方。

min(x−3)²且x−1≤0，无约束3非法。x=1驻点2(1−3)+λ=0得λ4非负，互补成立，目标4。数值成功标记还要查约束残差、驻点、目标比较或界。近可行可能违反应用严格要求，应指定容差并原单位约束复核。

body.en: Minimize (x−3)² subject to x≤1. The unconstrained minimizer 3 is infeasible, so the constrained optimum is x=1 with objective 4.
body.zh: 最小化(x−3)²且x≤1，无约束点3不可行，约束最优为1，目标4。

body.en: Checking stationarity alone ignores active constraints. Report feasibility residuals alongside objective values.
body.zh: 只查平稳忽略活跃约束，目标值应同时附可行残差。

body.en:
A cellular evidence problem often presents several assays that measure different levels of a process. Protein abundance, subcellular location, enzymatic activity and a final phenotype are not interchangeable readouts. Begin by stating what each assay directly measures and which links in the proposed mechanism remain inferred.

A loss-of-function perturbation can show that a component contributes to a process, but general toxicity or developmental disruption may produce the same endpoint. A rescue that restores a specific function, a time course placing events in order and an independent perturbation with a similar result can strengthen the explanation. Overexpression can create nonphysiological interactions, so sufficiency under an artificial condition does not automatically establish the normal mechanism.

If two proteins colocalize, they may occupy the same unresolved compartment without directly binding. If a transcript increases while protein does not, translation or turnover provides alternative explanations. Build a table of predicted outcomes under competing models and compare it with all supplied observations.

The strongest answer identifies both the supported mechanism and the remaining ambiguity, rather than selecting one attractive panel and ignoring discordant data.
body.zh:
细胞证据题常有多种测不同层级的实验，蛋白量、定位、酶活与最终表型不能互换。先说各实验直接测什么，机制哪些环节仍为推断。失功能说明组件贡献，但一般毒性或发育破坏可同结果；特异挽救、事件先后时间序列和独立扰动可加强解释。

过表达可造非生理作用，人工充分不自动证明正常机制。共定位可只是同一未分辨区室，不必直接结合；RNA 增而蛋白不增，可由翻译周转解释。应列表比较竞争模型对全部观察的预测。

最好答案既指出支持机制也保留歧义，而非挑好看面板忽略矛盾。

summary.en: Genetic crosses describe transmission, while evolutionary models describe changing variant frequencies across generations.
summary.zh: 遗传杂交描述传递，进化模型描述跨代频率变化。

objectives.en: Describe Inheritance probabilities and its relationship to Population change.
objectives.zh: 说明遗传概率与种群变化之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Model discrimination and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释模型区分，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Combine inheritance and evolution by tracking the same alleles through successive biological stages. A cross predicts gamete and zygote genotype probabilities under specified segregation and linkage assumptions. Differential survival can then alter the genotype distribution observed among adults, and differential reproduction changes the contribution to the next generation.

Thus an unexpected adult ratio need not mean that meiosis itself violated Mendelian segregation. Count allele copies separately from individuals and genotype classes. A rare allele can increase through selection, drift, migration or a mixture of processes, and one short time series may not distinguish them.

Hardy–Weinberg expectations provide a reference for random mating and other ideal assumptions, not a claim that every natural population must exactly match. Population subdivision or assortative mating can alter genotype proportions even without changing the total allele frequency immediately. Use sample sizes and uncertainty when comparing observed frequencies.

A trait associated with reproductive success may be linked to the true causal variant or correlated with environment, so causal claims require additional evidence. Explain which process acts at which stage instead of assigning every frequency change to natural selection by default.
body.zh:
把遗传进化连接，应追同一等位经过连续生物阶段。杂交在分离连锁假设下预测配子合子概率，差异存活可改成体分布，差异繁殖改下一代贡献。因此成体比例异常不一定是减数分离违反孟德尔。

等位份数、个体和基因型应分开计。稀有等位可因选择、漂变、迁移或混合增加，短序列未必区分。哈代—温伯格是随机交配等理想参照，不要求自然群体精确符合；亚结构或选型交配可改基因型比例而总等位频率暂不变。

比较须考虑样本和不确定。与繁殖成功相关性状可能只连锁真正因果变异或相关环境，需更多证据。应说明过程作用阶段，不能默认每次频率变化都自然选择。

body.en:
Integrated physiology questions often become simpler when treated as material and energy balances linked to feedback. Identify the compartment or whole organism, then list inflows, outflows, production and consumption. A constant concentration can result from large balanced fluxes, so distinguish a pool size from a transport rate.

For membrane movement, determine which species can cross and whether chemical, electrical or pressure gradients drive them. In a plant, stomatal closure may conserve water while reducing carbon dioxide entry; in an animal, changing blood flow can redistribute delivery without changing every tissue’s metabolic demand equally. These are tradeoffs among coupled functions, not independent switches.

A graph showing a variable returning toward baseline suggests regulation only when the response mechanism and alternatives are considered. Time delays can distinguish an immediate physical effect from a slower hormonal or transcriptional response. Use the supplied conditions rather than importing a familiar textbook result that assumes a different environment.

Verify units and limiting cases, then explain the causal sequence from disturbance to sensor, effector and measured outcome. A complete answer states which quantities remain conserved and which are actively regulated.
body.zh:
综合生理常可化为物质能量平衡加反馈。先定区室或个体，列流入流出、生成消耗。恒浓可来自大而平衡的通量，池大小与速率不同。

膜移动需识别可透物种及化学、电或压梯度。植物闭孔节水却减 CO2，动物变血流可重分配供给而不等量改变各组织需求，这是耦合权衡不是独立开关。曲线回基线只有结合机制与替代解释才支持调节。

时间延迟区分即时物理与较慢激素转录作用。应使用题设条件，不套假设不同的熟悉结论。检单位极限，再说明扰动、传感、效应与结果的因果序列，指出何量守恒、何量主动调节。

body.en:
Ecology, behavior and classification questions require keeping several explanatory levels separate. A phylogenetic tree constrains ancestry, while an ecological observation describes present interactions and a behavioral experiment tests responses under particular conditions. Similar functions may arise independently, so ecological resemblance alone is weak evidence of close ancestry.

Conversely, related organisms can occupy very different niches. When a predator is removed, prey may increase directly, but competition, vegetation changes or alternative predators can create indirect effects that reverse a simple expectation. A behavioral response may be learned, hormonally mediated or genetically influenced, and an adaptive interpretation needs evidence about consequences for reproduction in the relevant environment.

Classifying a trait as a shared derived character requires comparison with an outgroup or an explicit ancestral-state hypothesis. Avoid reading branch order on the page as a ranking of complexity. Use experimental controls, natural comparisons and multiple lines of evidence to distinguish explanations.

A strong synthesis says which observations concern history, mechanism and current function, then connects them without treating any one of those as a complete substitute for the others.
body.zh:
生态、行为和分类题要分解释层次。系统树约束祖先，生态观察描述现相互作用，行为实验检特定条件响应。相似功能可独立起源，因此生态相似不强证近缘，近缘也可占不同生态位。

移捕食者可直接增猎物，但竞争、植被或其他捕食者的间接效应可逆转简单预期。行为可能学习、激素或遗传影响，适应解释需相关环境繁殖后果证据。判断共有衍征需外群或明示祖态假说，不能把纸上分支顺序当复杂等级。

用对照、自然比较及多证据区分。好的综合应说清哪些观察关历史、机制和现功能，再连接而非以一层完全替另一层。

title.en: Practical images, data and experimental design

summary.en: Practical evidence tasks require reading scales, recognizing preparation limits and choosing controls that distinguish hypotheses.
summary.zh: 实践证据题需读尺度、认识制备限制，并选能区分假说的对照。

objectives.en: Describe Scale reading and its relationship to Control selection.
objectives.zh: 说明比例尺判读与对照选择之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Uncertainty and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释不确定度，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Practical biological questions often test whether an image or dataset has been interpreted at the correct scale. Read the scale bar before naming a structure, and distinguish actual specimen dimensions from printed or displayed magnification. Consider section orientation: the same three-dimensional object can produce different two-dimensional profiles.

Staining intensity may depend on chemistry, exposure or image processing rather than simply the amount of target material. Count independent specimens and record how fields or cells were selected; many measurements from one specimen can improve its estimate without creating many independent biological replicates. In a proposed experiment, choose controls that address the specific alternative explanation, such as background labeling, handling effects or assay failure.

A positive control and a negative control answer different questions. If treatment groups were imaged with different exposure settings, raw brightness comparisons may be invalid. Combine observations with uncertainty and avoid inferring movement, causation or developmental sequence from one static image alone.

The best practical answer explains what the method can establish, which artifact could mimic the result and what additional observation would discriminate them.
body.zh:
实践题常考是否按正确尺度解释图和数据。命名结构前读比例尺，分实际尺寸和打印放大。切面方向重要，同三维物体可有不同二维轮廓。

染色强度可依化学、曝光和处理，不只是靶量。计独立样本并记录选视野细胞方式；同样本多测可改善该样本估计，却不创造更多独立生物重复。对照应针对背景标记、操作效应或测定失效等具体替代；阳性阴性回答不同问题。

组间曝光不同，原亮度比较可能无效。应结合不确定，不能一张静图就推运动、因果或发育顺序。最好答案说明能建立何结论、何伪影可模拟及下一何观察可区分。

title.zh: 比例尺判读 · 对照选择 · 不确定度

summary.en: Timed biological reasoning prioritizes supplied evidence over familiar stories.
summary.zh: 限时生物推理应优先题给证据，而非熟悉故事。

objectives.en: Describe Evidence prioritization and its relationship to Question decomposition.
objectives.zh: 说明证据排序与问题分解之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Error review and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释错误复盘，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A timed integrated set rewards disciplined interpretation more than rapid recall of isolated names. Read the requested claim carefully: identifying a pattern, calculating a probability, explaining a mechanism and designing a discriminating experiment are different tasks. Mark the independent variables, response variables, control conditions and sample sizes before interpreting a graph.

Translate unfamiliar terminology into the supplied operational definition instead of assuming it matches a familiar word exactly. Solve quantitative subparts with explicit units and state probabilistic assumptions, including independence, random sampling or equilibrium when used. A later part may ask for a limitation of the same model that made an earlier calculation possible; recognizing that boundary is not a contradiction.

Reserve time to test whether the conclusion exceeds the evidence, especially for claims of causation, adaptation or unique identity. When several explanations remain, choose the additional experiment that makes their predictions differ most clearly. After practice, separate factual gaps from reasoning errors such as confusing correlation with cause, technical with biological replication, or mean change with individual certainty.

Use that diagnosis to select the next learning node and a fresh transfer problem.
body.zh:
限时综合更奖励有纪律解释而非孤立名词快背。先看要求是识模式、算概率、解释机制还是设计辨别实验。读图前标自变量、响应、对照与样本量。

陌生术语按题给操作定义理解，不假定与熟词完全同义。定量部分保单位并说明独立、随机抽样或平衡等概率假设。后题可能正问前题模型的限制，认识边界不矛盾。

留时间检查因果、适应或唯一身份结论是否超证据。若仍多解释，选使预测最不同的后续实验。练后区分事实缺口与推理错，如相关因果、技术生物重复、均值变化与个体确定混淆，再据此选下一节点及新迁移题。

text.en: Describe the evidence, propose a conditional mechanism and give a controlled test that could distinguish it from an alternative.
text.zh: 描述证据，提出有条件的机制，并设计能区分该机制与替代解释的对照检验。

text.en: Restate the graph trend and label it a proven mechanism without another test.
text.zh: 复述图中趋势，直接称为已证明机制，不再检验。

text.en: List unrelated facts while ignoring the graph’s axes and experimental controls.
text.zh: 列举无关事实，忽略坐标轴与实验对照。

hints.en: Separate observation, explanation and a discriminating prediction.
hints.zh: 分开观察、解释与能够区分假说的预测。

explanation.en: A complete synthesis connects the measured pattern to a plausible model, states its limits and proposes a test with interpretable controls. A mechanism remains an inference until evidence distinguishes it from competing explanations.
explanation.zh: 完整综合应把测得图样与合理模型相连，说明局限，并提出带可解释对照的检验。在证据区分竞争解释之前，机制仍是推断。

summary.en: Biological observation depends on what the method can reveal and which material is sampled.
summary.zh: 生物观察依方法可揭示内容及所取材料。

objectives.en: Describe Resolution and its relationship to Sampling frame.
objectives.zh: 说明分辨率与抽样框之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Observer bias and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释观察者偏差，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Observation is selective: an instrument, preparation and sampling plan determine which features become visible. Light microscopy distinguishes structures only above its effective resolution, while electron and fluorescence methods reveal different kinds of information with their own preparation constraints. A stain or marker must have suitable specificity; absence of labeling may reflect a technical failure rather than absence of a structure.

Calibrate scale bars using the imaging setup, because digital resizing changes displayed size without changing the biological specimen. Define the sampling frame before choosing attractive images. Random or systematic sampling of fields can reduce selection bias, while repeatedly imaging the most conspicuous region can exaggerate a feature’s frequency.

Cells nested within one organism or tissue sample are not necessarily independent biological replicates. Record preparation, magnification, acquisition settings and inclusion rules so another observer can evaluate the result. Blinding labels can reduce expectation-driven scoring when judgment is involved.

A descriptive observation can generate a hypothesis, but showing that a structure causes a function requires additional comparisons or perturbations. Keep raw images and distinguish legitimate uniform processing from alterations that change the apparent evidence.
body.zh:
观察有选择性，仪器、制备和抽样决定可见特征。光镜有有效分辨限制，电镜荧光揭不同信息且各有制备约束。染色标记需特异，缺标可能技术失败而非结构不存在。

比例尺须按成像系统校准，数字缩放只改显示不改样品。挑漂亮图前定义抽样框，随机或系统选视野减少偏差，反复取显眼区会夸大频率。同一个体组织的多细胞不一定是独立生物重复。

记录制备、放大、采集和纳入规则，盲标签可减少期待驱动评分。描述观察能生假说，要证明结构致功能还需比较扰动。保留原图，区分合法统一处理与改变证据外观的修改。

title.zh: 分辨率 · 抽样框 · 观察者偏差

body.en: Biological observation depends on what the method can reveal and which material is sampled. Resolution limits distinguishable detail, while a sampling frame defines the population to which observations can reasonably generalize.
body.zh: 生物观察依方法可揭示内容及所取材料。分辨率限制可区分细节，抽样框定义观察可合理推广的总体。

text.zh: 真实样本的物理长度加倍。

hints.en: Magnification describes displayed size; resolution concerns distinguishable detail.
hints.zh: 放大描述显示尺寸，分辨率涉及能区分的细节。

explanation.en: Digital enlargement spreads existing pixels over a larger display. It does not recover spatial detail that was never resolved during acquisition; an updated scale bar must remain consistent with the resized image.
explanation.zh: 数字放大将现有像素显示得更大，不能恢复采集时未分辨出的细节。图像缩放后，比例尺必须同步保持正确。

summary.en: Controls isolate alternative explanations, randomization reduces systematic allocation differences, and independent replication estimates biological variation.
summary.zh: 对照隔离替代解释，随机分配减少系统组差，独立重复估生物变异。

objectives.en: Describe Randomization and its relationship to Independent replication.
objectives.zh: 说明随机化与独立重复之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Blinding and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释盲法，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Experimental design aims to make alternative explanations distinguishable. A negative control establishes the baseline without the proposed active factor, while a positive control demonstrates that the system can produce the expected response when an appropriate stimulus is present. Vehicle, sham or handling controls may be needed when the procedure itself has effects.

Random assignment reduces systematic pre-existing differences between groups on average, but it does not guarantee perfect balance in a small experiment. Blinding reduces the influence of expectations on treatment, measurement or analysis where feasible. Replication must occur at the level independently assigned to conditions: repeated wells from one preparation or repeated images from one animal do not automatically count as independent organisms.

Technical replicates estimate measurement variability; biological replicates capture variation among independent biological units. Prespecify primary outcomes and important exclusions when possible, preserve deviations from the plan and report them. Reproducibility includes enough detail to repeat procedures and enough data and code to repeat analysis.

An experiment can be repeatable yet biased if the same flawed method is repeated, so independent validation and alternative measurement methods add value.
body.zh:
实验设计让替代解释可区分。阴性对照给无活性因素基线，阳性对照证明系统遇合适刺激能响应。溶剂、假处理或操作对照可隔离程序本身。

随机分配平均减少先存系统组差，但小实验不保证完美平衡；盲法减少期待对处理测量分析影响。重复须在独立分配条件的层级，一制备多孔或一动物多图不自动等于独立个体。技术重复估测量变异，生物重复估独立生物单位变异。

尽可能预定主要结果和排除，保留并报告偏离。可复现需要足够程序细节及数据代码。相同错误方法可反复得到同样偏结果，因此独立验证与不同测量方法仍有价值。

title.zh: 随机化 · 独立重复 · 盲法

body.en: Controls isolate alternative explanations, randomization reduces systematic allocation differences, and independent replication estimates biological variation. Reproducibility requires transparent methods, data handling and a clear distinction between technical and biological repeats.
body.zh: 对照隔离替代解释，随机分配减少系统组差，独立重复估生物变异。可重复性需透明方法、数据处理，并区分技术与生物重复。

body.en:
Four independent animals each contribute three technical measurements. How many independent animal units are there?

The independent biological units are the 4 animals, not 12 readings.

四只独立动物各测三次技术重复，独立动物单位有几个？

独立生物单位为 4 只动物；12 次读数不代表 12 个独立生物单位。

body.zh: 技术重复不自动增加生物样本量。常见误解：“同一样本十二读数等于十二独立生物。”

title.zh: 生物统计与数据可视化

summary.en: Biological data vary, so summarize distributions and effect sizes rather than only significance labels.
summary.zh: 生物数据有变异，应总结分布和效应量而非只贴显著标签。

objectives.en: Describe Distributions and its relationship to Effect sizes.
objectives.zh: 说明分布与效应量之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Uncertainty and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释不确定度，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A biological dataset is a collection of measurements from a sampling process, not merely numbers waiting for a significance test. Begin by identifying the observational unit, variables, units and grouping structure. Plot individual observations where practical and inspect skew, outliers, missingness and possible subgroups before selecting a summary.

A mean describes a centre but can hide a bimodal distribution; a median answers a different question and may be more robust to extreme values. Standard deviation describes spread among observations, while a standard error or confidence interval concerns uncertainty in an estimated quantity under a model. An effect size states the magnitude of a difference or association in interpretable units.

A p-value describes compatibility with a specified null model and is not the probability that the hypothesis is true. Statistical significance does not establish causation or practical importance. Choose graphs with honest axes, clear labels and uncertainty displays that match the analysis.

Paired measurements should preserve pairing, and nested designs need methods that respect dependence. Explain assumptions and sensitivity to reasonable alternatives rather than treating a software output as an automatic scientific conclusion.
body.zh:
生物数据来自抽样过程，不只是等显著检验的数字。先明确观察单位、变量、单位和分组，尽可能画个体值，先查偏斜、异常、缺失和亚群。均值描述中心却可掩双峰，中位数回答不同问题且对极端稳健。

explanation.en: Raw points, box plots or suitable density summaries reveal spread and possible outliers. The plot should also make sample size and units clear; equal means do not establish identical distributions.
explanation.zh: 原始点、箱线图或适当密度摘要能显示分散程度与可能的异常值，还应明确样本量和单位。均值相等不等于分布相同。

summary.en: Alignment proposes corresponding sequence positions using a scoring model.
summary.zh: 比对按评分模型提出对应位置。

objectives.en: Describe Alignment and its relationship to Similarity versus homology.
objectives.zh: 说明序列比对与相似与同源之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Annotation and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释注释，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A sequence alignment proposes which nucleotide or amino-acid positions correspond between sequences. The result depends on a scoring scheme for matches, substitutions and gaps, and on whether the goal is a global alignment of entire sequences or a local match between regions. A high-scoring alignment is evidence of similarity under that model, not automatic proof of identical function.

Homology means shared ancestry and is a relationship, not a percentage; percent identity is a numerical summary of aligned matches. Orthologues arise through lineage splitting and paralogues through gene duplication, which affects how cautiously function should be transferred. Database records can contain experimentally supported annotations, computational predictions or inherited annotations of varying confidence.

Record accession identifiers, database versions, sequence orientation and coordinate conventions so an analysis can be reproduced. Low-complexity regions, contamination, sequencing errors and incomplete gene models can create misleading matches. An apparent absence may reflect an incomplete assembly rather than true biological loss.

Combine sequence evidence with domain organization, genomic context, expression or experiments before making a strong functional claim. A similarity search is a starting point for reasoning, not a replacement for checking evidence provenance.
body.zh:
序列比对提出核苷酸或氨基酸位置对应，取决于匹配替换缺口评分，以及全局或局部目标。高分只是该模型下相似证据，不自动证明同功能。同源是共同祖先关系，不是百分比；一致性才是对齐匹配数值。

直系同源源自谱系分开，旁系同源源自复制，影响功能转移谨慎程度。数据库注释可来自实验证据、计算预测或继承推断，置信不同。应记录登录号、版本、方向和坐标约定以复现。

低复杂、污染、测序错和不完整基因模型可误导，缺失也可能是组装不全。应结合结构域、基因组背景、表达或实验再作强功能结论。相似搜索是推理起点，不代替追查证据来源。

title.zh: 序列比对 · 相似与同源 · 注释

body.en: Alignment proposes corresponding sequence positions using a scoring model. Similarity can support common ancestry but requires context. Database annotations combine evidence and inference and can contain errors or differing coordinate conventions.
body.zh: 比对按评分模型提出对应位置。相似可支持共同祖先但需情境。数据库注释兼有证据和推断，可能有错误或不同坐标约定。

explanation.zh: 短匹配片段可能偶然出现，也可能只代表一个共享结构域。解释需要覆盖度与比对情境，即使高度相似也不能单独证明生物功能相同。

summary.en: High-dimensional datasets test many features and can reveal patterns or confounding.
summary.zh: 高维数据检验许多特征，可揭模式也可揭混杂。

objectives.en: Describe Multiple testing and its relationship to Batch effects.
objectives.zh: 说明多重检验与批次效应之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Phylogenetic uncertainty and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释系统树不确定性，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Omics methods measure many molecular features at once, creating both discovery opportunities and statistical hazards. When thousands of null hypotheses are tested, some small p-values arise by chance even if each test is individually calibrated. Multiple-testing procedures control a defined error quantity, such as a family-wise rate or false-discovery rate; these are not interchangeable promises.

Batch effects can arise from collection date, preparation, instrument run or processing software, and become especially dangerous when batch aligns with the biological groups of interest. Normalization adjusts selected technical differences but cannot rescue every confounded design. Exploratory clustering can reveal patterns without proving that the clusters are natural biological categories.

Phylogenetic analysis likewise depends on alignment, substitution models, sampling and support assessment. Resampling support summarizes stability under a procedure, not a universal probability that a historical claim is true. Integrate high-dimensional findings with independent datasets or targeted experiments and distinguish pathway enrichment from direct measurement of pathway activity.

Preserve enough metadata to test alternative explanations. A large dataset can estimate the wrong comparison very precisely if its design or labels are biased.
body.zh:
组学同时测许多分子，带来发现也带统计风险。数千零假设检验即使单项校准，仍会偶然出现小 p。多重检验控制指定错误量，如家族错误率或假发现率，二者不是同一承诺。

批次可来自采集日、制备、仪器或软件，若与生物组重合尤其危险。归一只调部分技术差异，不能挽救所有混杂。探索聚类可显模式，却不证明自然生物类别。

系统发育依比对、替换模型、取样和支持评估，重抽样支持表示特定程序下稳定性，不是历史断言的普遍真概率。高维发现需独立数据或定向实验，通路富集不等于直接测活性。保留元数据检验替代解释，大数据若设计标签偏，仍可极精确估错比较。

title.en: Multiple testing · Batch effects · Phylogenetic uncertainty
title.zh: 多重检验 · 批次效应 · 系统树不确定性

summary.en: A report connects the question, design, measurements, analysis and conclusion.
summary.zh: 报告连接问题、设计、测量、分析与结论。

objectives.en: Describe Evidence chain and its relationship to Reproducible analysis.
objectives.zh: 说明证据链与可复现分析之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Limitations and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释限制，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A scientific report should let a reader follow the inference from question to evidence. State the biological question and the competing predictions, then describe the experimental units, treatments, controls, sampling and measurement methods. Explain how raw observations became analyzed variables, including calibration, normalization, exclusions and handling of missing values.

Results should separate descriptive observations from statistical estimates, with units, sample sizes and uncertainty. Figures need labels and legends sufficient to understand what each point or band represents; a polished graphic should not conceal replication structure. The discussion connects findings to the hypothesis while considering alternative explanations, limitations and the range over which the conclusion is supported.

Preserve raw data, analysis code and relevant versions so the numerical results can be reproduced. A reproducible calculation does not by itself validate the original measurement or causal interpretation, so those layers require separate evidence. Avoid inventing a mechanism simply because an association is strong.

Conclude with the specific supported claim and the next discriminating test where uncertainty remains. Transparent reporting includes unexpected or null findings when they bear on the question rather than selecting only the most attractive panel.
body.zh:
科学报告应让读者从问题追到证据。先写生物问题和竞争预测，再述实验单位、处理、对照、取样和测量。说明原始观察如何变成分析变量，包括校准、归一、排除及缺失处理。

结果分描述与统计估计，带单位、样本量和不确定度。图标图例应说明每点每带含义，不能用美图隐藏重复层级。讨论联系假说并考虑替代、限制和支持范围。

保留原数据、代码和版本以复现数字；计算可复现不自动验证测量或因果，这些需分别证据。不能因相关强就编机制。结论给具体受支持断言及未解处下一辨别检验，透明报告也包括与问题相关的意外和零结果，而非只挑最漂亮面板。

body.en: A report connects the question, design, measurements, analysis and conclusion. Preserve raw data and explain exclusions, transformations and uncertainty. Separate observed association, model fit and causal inference.
body.zh: 报告连接问题、设计、测量、分析与结论。保留原始数据并说明排除、变换和不确定度，区分观察相关、模型拟合与因果推断。

summary.en: Developing cells acquire different states through inherited components, local signals and interactions.
summary.zh: 发育细胞通过继承成分、局部信号与相互作用获得不同状态。

objectives.en: Describe Positional information and its relationship to Induction.
objectives.zh: 说明位置信息与诱导之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Differentiation and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释分化，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Development transforms a fertilized egg or other starting structure into an organized body through division, movement, growth and differentiation. Most differentiating cells retain much of the same genome but use different regulatory programs. Cell fate describes what a cell normally becomes, while potency describes what it can become under specified conditions; those are not identical claims.

Unequal inherited cytoplasmic components can bias early states, and signals from neighboring cells can induce new responses. Positional information lets cells respond differently according to location, but a gradient alone is not a complete explanation unless the sensing and response mechanisms are identified. Cells also alter their environment through adhesion, force generation and secretion, producing feedback between pattern and mechanics.

Determination refers to a relatively stabilized developmental commitment, whereas differentiation produces specialized observable properties. Some states remain plastic and can change after perturbation. To infer a fate mechanism, combine lineage tracing, transplantation or controlled signaling changes with suitable controls.

A final anatomical pattern is evidence of an outcome, not direct proof of the sequence of molecular decisions that produced it.
body.zh:
发育通过分裂、移动、生长和分化把起始结构变成有序身体。多数分化细胞保留相近基因组，却用不同调控程序。命运指通常成为何物，潜能指指定条件下能成为何物，二者不同。

不均继承胞质可偏置早期状态，邻细胞信号可诱导响应。位置信息让不同位置作不同反应，但若不说明感知响应机制，梯度不是完整解释。细胞以黏附、力和分泌改环境，形成格局与力学反馈。

决定指较稳定承诺，分化指专门可见性质，有些状态仍可塑。应结合谱系追踪、移植或受控信号变化及对照推断机理。最终解剖格局是结果证据，不直接证明产生它的分子决策序列。

summary.en: Developmental gene networks integrate signals and feedback to create spatial and temporal expression patterns.
summary.zh: 发育网络整合信号反馈，形成时空表达。

objectives.en: Describe Regulatory networks and its relationship to Morphogen interpretation.

objectives.en: Explain State stability and identify the conditions behind the example.

body.en:
Developmental regulation uses interacting genes and signals to create stable but adjustable patterns. A transcription factor can activate or repress target genes, and combinations of factors give cells a context-dependent interpretation of the same extracellular signal. Positive feedback can stabilize a state once initiated, while mutual inhibition can sharpen differences between neighboring or alternative cell identities.

A morphogen is a signal capable of eliciting distinct responses over a concentration range in an appropriate developmental system. Its effect can also depend on exposure duration, transport, degradation and the history of the responding cell. Boundary formation therefore cannot always be reduced to a static concentration threshold.

Enhancers integrate regulatory inputs, and chromatin state can preserve accessibility or repression across divisions. Developmental timing matters: applying a signal before or after a competence window can produce different outcomes. Gene-expression maps show association with a pattern, while loss-of-function, gain-of-function and rescue experiments test causal contributions.

Redundant pathways may hide an effect when one gene is removed. A useful network model makes predictions about perturbations and timing, not merely arrows connecting every gene mentioned in a diagram.
body.zh:
发育调控用相互作用基因和信号形成稳定而可调格局。转录因子活化或抑制靶基因，组合使同一外信号得到情境解释。正反馈稳定已启状态，相互抑制锐化邻细胞或备选身份差异。

形态素在合适系统中可按浓度范围引不同响应，但效应还依暴露时间、运输、降解和细胞历史，边界不总能化成静态阈值。增强子整合输入，染色质跨分裂维持可及或抑制。能力窗口前后施信号可有不同结局。

表达图显示与格局关联，功能丧失、增加及挽救检验因果，冗余路径可能遮蔽单基因去除效应。有用网络模型须预测扰动与时间，而不是把图中每基因都连箭头。

summary.en: Ion gradients and selective permeability establish membrane voltage.
summary.zh: 离子梯度与选择透过建立膜电位。

body.en:
A neuron’s membrane separates ionic solutions with different compositions. Pumps and transporters maintain gradients over time, while selective ion channels determine which ions can cross at a given moment. The resting membrane potential reflects the combined electrochemical influences and permeabilities, not a complete absence of electrical activity.

A small input can depolarize or hyperpolarize the membrane. In an excitable region, reaching a threshold can open voltage-dependent channels and trigger a regenerative action potential. Subsequent channel inactivation and potassium-related currents help repolarize the membrane, while refractory behavior limits immediate re-excitation.

The action potential’s local shape is relatively stereotyped under fixed conditions; stimulus strength is often represented through firing patterns rather than an arbitrarily larger spike. Propagation occurs because local currents influence adjacent membrane, which regenerates the event. Myelin changes the electrical properties and concentrates regeneration at nodes, increasing conduction efficiency and speed.

Glial cells support neural function in many ways beyond passive structural filling. Distinguish the rapid channel currents of one spike from the slower transport processes that maintain the ion gradients required for repeated signaling.
body.zh:
神经膜隔开成分不同的离子溶液。泵和转运体长期维持梯度，选择通道决定当下能跨的离子。静息电位反映综合电化学影响与透过性，不是完全没有电活动。

小输入可去极化或超极化，兴奋区达阈后电压通道可触发再生动作电位；随后失活及钾相关电流帮助复极，不应期限制即刻再激。固定条件下局部脉冲形状较定型，刺激强弱常由发放模式而非任意更大脉冲编码。局部电流影响邻膜，邻膜再生事件而传播。

髓鞘改电性质并使再生集中郎飞结，提高效率速度。胶质支持功能远不止填空支架。应区分单次脉冲快通道电流与维持反复信号梯度的慢运输。

summary.en: Synapses convert presynaptic activity into postsynaptic effects through chemical or electrical coupling.

body.en:
A chemical synapse links presynaptic activity to transmitter release and a postsynaptic response. An arriving action potential can open calcium channels, and calcium entry promotes vesicle fusion at the terminal. Released transmitter binds receptors whose effects depend on their molecular type and the target cell’s ionic conditions.

Some receptors directly gate channels, while others act through intracellular signaling. Excitatory and inhibitory describe effects on the likelihood of relevant activity, not a permanent moral or chemical label. Postsynaptic potentials vary in size and combine over time and across locations; dendritic geometry and active membrane properties influence that integration.

Electrical synapses provide another mode of coupling through intercellular channels. Circuit behavior emerges from connection patterns together with intrinsic cell dynamics, so a wiring diagram alone is incomplete. Synapses can strengthen or weaken with activity and other signals, contributing to plasticity, learning and adaptation.

Correlation between two neurons does not prove a direct connection because both may share input. Perturbing one element and measuring a predicted effect helps test a circuit model, but compensation and indirect pathways must still be considered.
body.zh:
化学突触把前活动连到递质释放及后响应。动作电位可开钙通道，钙进入促进末端囊泡融合，递质受体效应依分子类型与靶离子条件。有些受体直接开通道，有些经胞内信号。

兴奋抑制描述对相关活动概率的影响，不是永久化学或价值标签。突触后电位大小可变，在时间空间叠加，树突几何及主动膜性质影响整合。电突触则经细胞间通道耦合。

回路行为来自连接加内在动力学，接线图不完整。突触可随活动信号增强减弱，贡献可塑性学习适应。两神经元相关不证明直接连接，可能共输入；扰动并测预测效应可检验模型，仍须考虑补偿间接途径。

objectives.en: Explain Behavioral output and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释行为输出，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Sensory systems transform selected environmental variables into neural signals through transduction. A receptor is sensitive to a range of stimuli, and its response depends on both stimulus properties and prior stimulation. Adaptation can reduce response to a sustained input while preserving sensitivity to change.

Population codes distribute information across many neurons, and the timing of spikes can carry information beyond average firing rate. Receptive fields describe which stimulus features or locations influence a neuron’s response under specified conditions; they can be shaped by network interactions rather than only direct receptor input. Successive processing stages combine, compare and transform signals, so perception is an inference-like biological process rather than a pixel-perfect copy of the external world.

Behavior additionally depends on internal state, past learning and available actions. A sensory experiment should separate detection, discrimination and decision criteria, since a changed response can reflect any of them. Illusions and context effects reveal properties of processing but do not imply that perception is arbitrary.

Link a physical stimulus, receptor response, circuit transformation and measured behavior while acknowledging where the causal chain remains uncertain.
body.zh:
感觉系统经换能把选定环境变量转为神经信号。受体对某范围刺激敏感，响应依刺激及既往刺激。适应可降低持续输入响应而保留变化敏感。

群体编码分布于多神经元，脉冲时间可携平均频率之外信息。感受野说明指定条件下影响响应的特征位置，可由网络塑造而非仅直接输入。后续阶段整合比较变换信号，所以知觉不是外界像素完美拷贝，而是生物推断样过程。

行为还依内部状态、学习和可行动作。实验应分检测、辨别与决策标准，响应改变可反映任一。错觉和背景效应揭示处理性质，不意味着知觉任意。

应连接刺激、受体、回路与行为，并承认因果链不确定处。

prompt.en: A sensory receptor responds strongly when a constant stimulus begins, then its response decreases while the stimulus continues. What is this pattern consistent with?

text.en: Sensory adaptation that changes responsiveness during sustained stimulation.
text.zh: 持续刺激期间响应性改变的感觉适应。

text.en: Proof that the stimulus vanished, regardless of independent measurements.
text.zh: 无论独立测量如何，都证明刺激消失。

text.en: Proof that all sensory neurons encode only stimulus duration and never change.
text.zh: 证明所有感觉神经元只编码刺激持续时间且永不改变。

hints.en: A changing neural response need not mean the external stimulus changed.
hints.zh: 神经响应变化不一定意味着外界刺激变化。

explanation.en: Adaptation can reduce response to a sustained input and emphasize changes. Its degree and mechanism vary by receptor and circuit; the observed response should be distinguished from the physical stimulus.
explanation.zh: 适应可降低对持续输入的响应并突出变化，其程度与机制因受体和回路而异。应区分观察到的响应与物理刺激本身。

summary.en: Model systems expose mechanisms under controlled conditions but differ from the target organism or behavior.
summary.zh: 模式系统在控制条件揭示机制，但与目标生物或行为有差异。

objectives.en: Describe Model systems and its relationship to Causal perturbation.
objectives.zh: 说明模式系统与因果扰动之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Ethical limits and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释伦理边界，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A model organism or preparation is chosen because it makes a particular question experimentally accessible. Simplicity, genetic tools, optical access or a well-characterized circuit can reveal mechanisms, but the model differs from the target system in anatomy, timescale or context. An organoid, isolated cell or artificial network does not automatically reproduce the full behavior of an intact organism.

Causal perturbations require specificity: changing one molecule or cell type can have indirect effects through development, compensation or general stress. Use appropriate controls, reversibility or rescue where feasible, and distinguish necessity from sufficiency. An element can be necessary for a behavior without uniquely encoding it, and artificial activation can evoke an outcome without proving that normal behavior uses the same pattern.

Ethical evaluation considers scientific value, welfare, alternatives and the minimum necessary burden, with oversight appropriate to the organism and procedure. Human neural data require particular care in interpretation because group averages do not determine an individual’s thoughts or abilities. Report what was measured, what was inferred and which extrapolations remain hypotheses, rather than allowing a vivid brain image to imply unwarranted certainty.
body.zh:
模式生物或制备因使问题可实验而选，简单性、遗传工具、光学可达或已知回路可揭机制，但解剖、时间与背景不同。类器官、离体细胞或人工网络不自动复现完整个体行为。因果扰动需特异性，改一分子或细胞类可经发育、补偿或一般应激产生间接效应。

应有对照、可逆或挽救，并分必要与充分：某元件必要不代表唯一编码，人工激活能引结果也不证明正常时用同模式。伦理评价权衡科学价值、福利、替代和最低必要负担，并按生物程序接受适当监督。人类神经数据尤其须谨慎，群体均值不决定个人思想能力。

应报告测量、推断与仍是假说的推广，不能让鲜明脑图造成过度确定。

summary.en: Microbes include diverse bacteria, archaea and microbial eukaryotes with different metabolisms.
summary.zh: 微生物包括代谢多样的细菌、古菌及微型真核。

objectives.en: Describe Microbial groups and its relationship to Growth curves.
objectives.zh: 说明微生物类群与生长曲线之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Environmental constraints and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释环境限制，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Microbiology studies organisms and biological agents that often require magnification or molecular methods to characterize, but “microbe” is not one evolutionary lineage. Bacteria and archaea are distinct prokaryotic domains, while fungi, protists and microscopic algae include eukaryotic forms. Their energy sources, carbon sources and electron acceptors vary, so oxygen use and nutritional requirements cannot be generalized from one familiar species.

Binary fission is common in prokaryotes, but not every microscopic organism divides by the same process. In a simplified closed population with adequate initial resources, a lag phase reflects adjustment, an exponential phase has approximately constant per-capita growth, a stationary phase reflects balanced production and loss or limited net increase, and decline can follow deteriorating conditions. These are population patterns, not synchronized stages that every individual follows together.

Optical density, direct cell counts and viable counts measure different things and can diverge. A cell-sized particle is not necessarily alive, and a viable cell need not be detected by every assay. Interpret growth data by specifying the organism, conditions, measurement and model range rather than assuming that a doubling equation remains valid indefinitely.
body.zh:
微生物学研究常需放大或分子方法表征的生物和因子，但“微生物”不是一个进化谱系。细菌古菌属不同原核域，真菌、原生生物和微藻含真核。能源、碳源及电子受体多样，不能从熟悉一种推广需氧和营养。

原核常二分裂，但并非所有微型生物相同。简单封闭种群中，延滞反映调整，指数期人均增长近恒，稳定期净增受限或生死平衡，条件恶化可衰亡。这是群体模式，不是每个个体同步经历的阶段。

光密度、直接计数与活菌数测不同量，可不一致。细胞大小粒子未必活，活细胞也非每种检测都能检出。解释增长须说明生物、条件、测量与模型范围，不能无限使用倍增式。

summary.en: Viruses package genetic material and depend on host machinery for reproduction.

objectives.en: Describe Viral genome and its relationship to Host dependence.

body.en:
Viruses contain genetic information enclosed in a protein capsid, sometimes with an additional lipid envelope. Their genomes can be DNA or RNA and differ in strand type and replication strategy. They do not possess the full independent cellular machinery needed to reproduce, so a suitable host supplies essential functions.

Entry depends on interactions with host surfaces or other delivery routes, making host range a biological property rather than a universal ability to infect every cell. After entry, viral genes are expressed and copied through mechanisms appropriate to the genome type, components assemble and new particles leave or persist in association with the host. Some infections rapidly produce particles and damage cells, while others establish longer-lived states.

A detected viral sequence or particle is not automatically evidence of ongoing productive infection. Host defenses, cell state and prior exposure influence outcome, and viruses themselves vary in how they interact with those responses. Distinguish the infectious particle outside a cell from the intracellular replication process.

Viruses illustrate evolution and molecular dependence but should not be described as tiny bacteria, because antibacterial targets and viral reproductive mechanisms are fundamentally different.
body.zh:
病毒遗传信息由蛋白衣壳包裹，有些另有脂包膜；基因组可 DNA 或 RNA，链型和复制策略不同。病毒缺完整独立细胞繁殖机器，需合适宿主功能。进入依宿主表面作用或其他输送，宿主范围是具体性质，并非可感染任意细胞。

进入后按基因组类型表达复制，组分装配，新粒子释放或与宿主持久相关。有些快速产粒子损细胞，另一些长期存在。检测到序列或粒子不自动证明正在生产性感染。

宿主防御、细胞状态、既往暴露影响结果，病毒与防御的作用也不同。应区分胞外感染粒子与胞内复制过程，病毒虽体现进化和分子依赖，却不是小细菌，因为抗细菌靶点与病毒繁殖机制根本不同。

objectives.en: Describe Community interactions and its relationship to Horizontal transfer.
objectives.zh: 说明群落作用与水平转移之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Selection and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释选择，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Microbial ecology examines interactions among organisms and their chemical environment. One species may release a metabolite that another consumes, creating cross-feeding, while competition can limit access to carbon, nutrients or space. Communities also modify pH, oxygen availability and other conditions that feed back on their own composition.

Relative abundance data describe proportions; an increase in one group’s fraction can result from decline of another without any increase in its absolute cell count. Horizontal gene transfer moves genetic material outside direct parent–offspring inheritance and can spread metabolic or resistance traits, but successful transfer and persistence depend on compatibility and selection. Evolutionary changes also arise through mutation, drift and ordinary inheritance.

Environmental pressure favors variants according to their effects; it does not cause organisms to choose the precise beneficial mutation. A resistant population can expand because susceptible competitors decline, because resistance genes spread or because new variants arise and persist. Distinguish these mechanisms using time-resolved, genetic and ecological evidence.

A microbiome association with a host trait is not automatically causal, since diet, environment, host physiology and reverse effects can influence both.
body.zh:
微生物生态研究生物与化学环境。一种释放代谢物供另一种利用形成交叉供养，竞争限制碳、营养和空间。群落也改 pH、氧等条件，反馈自身组成。

相对丰度是比例，某类比例增大可只是他类减少，绝对数未增。水平转移绕过亲子遗传搬基因，可传播代谢和抗性，但成功与持久依相容和选择。突变、漂变和普通遗传也产生变化。

summary.en: Innate defenses include physical barriers, molecular recognition and rapid cellular responses.
summary.zh: 先天防御包括物理屏障、分子识别和快速细胞响应。

objectives.en: Describe Barriers and its relationship to Pattern recognition.

objectives.en: Explain Inflammation and identify the conditions behind the example.

body.en:
Innate immunity provides layered defenses that act before or alongside highly specific adaptive responses. Physical and chemical barriers reduce entry, including epithelial surfaces and local secretions. If a barrier is breached, cells can recognize conserved microbial patterns or signals of damaged tissue through pattern-recognition receptors.

These receptors are inherited recognition systems rather than a newly generated receptor for every possible invader. Phagocytic cells can engulf material, complement proteins can mark or damage targets, and cytokines coordinate recruitment and activation. Inflammation changes local blood flow, permeability and cell traffic, helping deliver defenses but also producing tissue effects.

The response must be regulated because excessive or misdirected activation can harm the host. Recognition of a signal does not by itself identify one unique organism, and inflammation can occur without infection. Innate signals influence adaptive activation, so the two branches are connected rather than independent backup systems.

Interpret experiments by identifying the barrier, receptor, cell type and measured response. A rise in one cytokine is evidence about that signaling component, not a complete measurement of overall immune competence or the cause of a disease.
body.zh:
先天免疫提供分层防御，在特异适应响应前或同时作用。上皮与分泌等物理化学屏障减少进入。突破后，细胞通过模式识别受体检测保守微生物模式或组织损伤信号；这是遗传识别系统，不是为每个入侵者新造受体。

吞噬细胞吞材料，补体标记或损目标，细胞因子协调募集活化。炎症改局部血流、通透和细胞交通，输送防御也产生组织影响。必须调控，因为过度错向会伤宿主。

一个信号不唯一识别病原，炎症也可无感染。先天信号影响适应活化，两者相连而非独立备用。实验应明确屏障、受体、细胞与测响应；某因子升高只说明该组件，不是整体免疫能力或疾病原因的完整测量。

body.en:
Adaptive immunity uses diverse antigen receptors distributed among lymphocyte clones. A clone whose receptor recognizes a relevant target can be selected, activated and expanded when the necessary contextual signals are present. B cells can differentiate into antibody-secreting cells; antibodies bind particular molecular features and can neutralize, mark or otherwise influence targets through their structure and associated systems.

T cells recognize peptide antigens presented by appropriate major-histocompatibility molecules rather than generally binding free intact antigen in the same manner as antibodies. Different T-cell subsets coordinate responses or act on target cells. Receptor specificity does not mean perfect exclusivity, since cross-reactivity is possible.

Tolerance mechanisms reduce harmful responses to self, but their failure can contribute to immune pathology. After a response, some cells persist as memory populations and can alter later response speed and quality. Protection depends on the target, exposure route, tissue context and effector mechanisms, so antibody amount alone is not a universal immunity score.

Adaptive and innate systems exchange signals throughout activation and resolution. A proper explanation distinguishes recognition, activation, effector action and memory rather than merging them into a single event called fighting infection.
body.zh:
适应性免疫将多样抗原受体分布于淋巴克隆。受体识别相关目标且情境信号适合时，克隆被选择、活化和扩增。B 可成分泌抗体细胞，抗体结合特定分子特征，通过结构及相关系统中和、标记或影响目标。

T 细胞识别合适主要组织相容分子呈递的肽，而非像抗体一样通常直接结合完整游离抗原；不同亚群协调或作用靶细胞。特异并非绝对唯一，可能交叉反应。耐受降低有害自反应，失败可致免疫病理。

响应后部分保留为记忆，改变后来速度和质量。保护依目标、暴露途径、组织与效应，抗体量不是万能免疫分数。先天适应在活化消退全过程交流，应区分识别、活化、效应和记忆，不能统称一个“抗感染”事件。

body.en:
An immune experiment measures a chosen proxy, such as binding antibodies, neutralization under assay conditions, cell activation or a cytokine concentration. Those proxies answer different questions and need not move together. Sensitivity is the proportion of truly positive samples detected, while specificity is the proportion of truly negative samples correctly called negative.

Predictive values additionally depend on the tested population’s prevalence and the sampling design. A positive molecular or immune signal therefore requires interpretation in context rather than being a self-explanatory diagnosis. Time since exposure, age, prior immune history and assay platform can influence comparisons.

Population-level evidence benefits from clearly defined outcomes, comparable groups and methods to address confounding and missing data. Random assignment can strengthen causal inference for an intervention, while observational associations require careful alternative explanations. An immune correlate predicts or accompanies an outcome but may not itself be the protective mechanism.

Distinguish a laboratory response from demonstrated protection in the relevant setting, and report confidence intervals or uncertainty rather than only a point estimate. Educational datasets can illustrate these principles without substituting for individualized medical interpretation.
body.zh:

body.en:
Animals are multicellular eukaryotes that obtain organic material from other organisms or their products, but their structures and life histories vary enormously. Comparative anatomy considers traits such as symmetry, tissue organization, segmentation, body cavities and feeding structures. Bilateral symmetry often accompanies a distinct head–tail axis and directional movement, whereas radial organization suits other ecological arrangements; there are exceptions and secondary modifications.

Germ layers contribute to different tissues during development, but simplified developmental categories do not by themselves resolve every evolutionary relationship. A body cavity can provide space for organs or a hydrostatic support system, while skeletons may be internal, external or based on fluid pressure. Gas exchange, circulation and excretion must solve size- and environment-dependent problems, so small aquatic animals and large terrestrial animals can use very different designs.

Phylogeny combines anatomical and molecular evidence rather than ranking organisms by resemblance to humans. Similar functions can evolve through different structures, and related structures can acquire different functions. Learn representative lineages as comparisons of mechanisms and constraints, not as an endless list of names or a ladder from inferior to superior forms.
body.zh:
动物是从其他生物或其产物获取有机物的多细胞真核，但结构生活史差异巨大。比较解剖看对称、组织、分节、体腔及摄食结构。两侧对称常伴头尾轴和定向运动，辐射组织适合其他生态安排，也有例外及次生改变。

胚层对不同组织有贡献，但简化发育类别不能独自解决所有亲缘。体腔可给器官空间或液压支撑，骨骼可内、外或依流体压力。换气、循环和排泄需解决大小及环境问题，所以小水生与大陆生设计可很不同。

系统发育综合解剖和分子证据，不按像人程度排名。同功能可由不同结构实现，同源结构可获不同功能。学习代表谱系应比较机制约束，不是无尽背名或从低等到高等阶梯。

title.zh: 对称性 · 组织层次 · 进化关系

body.en: Animal body plans differ in symmetry, tissues, cavities and development. These characters help compare lineages, but evolutionary relationships require combined evidence rather than arranging animals on a single complexity ladder.
body.zh: 动物体制在对称、组织、体腔和发育上不同，这些特征帮助比较谱系，但亲缘需综合证据，不能排成单一复杂度阶梯。

body.en:
A bilaterally symmetric body is divided by its main symmetry plane into how many matching sides?

text.zh: 它们必定互为最近的现生近亲。

hints.en: Separate functional resemblance from homology of the feature being compared.

explanation.en: Similar selective pressures can produce analogous adaptations independently. Anatomy remains useful, but ancestry is inferred from multiple characters and other evidence, with careful identification of homology.
explanation.zh: 相似选择压力可独立产生相似适应。解剖学仍有价值，但祖先关系应结合多个性状和其他证据，并谨慎判断同源性。

summary.en: Homeostasis maintains variables within functional ranges through sensing, integration and responses.
summary.zh: 稳态通过感知、整合和响应将变量维持在功能范围。

objectives.en: Describe Regulated variables and its relationship to Negative feedback.
objectives.zh: 说明受调变量与负反馈之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Set-point variation and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释调节点变化，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Homeostatic regulation maintains conditions compatible with cellular function despite changing inputs and demands. A regulated variable might be temperature, ion concentration or another internal quantity, and the acceptable range need not be one exact fixed number. Sensors detect a state, integrating processes compare information with regulatory signals, and effectors alter heat production, transport, secretion or behavior.

Negative feedback means the response tends to oppose the initiating deviation. A delay or strong response can produce oscillation or overshoot, so fluctuation does not automatically indicate regulatory failure. Positive feedback reinforces a change and can be useful for a bounded event, but it usually requires an external stopping condition or depletion of the initiating stimulus.

Feedforward responses anticipate a demand rather than waiting for a measured deviation. Different variables interact: conserving water may affect heat loss, and exercise simultaneously changes oxygen demand, circulation and temperature regulation. A physiological set point can vary with time or state, so a changed target should not be confused with a broken controller.

Explain a feedback example by identifying the sensed variable, response direction, effectors and termination conditions rather than labeling any beneficial response homeostasis.
body.zh:
稳态调节在输入需求改变时维持适于细胞功能的条件。受调量可为温度、离子等，可接受范围未必一个固定点。传感器检测，整合过程比较调控信息，效应器改变产热、输运、分泌或行为。

负反馈使响应反抗初始偏离；延迟或强响应可引起振荡超调，波动不自动表示失败。正反馈增强变化，可用于有边界事件，但通常需外部终止或刺激耗尽。前馈预判需求，而非等待偏差。

多个变量互相影响，如节水影响散热，运动同时改变耗氧、循环和体温。调节点可随时间状态改变，目标改变不等于控制器坏。解释反馈须明确感知量、响应方向、效应器及终止条件，不能把任何有益反应都叫稳态。

title.en: Regulated variables · Negative feedback · Set-point variation
title.zh: 受调变量 · 负反馈 · 调节点变化

body.en: Homeostasis maintains variables within functional ranges through sensing, integration and responses. Negative feedback counteracts a deviation; positive feedback amplifies it until another process ends the loop. Regulation is dynamic rather than perfectly constant.
body.zh: 稳态通过感知、整合和响应将变量维持在功能范围。负反馈反抗偏离，正反馈放大偏离直至其他过程终止。调节是动态的，并非绝对恒定。

body.en:
A variable rises from target 100 to 112. What is its deviation above target?

Deviation = measured − target = 112 − 100 = 12.
body.zh:
变量从目标 100 升至 112，偏高多少？

偏差 = 测量值 − 目标值 = 112 − 100 = 12.

body.en: Negative feedback can involve continuing fluctuations around a regulated range. Common misconception: “Homeostasis means every internal variable is perfectly constant.”
body.zh: 负反馈可伴随调节范围附近持续波动。常见误解：“稳态意味着所有内部量完全不变。”

text.en: Negative feedback because the response opposes the initial deviation.
text.zh: 负反馈，因为响应抵消了初始偏离。

text.en: Positive feedback because the response is beneficial.
text.zh: 正反馈，因为响应有益。

text.en: No feedback because the regulated value is not perfectly constant.
text.zh: 没有反馈，因为调节值并非绝对不变。

hints.en: Feedback sign describes direction relative to the deviation, not whether the result is good.

explanation.en: Negative feedback counteracts a change in the regulated variable. It can stabilize a range without maintaining an absolutely constant number; beneficial effects do not define positive feedback.
explanation.zh: 负反馈抵消被调节变量的变化，可以稳定一个范围而不维持绝对恒值。“有益”并不是正反馈的定义。

summary.en: Respiratory surfaces exchange gases, circulation transports materials, and digestion converts food into absorbable forms.
summary.zh: 呼吸表面交换气体，循环运输物质，消化把食物转为可吸收形式。

objectives.en: Describe Exchange surfaces and its relationship to Circulation.
objectives.zh: 说明交换表面与循环之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Digestion and absorption and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释消化与吸收，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Nutrition, gas exchange and internal transport solve complementary supply problems. Digestion breaks food mechanically and chemically into forms that can cross an epithelial barrier, while absorption transfers those products into internal transport systems. Surface folds and projections increase exchange area, but a large area must also be supplied and drained effectively.

Respiratory exchange depends on partial-pressure gradients and diffusion distance; ventilation renews the external medium and circulation carries gases between exchange surfaces and tissues. Oxygen-binding proteins can increase transport capacity beyond dissolved gas alone, with binding behavior influenced by local conditions. A circulatory pump establishes pressure differences that drive flow through a network, and resistance depends strongly on vessel geometry.

Capillaries or other exchange regions connect bulk transport with short-distance diffusion. Breathing is movement of air or water across a respiratory surface, whereas cellular respiration is a metabolic process inside cells; neither term should replace the other. Coordinated regulation adjusts flow and ventilation to tissue demand.

Compare animal systems by following the path of a nutrient or oxygen molecule from the environment to a cell, identifying each barrier, driving force and transport mechanism along the way.
body.zh:
营养、换气与内运输解决互补供应问题。消化机械和化学分解食物为可跨上皮形式，吸收将产物送入体内运输。褶皱突起增面积，但仍需有效供给和带走物质。

呼吸交换依分压梯度与扩散距离，通气更新外介质，循环在表面与组织间运气体。氧结合蛋白使载氧能力超过单纯溶解，结合行为受局部条件影响。循环泵建立压差驱动网络流，阻力强烈依血管几何。

毛细等交换区连接整体输运与短程扩散。通气是空气水跨呼吸表面运动，细胞呼吸是胞内代谢，不能互换。协调调节使流量通气适应组织需求。

比较系统可追踪营养或氧从环境到细胞，逐段识别屏障、驱动力和机制。

title.en: Exchange surfaces · Circulation · Digestion and absorption
title.zh: 交换表面 · 循环 · 消化与吸收

body.en: Respiratory surfaces exchange gases, circulation transports materials, and digestion converts food into absorbable forms. Exchange depends on gradients, surface area and barrier thickness, while blood flow connects distant tissues.
body.zh: 呼吸表面交换气体，循环运输物质，消化把食物转为可吸收形式。交换依梯度、面积与屏障厚度，血流连接远处组织。

body.en:
A pump moves 70 mL per beat at 60 beats per minute. Find flow in mL/min.

Flow = stroke volume × frequency = 70 × 60 = 4200 mL/min.

泵每搏 70 mL，每分钟 60 搏，流量为多少 mL/min？

流量 = 每搏输出量 × 频率 = 70 × 60 = 4200 mL/min.

body.zh: 通气与细胞呼吸相联系却是不同过程。常见误解：“所有 ATP 都直接在肺内产生。”

prompt.en: A respiratory surface becomes thicker while area and concentration difference remain the same. Under a diffusion model, what happens to transfer rate?
prompt.zh: 呼吸表面变厚，但面积与浓度差不变。根据扩散模型，物质转移速率如何变化？

text.en: It decreases because the diffusion path is longer.
text.zh: 下降，因为扩散路径更长。

text.en: It increases because a thicker barrier always increases diffusion.
text.zh: 上升，因为屏障越厚扩散总是越快。

text.en: It cannot change because only total body mass controls diffusion.
text.zh: 不可能改变，因为只有体重控制扩散。

hints.en: For the same area and concentration difference, flux is inversely related to path length.
hints.zh: 面积与浓度差相同时，通量与路径长度成反比。

explanation.en: Fick-type diffusion gives transfer proportional to area times concentration difference divided by thickness, with other properties fixed. A thicker exchange barrier therefore slows transfer.
explanation.zh: 其他性质固定时，菲克型扩散的转移量与面积、浓度差成正比，与厚度成反比，因此较厚交换屏障会降低转移速率。

summary.en: Excretory systems remove metabolic wastes while regulating water and ions.
summary.zh: 排泄系统去代谢废物并调节水离子。

objectives.en: Describe Filtration and its relationship to Selective reabsorption.
objectives.zh: 说明滤过与选择性重吸收之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Water–salt balance and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释水盐平衡，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Metabolism produces wastes, and living in water or on land also creates challenges of maintaining water and ion balance. Excretion removes metabolic products, whereas egestion removes material that was not absorbed from food. Nitrogen-containing wastes differ in toxicity, water requirement and energetic cost, helping explain why animal groups use different dominant forms.

In a nephron-like system, pressure-driven filtration transfers water and small solutes from a fluid compartment, but valuable substances would be lost if filtration were the final step. Selective reabsorption returns needed material, while secretion adds particular substances to the forming excretory fluid. Countercurrent arrangements and active transport can establish gradients that support water conservation.

Hormonal regulation changes permeability or transport activity according to physiological state. Freshwater, marine and terrestrial animals face different osmotic gradients, so one universal “remove excess water” explanation is inadequate. A final urine or excretory composition reflects filtration, reabsorption, secretion and flow together.

Use a material balance to distinguish those contributions, and do not infer that a substance was never filtered merely because little appears in the final output.
body.zh:
代谢产生废物，水陆环境还带来水盐平衡挑战。排泄去代谢产物，排遗去未被食物吸收的材料。含氮废物毒性、需水和能耗不同，解释不同动物主要形式差异。

肾单位样系统中，压差滤过水及小溶质，但若止于滤过会丢失有用物。选择重吸收回收所需，分泌则把特定物加入形成的排液。逆流安排和主动运输建立梯度，帮助节水；激素按状态改变透过性与转运。

淡水、海洋和陆生面对不同渗透梯度，不能一律说“排多余水”。最终组成由滤过、重吸收、分泌和流量共同决定。应物料核算区分贡献，终输出少不能推断该物从未被滤过。

title.zh: 滤过 · 选择性重吸收 · 水盐平衡

body.en: Excretory systems remove metabolic wastes while regulating water and ions. Filtration is followed by selective reabsorption and secretion, so final excreted composition is not simply an unchanged sample of body fluid.
body.zh: 排泄系统去代谢废物并调节水离子。滤过后有选择重吸收与分泌，因此最终排出物不是未经改变的体液样本。

body.en:
A model filters 100 units and reabsorbs 95, with no secretion. Find excreted amount.

Excreted = filtered − reabsorbed = 100 − 95 = 5.
body.zh:
模型滤过 100 单位，重吸收 95，无分泌，排出多少？

排出量 = 滤过量 − 重吸收量 = 100 − 95 = 5.

body.en: Excretion and undigested-food elimination are different processes. Common misconception: “Kidneys merely remove all filtered substances without selection.”
body.zh: 排泄与排出未消化食物是不同过程。常见误解：“肾只是不加选择地排出所有滤过物。”
