summary.en: Spectra measure energy differences between states, with transition strengths constrained by symmetry and coupling to radiation.
summary.zh: 光谱测量态间能量差，跃迁强度受对称性及与辐射耦合限制。

objectives.en: Describe Rotational levels and its relationship to Vibrational levels.
objectives.zh: 说明转动能级与振动能级之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Selection rules and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释选择定则，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A molecular spectrum is a set of transition frequencies and intensities, not a direct drawing of the molecule. Photon energy must match the difference between initial and final states, while the coupling matrix element and state populations determine whether the transition is observable and how strong it is. Rotational energies depend on moments of inertia and therefore reveal information about mass distribution and bond lengths.

Vibrational frequencies depend on force constants and masses; isotopic substitution can shift them without changing the main electronic bonding pattern. Electronic transitions usually involve larger energies and can overlap with vibrational structure. Selection rules arise from symmetry and the interaction with radiation, so an existing energy gap need not produce a strong allowed line.

Finite lifetimes, collisions, thermal motion and instrument response broaden spectral features. The harmonic oscillator and rigid rotor are useful first models, but anharmonicity and centrifugal distortion produce corrections. Interpret a spectrum by combining positions, intensities, isotope changes and temperature dependence.

A single frequency match is weak evidence compared with a consistent assignment across multiple independent features and known selection constraints.
body.zh:
分子光谱是一组跃迁频率与强度，不是分子直接图像。光子能量须匹配始末态差，耦合矩阵元及态布居决定能否观测和强度。转动能取决于转动惯量，可揭示质量分布与键长；振动频率依赖力常数与质量，同位素替换可在基本电子成键不变时移频。

电子跃迁能量通常较大，可伴振动结构。选择定则来自对称性与辐射作用，所以有能隙未必有强允许谱线。有限寿命、碰撞、热运动及仪器响应使峰展宽。

谐振子和刚性转子是初模型，非谐与离心畸变给出修正。解释应结合位置、强度、同位素变化及温度依赖。单频匹配证据弱，多个独立谱征与选择约束一致更有说服力。

title.zh: 统计热力学与反应动力学

summary.en: Statistical thermodynamics builds macroscopic averages from state energies and probabilities.
summary.zh: 统计热力学从态能量与概率建立宏观平均。

objectives.en: Describe Partition functions and its relationship to Transition-state model.
objectives.zh: 说明配分函数与过渡态模型之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Energy distributions and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释能量分布，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Statistical thermodynamics connects a list of microscopic states with measurable averages. At fixed temperature in the canonical description, a state’s weight decreases exponentially with energy, while degeneracy multiplies the number of states contributing at that energy. The partition function sums those weights and normalizes probabilities.

Translational, rotational, vibrational and electronic contributions can sometimes be factored approximately when their motions are sufficiently separable. Derivatives and weighted averages then yield energy, heat capacity and other thermodynamic quantities. Reaction dynamics adds the question of how trajectories or quantum amplitudes move between reactant and product regions.

Transition-state theory estimates flux through a dividing surface near a free-energy bottleneck, assuming an appropriate equilibrium-like population and limited recrossing. A barrier’s height alone is not always enough: orientation, solvent reorganization, tunneling and competing channels can affect rate. Thermodynamic populations and kinetic pathways therefore play complementary roles.

Two reactions can have similar equilibrium constants but radically different speeds. When using a rate model, identify which degrees of freedom are equilibrated, what defines the dividing surface and which dynamical corrections have been neglected rather than treating an exponential factor as a universal complete explanation.
body.zh:
统计热力学把微观态列表连接到可测平均。恒温正则描述中，态权重随能量指数降低，简并度增加该能量贡献的态数，配分函数求和并归一概率。运动足够可分离时，平动、转动、振动和电子贡献可近似因子化，通过导数及加权平均得到能量、热容等量。

反应动力学进一步问轨迹或量子振幅如何在反应物与产物区域之间运动。过渡态理论估计自由能瓶颈附近分界面的通量，假定合适类平衡布居及有限回穿。仅势垒高度不总够，取向、溶剂重组、隧穿与竞争通道都可影响速率。

热力学布居与动力学路径互补，平衡常数相近的反应速度可迥异。使用速率模型时，应明确哪些自由度平衡、分界面如何定义、忽略何种动力学修正，不能把指数因子视为普适完整解释。

summary.en: Analytical results depend first on whether the sample represents the material of interest.
summary.zh: 分析结果首先依赖样品是否代表目标材料。

objectives.en: Describe Representative sampling and its relationship to Precision.
objectives.zh: 说明代表性取样与精密度之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Calibration curve and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释校准曲线，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
An analytical measurement begins before the instrument is switched on. Define the target population or batch and the property to be reported, then choose a sampling scheme capable of representing its variation. A soil surface scoop, for example, may not represent deeper material even if its laboratory assay is exceptionally precise.

Homogenization, storage, contamination and chemical changes during transport can all alter the sample. Precision concerns the spread of repeated measurements under stated conditions; accuracy concerns agreement with an appropriate reference, and bias is a systematic offset. A calibration curve relates known standard amounts to instrument response and may include a nonzero blank signal.

Use standards spanning the relevant range and inspect residuals rather than automatically forcing a line through zero. Interpolation within a validated range is generally better supported than extrapolation. Matrix components can change the response relative to a simple standard solution, motivating matrix matching or standard additions when appropriate.

Propagate uncertainty from sampling, preparation, calibration and measurement instead of reporting only the instrument’s final display digits. A precise result from a biased sample answers the wrong question precisely.
body.zh:
分析测量在开机前已经开始。先定义目标总体或批次及报告性质，再选能代表其变异的取样方案。比如表层土一勺，即使检测极精密，也可能不代表深层。

均化、保存、污染和运输中的化学变化均可改变样品。精密度关注重复分散，准确性关注与合适参考的一致，偏倚是系统偏移。校准曲线联系已知标准量与信号，可有非零空白。

标准应覆盖相关范围，检查残差，不应自动强迫过原点。验证范围内插值通常比外推更有依据。基体可使响应不同于简单标准液，因此可能需基体匹配或标准加入。

应传播取样、制备、校准及测量不确定度，而非只报显示位数。偏倚样品的精密结果，是精确回答了错误问题。

summary.en: Titration infers amount from a known reacting quantity; the observed endpoint approximates a stoichiometric equivalence point.
summary.zh: 滴定由已知反应量推断待测量，观察终点近似计量等当点。

objectives.zh: 说明等当点与终点之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Precipitate mass and identify the conditions behind the example.

body.en:
A titration uses a reaction with known stoichiometry to convert a measured titrant amount into an analyte amount. The reaction must be sufficiently complete, selective and fast under the chosen conditions. The equivalence point is the theoretical composition where the stoichiometric amount has been added; the endpoint is an observed signal change used to stop the experiment.

Their difference is a method-dependent error that can be minimized by a suitable indicator or instrumental criterion. Standardize the titrant when its concentration cannot be established reliably from preparation alone. Account for aliquot volume, dilution factors and the actual reaction coefficient ratio rather than assuming every reaction is one to one.

Gravimetric analysis instead isolates a compound of known composition, converts it to a stable weighable form and uses its mass to infer the analyte. Incomplete precipitation lowers recovery, while coprecipitated impurities or retained water can raise apparent mass. Washing must remove contaminants without dissolving excessive product, and drying to a stable mass helps establish a reproducible composition.

Both methods rely on chemical selectivity and careful material accounting, not only accurate balance or burette readings.
body.zh:
滴定用已知计量反应把滴定剂量换算为分析物量，要求反应在所选条件下足够完全、选择性好且快。等当点是理论计量加入量，终点是实际用于停止实验的信号变化，两者差是方法误差，可选适当指示剂或仪器判据减小。若配制不能可靠确定浓度，应标定滴定剂。

须计入分取体积、稀释倍数和真实计量比，不能默认所有反应 1:1。重量分析则分离已知组成化合物，转为稳定称量形式，再由质量推分析物。不完全沉淀降低回收，共沉淀杂质或残水可抬高表观质量。

洗涤须除污染又不过量溶失产物，干燥至恒重有助建立可重复组成。两种方法都依赖选择性与物料核算，而非仅靠天平或滴定管精确。

summary.en: Chromatography separates components through different interactions with stationary and mobile phases.
summary.zh: 色谱利用组分对固定相和流动相作用不同来分离。

objectives.en: Describe Partitioning and its relationship to Retention.
objectives.zh: 说明分配与保留之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Resolution and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释分离度，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A separation succeeds when components move differently enough to distinguish their signals or collect them separately. Chromatography repeatedly partitions species between a moving phase and a stationary environment. Stronger retention in the stationary phase generally delays arrival, while flow rate and column geometry also affect retention time.

Different separation modes exploit adsorption, partitioning, size, charge or affinity, so a method suitable for one mixture may fail for another. Resolution depends both on the distance between peak centres and on peak broadening. Broadening can arise from multiple flow paths, longitudinal diffusion and slow mass transfer between phases.

Increasing column length may improve separation but also increases time and pressure requirements. Peak area can support quantitative analysis only with a suitable response calibration; equal areas do not necessarily imply equal masses for different compounds. A retention-time match is supportive but not unique identification because unrelated species can coelute.

Couple separation with an independent detector or compare under altered conditions to strengthen identification. Also distinguish analytical separation, which measures composition, from preparative separation, which prioritizes collecting adequate purity and yield.
body.zh:
分离要求组分移动差异足以区分信号或分别收集。色谱让物种在流动相与固定环境之间反复分配，固定相保留越强通常越晚到达，流速与柱几何也影响保留时间。不同模式利用吸附、分配、大小、电荷或亲和，一种混合物适用的方法可能对另一种失效。

分离度同时取决于峰中心距离和峰展宽，展宽可来自多路径、纵向扩散及相间传质慢。加长色谱柱可能提高分离，但增加时间和压力。峰面积只有经过适当响应校准才可定量，不同物质等面积未必等质量。

保留时间相同只是支持证据，无关物种可共洗脱；结合独立检测或改变条件比较可增强鉴定。分析分离主要测组成，制备分离更关注收集纯度和产率，二者目标不同。

title.zh: 分配 · 保留 · 分离度

summary.en: Absorbance is −log10 transmitted intensity fraction.
summary.zh: 吸光度为透射强度比例的负常用对数。

objectives.en: Describe Absorbance and its relationship to Beer–Lambert law.

objectives.en: Explain Selectivity and identify the conditions behind the example.

body.en:
Spectroscopy measures how matter interacts with electromagnetic radiation as a function of wavelength or frequency. Absorption can probe electronic, vibrational or other allowed transitions, and the selected region determines which structural information is accessible. Transmittance is the fraction of incident intensity emerging from the sample; absorbance is its negative base-ten logarithm.

Beer–Lambert behavior predicts absorbance proportional to concentration and path length when the absorbing species is unchanged, the light is sufficiently monochromatic and scattering or instrumental limitations are negligible. A solvent and reagent blank estimates background contributions under matched conditions. Choose a wavelength with useful sensitivity and limited interference, then calibrate using standards in the valid range.

At high absorbance, stray light and detector limits can distort linearity; at changing concentration, association or acid–base equilibria can change the absorbing species itself. For mixtures, absorbances can add under suitable independent-species assumptions, requiring multiple wavelengths or other constraints to separate contributions. A spectral feature can support identity while a calibrated signal supports amount; these are related but distinct claims that should not be conflated.
body.zh:
光谱测量物质与电磁辐射的作用如何随波长或频率变化。吸收可探测电子、振动等允许跃迁，所选波段决定可得结构信息。透射率是出射与入射强度之比，吸光度是其负常用对数。

当吸收物种不变、光足够单色、散射和仪器限制可忽略时，比尔—朗伯关系预测吸光度正比于浓度与光程。溶剂和试剂空白估计匹配背景。应选灵敏且干扰少的波长，并用有效范围内标准校准。

高吸光度时杂散光和探测器限制可破坏线性；浓度改变时缔合或酸碱平衡也可能改变吸收物种。合适独立物种假设下，混合物吸光度可相加，需多波长或其他约束分离贡献。谱征支持身份，校准信号支持含量，两者相关但不是同一结论。

summary.en: A quality-control plan distinguishes contamination, loss, drift and random variability.
summary.zh: 质量控制计划区分污染、损失、漂移和随机变异。

objectives.en: Describe Blanks and its relationship to Recovery.
objectives.zh: 说明空白与回收率之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Reference materials and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释标准物质，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Quality control is a set of targeted checks on an entire analytical process. A reagent blank follows the procedure without intentional analyte and can reveal contamination or background signal. A field blank may also test collection and transport contamination.

A duplicate tests combined sampling or measurement variability depending on where the duplication begins. A spike adds a known amount of analyte to a sample; recovery compares the measured increment with the added amount and can expose losses or matrix effects. A certified reference material provides an independent composition benchmark when its matrix and concentration range are relevant.

Calibration checks interspersed through a run detect drift that a single initial calibration would miss. Define acceptance criteria and a response to failed controls before examining the sample results, rather than adjusting criteria to make a run appear successful. Randomize or balance run order where time trends could confound treatment comparisons.

Preserve traceable sample identifiers, preparation records and raw measurements. A method can be precise but inaccurate, or accurate on standards but biased in real samples, so several complementary controls are necessary.
body.zh:
质量控制针对完整分析流程设置不同检查。试剂空白不故意加分析物但走全流程，揭示污染或背景；现场空白还能检验采集运输污染。平行样检验取样或测量变异，取决于从哪一步重复。

加标向样品加入已知分析物，比较测得增量与加入量，可揭示损失或基体效应。基体和浓度范围合适的标准物质提供独立组成基准。穿插校准核查可发现初始校准遗漏的漂移。

应在看样品结果前定义接受标准及控制失败后的处置，而不是事后改标准让实验显得成功。若时间趋势可能混杂处理比较，应随机或平衡运行顺序。保留可追溯编号、制备记录与原始读数。

方法可精密但不准确，也可在标准液准确而在真实样品偏倚，因此需要互补控制。

summary.en: Unknown identification combines composition, separation, reaction and spectral evidence.

objectives.en: Describe Orthogonal evidence and its relationship to Candidate elimination.
objectives.zh: 说明互补证据与候选排除之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Detection limits and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释检出限，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Unknown identification is an exercise in constraint combination. Begin with broad observations that do not prematurely assume a structure: phase, solubility, elemental composition or accurate mass can narrow the candidate class. Then use selective reactions, chromatographic behavior and spectra to test more specific possibilities.

Each result has a sensitivity, specificity and uncertainty; a negative test means only that the target response was not detected under those conditions. A positive result can also have false alternatives if several species respond similarly. Orthogonal evidence is valuable because it constrains different features, such as elemental formula, functional groups and connectivity, rather than repeating the same assumption in several forms.

Track which observations each candidate explains and which it contradicts. Do not rescue a favored candidate by silently ignoring a reliable inconsistent feature. If multiple structures remain compatible, report that ambiguity and propose the next measurement that would discriminate them.

Quantitative purity and qualitative identity are separate: correctly identifying the principal component does not establish that no impurity is present. A defensible conclusion states the supported identity, relevant limits and the evidence chain connecting measurements to inference.
body.zh:
未知物鉴定是组合约束。先观察不预设结构的广泛性质，如相态、溶解度、元素组成或准确质量，再用选择性反应、色谱和光谱检验更具体候选。每项结果都有灵敏度、特异性和不确定度；阴性只表示该条件下未检出目标响应，阳性也可能有其他会产生类似响应的物种。

互补证据约束不同特征，如分子式、官能团与连接，而不是多次重复同一假设。应记录各候选解释哪些观察、与哪些矛盾，不能为保留偏爱候选而忽略可靠冲突。若多个结构仍相容，应报告歧义并提出最能区分的下一测量。

主成分身份正确不等于没有杂质，定性身份与定量纯度不同。可辩护结论应说明支持的身份、相关限制，以及从测量到推断的证据链。

objectives.en: Explain Skeletal notation and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释键线式，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Carbon commonly forms four bonds, allowing chains, branches and rings with many different connectivities. A molecular formula counts atoms but does not show which atoms are joined, so structural isomers can share a formula. Condensed formulas group atoms into recognizable units, while skeletal drawings suppress most carbon and attached hydrogen labels.

Read each unlabeled vertex and line end as carbon, count bond orders, then add the implied hydrogens needed for ordinary neutral carbon valence. Heteroatoms and hydrogens attached to them are usually shown explicitly. Functional groups identify recurring local structures such as alcohols, carbonyls, carboxylic acids, amines and alkenes; a molecule can contain several and their interactions matter.

Systematic naming selects an appropriate parent skeleton, numbers it to locate substituents and principal groups, and records unsaturation and suffixes. The name is a compact structural instruction, not a substitute for drawing. A degree-of-unsaturation count compares hydrogen content with an acyclic saturated reference and can reveal rings or multiple bonds, but cannot locate them.

Always verify that the final structure matches both the atom inventory and chemically plausible valences.
body.zh:
碳通常成四键，可形成链、支链与环等多种连接。分子式只计数原子，不说明连接，因此结构异构体可同式。简式把原子合成易识别单元，键线式省去大部分碳和相连氢。

每个未标顶点与端点读作碳，数清键级，再补足普通中性碳价态所需氢；杂原子及与其相连的氢通常明写。官能团是重复局部结构，如醇、羰基、羧酸、胺和烯烃；一个分子可有多个官能团且彼此影响。系统命名选择合适母体，编号定位取代基与主官能团，并记录不饱和与后缀。

名称是压缩结构指令，不能代替画图。不饱和度把氢含量与无环饱和参照比较，可提示环和多重键，但不能确定位置。最终结构应同时符合原子库存与合理价态。

body.en:
Three-dimensional structure matters because molecules interact with other structured molecules. A tetrahedral atom attached to four distinguishable substituents is a common stereogenic centre, but chirality can also arise without this motif. Chirality means that an object and its mirror image cannot be superimposed by rotation and translation.

Enantiomers have identical properties in an ideal achiral environment except for opposite optical rotation, yet can behave differently with enzymes or other chiral partners. Diastereomers are stereoisomers that are not mirror-image partners and can differ in ordinary physical properties. R and S labels encode a priority-based configuration; they do not directly predict the sign of optical rotation.

Conformations arise through rotations about suitable single bonds, such as staggered and eclipsed ethane or chair cyclohexane arrangements. Steric and torsional energies make some conformations more populated than others. Configuration is retained under those ordinary rotations.

For n independent stereocentres, 2^n is an upper bound, not a guarantee: internal symmetry can produce meso forms and reduce the count. Draw and compare structures explicitly rather than relying on a flat left-versus-right impression.
body.zh:
三维结构重要，因为分子与其他有结构分子相互作用。四面体原子连接四种不同取代基是常见立体中心，但手性也可不依赖该结构。手性指物体与镜像无法经旋转平移重合。

理想非手性环境中，对映体除旋光方向相反外性质相同，但与酶或手性伙伴可有不同作用。非对映体不是镜像对，普通物理性质可不同。R/S 按优先序编码构型，并不直接预测旋光正负。

构象来自合适单键旋转，例如乙烷交错/重叠、环己烷椅式；位阻与扭转能影响各构象占比，普通旋转不改变构型。n 个独立立体中心的 2^n 只是上界，内部对称可产生内消旋形式并减少数量。应实际画图比较，不能凭平面左右印象判断。

body.en:
Organic mechanisms are electron-accounting models. A full curved arrow represents movement of an electron pair; its tail must begin at a lone pair or an existing bond, and its head identifies the atom or bond receiving that pair. After drawing arrows, redraw the product and check every atom’s bond count and formal charge.

Nucleophiles are electron-pair donors and electrophiles are acceptors, but nucleophilicity is a kinetic property and should not be equated automatically with basicity, which is an equilibrium property. Steric hindrance and solvent can make a strong base a poor nucleophile for a particular substitution. Proton transfer compares the relative stability of acid–base partners.

Resonance delocalization, electronegativity, inductive effects, hybridization and solvation can stabilize a conjugate base and increase acidity. Resonance contributors are alternative descriptions of one electronic structure, not rapidly interconverting molecules. Arrows used to relate contributors redistribute electrons without moving nuclei.

Every proposed mechanism must preserve total atoms and charge, and arrows alone do not establish that the indicated path is experimentally correct; rate and product evidence must also support it.
body.zh:
有机机理是电子记账模型。完整弯箭头表示一对电子移动，尾部须从孤电子对或已有键出发，头部指向接收电子对的原子或键。画箭头后应重画产物并检查每个原子键数与形式电荷。

亲核体供电子对，亲电体受电子对，但亲核性属于动力学性质，碱性属于平衡性质，不能自动等同。位阻与溶剂可使强碱在某取代中成为弱亲核体。质子转移比较酸碱伙伴的相对稳定；共振离域、电负性、诱导、杂化及溶剂化可稳定共轭碱并增强酸性。

共振贡献式是同一电子结构的替代描述，不是快速互变分子；贡献式之间只移动电子，不移动原子核。机制须守恒原子和电荷，但画出箭头不能证明实验确实沿该路径，还需速率与产物证据。

objectives.en: Describe SN1 and SN2 and its relationship to E1 and E2.

objectives.en: Explain Competing pathways and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释竞争路径，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Substitution and elimination often compete because the same substrate and reagent can support more than one pathway. In an SN2 step, a nucleophile attacks while the leaving group departs in one concerted event. Backside approach produces inversion at an appropriate stereogenic reaction centre, and crowding around that centre slows the pathway.

An SN1 mechanism begins with ionization to a carbocation-like intermediate; its rate-limiting formation can make the initial rate independent of nucleophile concentration. Such intermediates may rearrange, and product stereochemistry can reflect solvent cages rather than perfect unrestricted randomization. E2 elimination is concerted and usually requires a suitable antiperiplanar arrangement of the removed hydrogen and leaving group.

E1 proceeds through an ionization intermediate shared with possible SN1 chemistry. Base strength, nucleophile character, substrate structure, leaving-group ability, solvent and temperature must be considered together. A highly substituted substrate does not mechanically select one pathway under every condition.

Compare the predicted rate dependence, rearrangements and stereochemical outcomes with evidence. Product ratios reflect competing activation barriers and may change when one experimental condition is changed.
body.zh:
取代与消除常竞争，因为同一底物和试剂可支持多条路径。SN2 中亲核进攻与离去同步完成，背面进攻在合适反应立体中心产生构型反转，中心拥挤会减慢。SN1 先离解形成碳正离子型中间体，其形成若控速，初速可与亲核体浓度无关。

中间体可能重排，产物立体化学也可能受溶剂笼影响，并非完美随机化。E2 协同消除通常需要被移除氢与离去基适当反式共平面；E1 经离解中间体，可与 SN1 共用。应同时考虑碱强度、亲核性、底物、离去能力、溶剂和温度，不能认为高取代底物在任何条件下都必选某一路。

比较速率依赖、重排与立体结果来检验机理，产物比反映竞争活化势垒，改变条件可改变比例。

summary.en: Addition converts a pi bond into new sigma-bond connections.

body.en:
An alkene’s pi bond contains accessible electron density and can react with an electrophile. Addition consumes that pi bond and creates new sigma bonds, with regioselectivity and stereoselectivity depending on the mechanism rather than a universal slogan. Aromatic systems gain stabilization from cyclic delocalization under appropriate orbital conditions.

Electrophilic aromatic substitution temporarily disrupts that delocalization and then restores it by losing a proton, which helps explain why substitution can be favored over simple addition. Existing substituents affect both reaction rate and preferred position through electronic effects. A carbonyl group is polarized toward oxygen, leaving carbon susceptible to nucleophilic attack.

Aldehydes and ketones commonly undergo addition, whereas carboxylic-acid derivatives bearing a suitable leaving group can undergo nucleophilic acyl substitution through a tetrahedral intermediate. Acid or base conditions alter both electrophile activation and nucleophile availability. An addition product and a substitution product are therefore not interchangeable predictions.

Identify the functional group, leaving-group ability, reaction medium and proton transfers, then track atoms through each step rather than memorizing an isolated final formula.
body.zh:
烯烃 π 键具有易参与反应的电子密度，可与亲电体反应。加成消耗 π 键并形成新 σ 键，区域和立体选择性取决于机理，而非万能口号。芳香系统在适当轨道条件下由环状离域获得稳定。

亲电芳香取代暂时破坏离域，再失质子恢复，因此常比简单加成有利；原有取代基通过电子效应改变速率与定位。羰基向氧极化，使碳易受亲核进攻。醛酮常发生加成，而带合适离去基的羧酸衍生物可经四面体中间体发生亲核酰基取代。

酸碱条件同时改变亲电活化和亲核体可用性。因此加成与取代不能随意互换预测，应识别官能团、离去能力、介质和质子转移，再逐步追踪原子，而不是只背最终式。

body.en:
A synthesis plan connects a target structure to available starting materials through chemically plausible transformations. Retrosynthetic analysis disconnects a target bond conceptually and asks which precursor functional groups could form it. Those backward suggestions must then be checked forward for reagent compatibility, selectivity and the order of operations.

Chemoselectivity distinguishes which functional group reacts; regioselectivity distinguishes positions; stereoselectivity distinguishes spatial products. Protecting groups can temporarily suppress one reactive site but add steps and losses, so they are a strategic tradeoff rather than an automatic requirement. Overall isolated yield multiplies step yields, making unnecessary steps costly even when each step looks efficient.

Structure identification works in the opposite direction by combining constraints. Mass spectrometry constrains mass and fragmentation; infrared absorption suggests bond types; NMR chemical shifts, integrals and couplings constrain distinct environments and neighboring relationships. No single peak normally proves a whole structure.

Build candidates consistent with formula and unsaturation, then reject those contradicting any reliable spectral feature. Report uncertainty when multiple candidates remain rather than treating a plausible sketch as a uniquely established molecule.
body.zh:
合成计划通过合理转化把可得原料连接到目标结构。逆合成在概念上切断目标键，寻找可形成该键的前体官能团；反推后须正向检查试剂相容、选择性与顺序。化学选择性区分反应官能团，区域选择性区分位置，立体选择性区分空间产物。

保护基可暂时抑制位点，但增加步骤和损失，是策略权衡而非自动要求。总分离产率为各步产率乘积，即使单步高效，多余步骤仍代价明显。结构鉴定则综合约束反推结构：质谱约束质量与碎片，红外提示键类型，核磁位移、积分与耦合约束环境及邻接。

单峰通常不能证明完整结构。先依据分子式与不饱和度建立候选，再排除与可靠谱征矛盾者；若仍多解，应报告不确定性，而不是把合理草图说成唯一已证分子。

body.en:
Main-group chemistry uses the periodic table as an explanatory framework rather than a list of isolated facts. Valence-electron configuration constrains common bonding patterns, but orbital size, effective nuclear attraction and polarizability alter those patterns down a group. Small second-period atoms often form strong multiple bonds, while heavier congeners can favor different structures or coordination numbers.

Oxidation state tracks formal electron assignment; its stability depends on both the element and its chemical partners. In heavier p-block elements, lower oxidation states can become comparatively important, an observation often discussed through the inert-pair effect. Acidic oxides react with bases and basic oxides with acids; amphoteric oxides can participate in both types of reaction under suitable conditions.

This classification concerns reaction behavior, not simply whether oxygen is present. Hydrides range from ionic to covalent, so their reactions with water or acids cannot be predicted from the formula label alone. Compare representative compounds by identifying bond polarity, structure, accessible oxidation changes and acid–base roles.

A periodic trend generates a hypothesis; actual phase, solvent and reaction conditions decide whether the proposed reaction occurs.
body.zh:
主族化学把周期表作为解释框架，而不是孤立事实列表。价电子排布约束常见成键模式，但轨道大小、有效核吸引与可极化性会沿族改变这些模式。小的第二周期原子常形成强多重键，较重同族元素可偏好不同结构与配位数。

氧化态记录形式电子归属，其稳定性取决于元素及化学伙伴；重 p 区元素中，低氧化态可能更重要，常用惰性电子对效应讨论。酸性氧化物与碱反应，碱性氧化物与酸反应，两性氧化物在合适条件下两者皆可。此分类关注反应行为，并非仅看是否含氧。

氢化物从离子型到共价型均有，与水酸的反应不能仅凭名称预测。比较代表化合物时，应识别键极性、结构、可及氧化变化及酸碱角色。周期趋势提出假设，相态、溶剂和条件决定实际反应。

body.en:
A coordination compound contains a central atom or ion associated with ligands through donor atoms. A ligand may bind through one donor atom, several donors on the same molecule, or bridge two metal centres. Denticity counts how many donors from one ligand attach to a given centre, while coordination number counts all attached donor atoms.

A chelating ligand uses multiple donor atoms, often changing complex stability through both enthalpic and entropic effects. To assign the metal oxidation state, combine the complex charge with the formal charges of its ligands; neutral ligands contribute zero to that charge calculation. Structural isomers differ in connectivity, such as which donor atom an ambidentate ligand uses.

Geometric isomers preserve connectivity but change relative positions, as with cis and trans arrangements in suitable square-planar or octahedral complexes. Optical isomers are nonsuperimposable mirror images and can interact differently with chiral environments. Draw the actual geometry before counting isomers: a flat formula alone hides spatial information.

The same coordination number does not guarantee one geometry, and geometry can depend on metal identity, oxidation state and ligand properties.
body.zh:
配位化合物含中心原子或离子及通过给体原子结合的配体。一个配体可单点结合、多点结合，也可桥连两个金属中心。齿数计数同一配体连到给定中心的给体数，配位数计数所有连接给体原子。

螯合配体用多个给体结合，常通过焓与熵因素改变稳定性。确定金属氧化态时，将配合物总电荷与配体形式电荷合并，电中性配体在此计算中贡献零。结构异构体连接方式不同，例如两可配体改用另一给体原子。

几何异构保持连接却改变相对位置，如合适平面正方或八面体中的顺反。光学异构体互为不可重合镜像，可与手性环境不同作用。计数异构体前应画实际几何，平面化学式隐藏空间信息。

同一配位数不保证同一构型，构型还依赖金属、氧化态与配体。

body.en:
In a free isolated ion, the five d orbitals have the same energy before additional interactions are considered. A surrounding ligand arrangement breaks that equivalence because orbitals point toward or between different ligand directions. In an octahedral crystal-field picture, orbitals directed toward the six ligands are raised relative to the other three.

The splitting energy competes with the energetic cost of pairing electrons. When splitting is small, electrons may occupy higher orbitals before pairing; when it is large, pairing in the lower set can be favored. The outcome depends on electron count, metal identity, oxidation state and ligand type.

Counting unpaired electrons provides a first magnetic prediction, while transitions between split states can absorb visible light and contribute to colour. Colour alone is not an infallible oxidation-state label, because several transitions and environmental effects may contribute. Tetrahedral and square-planar geometries have different splitting patterns and must not inherit the octahedral diagram unchanged.

Crystal-field theory treats ligands electrostatically; ligand-field and molecular-orbital descriptions include covalent mixing and can explain bonding trends that a purely electrostatic model misses.
body.zh:
孤立自由离子的五个 d 轨道在进一步相互作用前等能。周围配体排列破坏等价性，因为轨道分别指向配体或配体间隙。八面体晶体场中，指向六个配体的轨道相对另三个升高。

分裂能与电子配对代价竞争：分裂小时可能先占高轨道再配对，分裂大时可能先在低能组配对。结果依赖电子数、金属、氧化态与配体。未成对电子数给出初步磁性预测，分裂态间跃迁可吸收可见光并贡献颜色。

颜色不是绝对可靠的氧化态标签，因为多种跃迁及环境效应可同时贡献。四面体和平面正方分裂不同，不能原样套八面体图。晶体场把配体作静电处理，配位场和分子轨道描述加入共价混合，可解释纯静电模型遗漏的趋势。

body.en:
Transition-metal chemistry is diverse because several valence electronic arrangements can be close enough in energy to participate in bonding and redox chemistry. Removing electrons from a neutral atom does not always follow the simple written filling order in reverse; for common first-row transition-metal cations, outer s electrons are removed before d electrons. A metal’s oxidation state affects charge density and ligand attraction, while ligand identity can stabilize one oxidation state relative to another.

Redox potentials are therefore properties of specified chemical couples and conditions, not permanent numbers belonging to an element in every environment. Complex colour and magnetism reflect electronic states and geometry. Ligand substitution changes the coordination sphere without necessarily changing oxidation state; redox changes electron bookkeeping and may occur with or without a simultaneous ligand change.

Thermodynamic stability measures an equilibrium preference, whereas kinetic inertness measures how slowly exchange occurs. A complex can be stable yet labile, or metastable yet persist because exchange is slow. Predict a reaction by combining oxidation state, ligand availability, solvent, pH and possible precipitates rather than using metal identity alone.
body.zh:
过渡金属化学多样，因为几种价电子排布可能能量接近，参与成键与氧化还原。从中性原子移电子不总是书写填充顺序的简单倒转，常见第一过渡系阳离子通常先失外层 s 电子再失 d 电子。氧化态影响电荷密度与配体吸引，配体也能相对稳定某种氧化态。

因此氧化还原电势属于指定电对和条件，并非元素在所有环境中的永久数值。颜色与磁性反映电子态与几何。配体取代改变配位层而不一定改变氧化态；氧化还原改变电子记账，可伴随或不伴随配体改变。

热力学稳定衡量平衡偏好，动力学惰性衡量交换慢快。配合物可稳定但易交换，也可亚稳却因交换慢而长期存在。预测时应结合氧化态、配体、溶剂、pH 和可能沉淀，不能只看金属名称。

body.en:
A crystal is described by a repeating lattice together with a basis of atoms, ions or molecules placed at each lattice position. A unit cell is a convenient repeating region, and many cell choices can describe the same infinite structure. Count shared particles carefully: a corner contribution is shared among eight neighboring cubic cells, a face among two and an edge among four.

The number of particles per cell, their molar mass and the cell volume together predict density. Coordination number describes the local number of nearest neighbors and is different from the number of particles per cell. Packing efficiency compares occupied model-sphere volume with cell volume, but atoms are not literal hard marbles in every material.

Vacancies, interstitials and substitutional impurities disrupt the ideal arrangement and can carry charge or alter transport. Dislocations help explain plastic deformation, while grain boundaries separate differently oriented crystallites. A material’s chemical formula and perfect-cell diagram therefore do not determine every mechanical or electronic property.

Processing history, defect concentration, temperature and phase composition can be as important as the ideal crystal structure.
body.zh:
晶体可用重复点阵及放在各点阵位置的原子、离子或分子基元描述。晶胞是方便的重复区域，同一无限结构可选不同晶胞。共享粒子要正确计数：立方角点由八胞共享，面由两胞共享，棱由四胞共享。

每胞粒子数、摩尔质量与胞体积共同预测密度。配位数是局部最近邻数，不等于每胞粒子数。堆积效率比较模型球体积与胞体积，但真实原子并非处处都是硬弹珠。

空位、间隙与替位杂质扰动理想排列，可带电或改变输运。位错帮助解释塑性形变，晶界隔开取向不同的晶粒。因此化学式与完美晶胞图不能确定所有力学或电子性质，加工历史、缺陷浓度、温度和相组成可能同样重要。

body.en:
Organize an inorganic transformation by asking which structural features change. Ligand substitution replaces one coordinated donor with another; electron transfer changes oxidation state; atom transfer changes connectivity while possibly coupling to redox. In an associative substitution picture, the entering ligand participates before the leaving ligand fully departs, whereas a dissociative picture begins with ligand loss.

These labels describe limiting mechanisms, and actual pathways can lie between them. Rate dependence on entering-ligand concentration can help distinguish alternatives but should be combined with other evidence. Electron transfer may occur between species without a shared ligand bridge or through a bridging group; geometry and reorganization influence its rate.

The dominant dissolved species can change with pH, ligand concentration or oxidation conditions, so the substance named on a reagent bottle may not be the reacting species. Write material and charge balances, then consider equilibrium speciation before proposing an elementary step. A plausible product is not proof of a mechanism: transient intermediates, isotope tracing, rate laws and activation trends provide stronger discrimination among pathways.
body.zh:
分析无机变化先问哪些结构特征改变：配体取代更换给体，电子转移改变氧化态，原子转移改变连接并可能耦合氧化还原。缔合型取代中，进入配体先参与而离去配体尚未完全离开；解离型则先失配体。二者是极限机制，真实途径可介于其间。

速率对进入配体浓度的依赖可帮助区分，但应结合其他证据。电子转移可通过共同桥联配体，也可无桥进行，几何与重组影响速率。优势溶解物种随 pH、配体浓度和氧化条件变化，试剂瓶标签上的物质未必就是实际反应物种。

提出基元步骤前，应列物料与电荷守恒并考虑平衡分布。得到合理产物不能证明机理，短寿命中间体、同位素追踪、速率律和活化趋势更能区分竞争途径。

body.en:
A reaction rate describes how quickly composition changes, and the sign depends on whether a species is consumed or produced. For aA → bB, the normalized rate is −(1/a)d[A]/dt = (1/b)d[B]/dt when volume is fixed. An average rate uses a finite time interval; an instantaneous rate is the tangent slope of a concentration–time curve.

A rate law such as r = k[A]^m[B]^n is an experimentally testable model over stated conditions. The exponents m and n are orders and need not be integers; their sum is the overall order. To infer one exponent by initial rates, compare experiments where only that reactant concentration changes while temperature and other relevant variables remain fixed.

The ratio of rates then equals the concentration ratio raised to the unknown exponent. The rate constant’s units depend on overall order, so dimensional analysis can catch an inconsistent proposed law. Temperature usually changes k, while catalysts, surface area and transport limitations can change the observed behavior.

A concentration correlation alone does not establish a unique molecular mechanism, because several mechanisms can produce the same empirical law.
body.zh:
反应速率描述组成变化快慢，符号取决于物种被消耗还是生成。恒体积 aA → bB 中，归一速率为 −(1/a)d[A]/dt = (1/b)d[B]/dt。平均速率使用有限时间区间，瞬时速率是浓度—时间曲线切线斜率。

r = k[A]^m[B]^n 是规定条件下可实验检验的模型。m、n 为级数，不必为整数，和为总级数。初速法求某指数时，应比较只有该反应物浓度变化、温度及其他变量固定的实验，速率比等于浓度比的相应幂。

k 的单位依赖总级数，量纲检查可发现错误速率律。温度通常改变 k，催化、表面积和输运限制也可改变观测行为。浓度关系不能唯一确定分子机理，因为不同机理可产生相同经验速率律。

body.en:
An integrated rate law relates concentration directly to elapsed time by solving a differential rate equation. For zero-order disappearance, concentration decreases linearly until the model ceases to apply near depletion. For first order, the fraction lost per short interval is proportional to the fraction present, producing exponential decay.

Taking the natural logarithm gives ln[A] = ln[A]0 − kt, so an appropriate straight-line plot has slope −k. For a simple second-order single-reactant law, 1/[A] increases linearly instead. These plots provide diagnostics, but fitting transformed data can alter error weighting; residuals and the original measurement uncertainties still matter.

Half-life means the time required for the current amount to fall by one half. It is constant through successive intervals for a first-order process, but generally changes with concentration for other orders. A pseudo-first-order experiment keeps another reactant in large excess so its concentration changes negligibly; the observed constant then includes that reactant’s approximately fixed contribution.

Do not infer a mechanism solely because one transformed plot looks straight over a narrow range.
body.zh:
积分速率律通过解微分速率方程，把浓度直接与时间联系起来。零级消耗浓度线性下降，直到接近耗尽时模型可能失效。一级反应短时间损失比例与现有比例相关，产生指数衰减；取自然对数得 ln[A] = ln[A]0 − kt，直线斜率为 −k。

简单单反应物二级反应则是 1/[A] 随时间线性增加。这些图可诊断模型，但变换数据会改变误差权重，仍应检查残差与原测量不确定度。半衰期是当前量降至一半所需时间，一级过程连续半衰期相同，其他级数通常随浓度变化。

准一级实验使另一反应物大量过量，其浓度近似不变，观测常数因此包含该固定浓度的贡献。狭窄范围内某变换图看似直线，不能单独证明机理。

summary.en: A mechanism proposes elementary steps whose sum gives the overall reaction.

objectives.en: Describe Elementary step and its relationship to Intermediate.
objectives.zh: 说明基元步骤与中间体之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Activation barrier and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释活化势垒，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A balanced overall equation reports net chemical change but hides the molecular sequence. A mechanism proposes elementary events, each with a limited number of directly participating particles. Adding its steps must cancel intermediates and recover the observed overall equation.

Intermediates are produced in one step and consumed in another; a catalyst is consumed and subsequently regenerated, so it does not appear in the net equation. A transition state is different from an intermediate: it is a high-energy configuration along a reaction path, not a stable species that accumulates. Activation energy or activation free energy controls the sensitivity of rate to temperature and pathway.

A catalyst offers an alternative sequence with more accessible barriers; it does not change the starting and ending thermodynamic states. A proposed slow step can help derive a rate expression, but if it contains an unmeasured intermediate, additional equilibrium or steady-state reasoning is needed. The steady-state approximation says an intermediate’s production and consumption nearly balance after an initial transient; it does not mean the whole reaction is at equilibrium.

Mechanisms must be tested against rates, isotope effects, detected intermediates and other independent observations.
body.zh:
总方程只报告净变化，隐藏分子过程。机理提出直接参与粒子数有限的基元步骤，相加后应约去中间体并恢复总方程。中间体在一步生成、另一步消耗；催化剂先消耗后再生，因此不出现在净方程中。

过渡态不同于中间体，它是路径上的高能构型，不是能积累的稳定物种。活化能或活化自由能控制速率对温度及路径的敏感性。催化剂提供势垒更易跨越的替代序列，却不改变始末热力学状态。

慢步骤可帮助推导速率式，但若含未测中间体，还需平衡或稳态推理。稳态近似指初始暂态后，中间体生成和消耗近似平衡，并不意味着整个反应处于化学平衡。应以速率、同位素效应、检出的中间体及其他独立观察检验机理。

summary.en: Oxidation loses electrons and reduction gains them.
summary.zh: 氧化失电子，还原得电子。

objectives.en: Describe Oxidation state and its relationship to Half-reactions.

objectives.zh: 解释电子守恒，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Oxidation numbers are a systematic bookkeeping convention for electron assignment. In a neutral species their sum is zero, and in an ion the sum equals the ionic charge. Rules such as oxygen usually being −2 and hydrogen usually +1 have exceptions, so inspect peroxides, hydrides and unusual bonding rather than applying rules blindly.

An increase in oxidation number identifies oxidation; a decrease identifies reduction. For half-reaction balancing in acidic aqueous solution, balance non-hydrogen and non-oxygen atoms first, oxygen using water, hydrogen using H+, and finally charge using electrons. Multiply the half-reactions so electrons cancel before adding them.

For a basic medium, neutralize any introduced H+ by adding equal OH− to both sides and simplify water. Finally recount every element and the total charge. Electrons must not remain in the summed closed redox equation.

Oxygen transfer is a useful historical example of oxidation but is not the definition: metal-ion electron transfer can be redox without any oxygen. Oxidation-number changes describe electron bookkeeping and need not imply that each covalent atom carries an integer measured physical charge.
body.zh:
氧化数是系统化电子归属记账规则。中性物种总和为零，离子总和等于离子电荷。氧通常为 −2、氢通常为 +1，但过氧化物、氢化物及特殊成键有例外，不能机械套用。

氧化数升高表示氧化，降低表示还原。酸性水溶液半反应配平时，先配除氢氧外元素，再用水配氧、H+ 配氢、电子配电荷。倍乘使电子数相等后相加。

碱性介质中，用两侧等加 OH− 中和引入的 H+ 并化简水。最后复核所有元素和总电荷，完整闭合氧化还原式中不能残留电子。氧转移是历史上的典型氧化，但不是定义；金属离子电子转移无需氧也可为氧化还原。

氧化数变化属于电子记账，不意味着共价原子实际带整数电荷。

title.zh: 氧化数 · 半反应 · 电子守恒

body.en:
An electrochemical cell separates coupled oxidation and reduction so electron transfer can pass through an external circuit. Oxidation always occurs at the anode and reduction always at the cathode; these definitions survive when switching between galvanic and electrolytic operation. In a galvanic cell, spontaneous chemical change supplies electrical work.

In electrolysis, an external source drives a reaction against its spontaneous tendency. The polarity of an electrode therefore cannot be memorized independently of operating mode. Ionic movement in an electrolyte or salt bridge maintains bulk charge balance; electrons do not simply travel through the salt bridge as they do through a metal wire.

Tabulated standard electrode potentials are commonly reduction potentials. Calculate the standard cell potential by subtracting the anode reduction potential from the cathode reduction potential, without multiplying potentials when balancing electron counts. Potential is intensive; Gibbs-energy change scales with reaction amount through ΔG = −nFE.

A real cell under load also experiences internal resistance, concentration changes and electrode polarization. Material compatibility, products and competing electrode reactions determine practical behavior beyond the ideal voltage calculation.
body.zh:
电化学池分开相互耦合的氧化与还原，使电子经外电路传递。阳极始终氧化、阴极始终还原，这一定义在原电池与电解池间保持不变。原电池由自发化学变化输出电功，电解则由外电源驱动逆自发趋势的反应，因此不能脱离运行方式死记电极正负。

电解液或盐桥中的离子运动维持宏观电荷平衡，电子不会像在金属导线中那样穿过盐桥。表列标准电势通常为还原电势，电池标准电势等于阴极还原电势减阳极还原电势；配平电子时不能倍乘电势。电势是强度量，吉布斯能通过 ΔG = −nFE 随反应量缩放。

负载下真实电池还受内阻、浓度变化与极化影响，材料兼容、产物及竞争电极反应决定理想电压之外的实际表现。

title.zh: 能斯特方程与动力学区别

summary.en: The Nernst relation E = E° − RT lnQ/(nF) connects reversible potential with composition.
summary.zh: 能斯特关系 E = E° − RT lnQ/(nF) 联系可逆电势与组成。

objectives.en: Describe Concentration dependence and its relationship to Reaction quotient.

body.en:
The Nernst equation follows from combining composition-dependent reaction Gibbs energy with electrical work. For a reaction transferring n electrons, E = E° − (RT/nF)lnQ, using the same reaction direction and quotient convention as the tabulated standard potential. Pure solid and liquid activities often cancel, while dissolved-ion activities or gas pressures remain.

At equilibrium the reversible full-cell voltage is zero for the specified reaction, linking the standard voltage to the equilibrium constant. The electron count n scales the Gibbs-energy conversion, but multiplying a reaction does not multiply its potential because the quotient and electron count change consistently. A measured open-circuit voltage approximates a reversible potential only under suitable equilibration and negligible leakage.

Drawing current drives the system away from that limit. Ohmic resistance produces a voltage drop, while finite reaction rates require activation overpotential; concentration gradients create additional polarization. Thus thermodynamic favorability predicts a possible direction and maximum reversible work, not an operating current.

Interpreting a battery, corrosion process or electrolysis experiment requires combining Nernst thermodynamics with transport and electrode kinetics rather than treating voltage as a complete performance model.
body.zh:
能斯特方程由组成相关的反应吉布斯能与电功关系结合得到。转移 n 电子的反应满足 E = E° − (RT/nF)lnQ，方向与反应商约定须与标准电势一致。纯固液活度常约去，溶解离子活度或气体压强保留。

指定总反应平衡时，可逆全电池电压为零，从而联系标准电压与平衡常数。n 使吉布斯能转换缩放，但倍乘反应不倍乘电势，因为 Q 与 n 同步改变。开路实测电压只有在充分平衡、泄漏可忽略等条件下才近似可逆电势。

输出电流使系统偏离该极限：电阻造成压降，有限反应速率需活化过电位，浓度梯度另生极化。因此热力学只预测可能方向与最大可逆功，而非工作电流。分析电池、腐蚀或电解，必须结合能斯特热力学、输运与电极动力学。

objectives.en: Describe Enthalpy and its relationship to Calorimetry.

objectives.en: Explain Hess law and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释赫斯定律，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Separate the system from its surroundings before assigning a heat sign. Heat entering the system is positive; an exothermic reaction transfers heat outward and has negative enthalpy change under the usual constant-pressure conditions. Internal energy includes microscopic energy storage, whereas enthalpy adds the pressure–volume term needed for convenient constant-pressure accounting.

A calorimeter infers transferred heat from a measured temperature change using heat capacity. For a solution, q = mcΔT is an approximation requiring an appropriate specific heat and allowance for the container’s own heat capacity. The reacting system’s heat is opposite to the surroundings’ heat when other losses are negligible.

Hess’s law allows equations to be reversed, multiplied and added: reverse the enthalpy sign when reversing an equation and multiply the enthalpy when scaling its coefficients. Standard formation enthalpies describe forming one mole of a substance from elements in their specified reference states. Sum product coefficients times formation enthalpies and subtract the corresponding reactant sum.

Always retain phase labels: liquid water and water vapour have different enthalpies, so silently changing the phase changes the problem.
body.zh:
指定热量符号前先区分系统与环境。进入系统的热为正；通常恒压条件下，放热反应向外传热，焓变为负。内能描述微观储能，焓增加 pV 项，便于恒压核算。

量热计由温度变化与热容推断热量。溶液 q = mcΔT 是近似，需选合适比热并考虑容器热容；若其他损失可忽略，反应系统的热与环境的热互为相反数。赫斯定律允许方程反向、倍乘、相加：反向时焓变变号，倍乘系数时焓变也倍乘。

标准生成焓对应元素从指定参考态生成一摩尔物质。按系数求产物生成焓总和，再减反应物总和。相态标签必须保留，液态水与水蒸气焓不同，暗中换相态就是改变问题。

body.en: Enthalpy H = U + pV is a state function. At constant pressure with only pressure–volume work, heat equals enthalpy change. Hess’s law adds reaction enthalpies because state-function differences depend only on endpoints.

objectives.en: Describe Entropy and its relationship to Gibbs energy.

body.en:
Entropy measures how energy and matter can be distributed among compatible microscopic states; calling it disorder is at best an incomplete analogy. Melting, mixing and gas expansion often increase entropy because more configurations become accessible, but a complete calculation must consider the specific process. The second law constrains total entropy of system plus surroundings.

At constant temperature and pressure, Gibbs energy packages that total-entropy criterion into a system property. In ΔG = ΔH − TΔS, use kelvin and matching energy units. A reaction with positive enthalpy can still be favorable if the entropy term is sufficiently large.

Standard reaction Gibbs energy refers to specified standard activities, while actual reaction Gibbs energy depends on current composition through ΔG = ΔG° + RT ln Q. Equilibrium is reached when the reaction Gibbs-energy change becomes zero, not when the system’s total Gibbs energy is literally zero. Thermodynamic favorability gives a direction under stated constraints; activation barriers can make a favorable transformation extremely slow.

Diamonds and combustible fuels illustrate why a driving force and a kinetic pathway must be considered separately.
body.zh:
熵衡量能量和物质在相容微观态间分配的可能性，“混乱度”最多是不完整类比。熔化、混合和气体膨胀常使可及构型增加，但完整计算须针对具体过程。第二定律约束系统加环境的总熵。

恒温恒压下，吉布斯能把总熵判据转化为系统性质。ΔG = ΔH − TΔS 中须用开尔文及匹配的能量单位。焓变为正的反应，若熵项足够大，仍可有利。

标准反应吉布斯能对应标准活度，实际值则通过 ΔG = ΔG° + RT ln Q 依赖组成。平衡意味着反应吉布斯能变为零，不是系统总吉布斯能数值为零。热力学给出指定约束下的方向，但活化势垒可使有利变化极慢，因此驱动力与动力学途径必须分别考虑。

body.en:
A reversible reaction can proceed in both directions while its macroscopic composition remains constant. At equilibrium the two rates match; individual molecules continue to react. For a reaction aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD, the reaction quotient uses product activities raised to c and d divided by reactant activities raised to a and b.

Activities are dimensionless effective concentrations relative to standard states. Concentrations or partial pressures can approximate them in suitable dilute or ideal conditions. Pure condensed phases usually have unit activity while present, which is why their amounts do not appear explicitly in the simplest equilibrium expression.

Changing a reaction’s direction inverts K; multiplying all coefficients by a factor raises K to that factor. At a fixed temperature K is a property of the specified reaction, while Q changes as composition changes. Adding a reactant can therefore change Q without changing K.

A catalyst accelerates approach in both directions but does not alter the equilibrium constant. Temperature changes can change K, and pressure changes influence gas equilibria through composition and volume rather than a universal rule that every reaction shifts the same way.
body.zh:
可逆反应可持续双向进行，而宏观组成保持恒定。平衡时正逆速率相等，分子仍在反应。对 aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD，反应商为产物活度按系数乘方之积，除以反应物对应之积。

活度是相对标准态的无量纲有效浓度；合适稀溶液或理想条件下可用浓度或分压近似。纯凝聚相存在时通常取单位活度，因此其量不显式出现。反向反应使 K 取倒数，全部系数乘某因子则 K 乘相应幂。

温度固定时，K 属于指定反应，而 Q 随组成改变；加反应物可改变 Q 而不改变 K。催化剂加速两个方向接近平衡，不改变 K。温度可改变 K，压强通过气体组成与体积影响平衡，不能机械认为所有反应都朝同一方向移动。

body.en: The reaction quotient Q uses current activities with stoichiometric exponents. At equilibrium Q = K. If Q < K, forward change is favored until equilibrium is approached; pure solid activities are normally one.
body.zh: 反应商 Q 用当前活度及计量指数计算，平衡时 Q = K。Q < K 时正向变化有利；通常纯固体活度为一。

summary.en: A Brønsted acid donates a proton and a base accepts one.
summary.zh: 布朗斯特酸供出质子，碱接受质子。

objectives.en: Describe Proton transfer and its relationship to Dissociation constants.
objectives.zh: 说明质子转移与解离常数之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Buffer action and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释缓冲作用，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Acid and base labels describe a reaction role. A Brønsted acid donates H+ to a base, producing its conjugate base and the base’s conjugate acid. Water can play either role.

For a weak acid HA, Ka describes HA + H2O ⇌ H3O+ + A− with water activity absorbed into the convention. A smaller pKa means a larger Ka and a stronger acid under comparable conditions. Strong and weak refer to dissociation tendency; concentrated and dilute refer to amount per volume.

The pH definition uses hydrogen-ion activity, so the familiar negative logarithm of concentration is an ideal dilute approximation. A buffer contains appreciable amounts of a weak acid and its conjugate base. Added acid is consumed mainly by the base component, while added base consumes the acid component.

The Henderson–Hasselbalch relation connects pH to pKa and the conjugate-pair activity ratio, but it presumes the relevant equilibrium description is valid. Buffer capacity is finite: near exhaustion of one component, a small addition can cause a large pH change. A titration equivalence point concerns stoichiometric consumption and is not automatically pH seven.
body.zh:
酸碱标签描述反应角色。布朗斯特酸向碱供出 H+，生成其共轭碱与原碱的共轭酸；水可扮演任一角色。弱酸 HA 的 Ka 描述 HA + H2O ⇌ H3O+ + A−，水活度吸收到约定中。

可比条件下，pKa 越小、Ka 越大、酸越强。强弱描述解离倾向，浓稀描述单位体积含量。pH 严格使用氢离子活度，浓度负对数是理想稀溶液近似。

缓冲液含显著量弱酸及其共轭碱；加酸主要被碱组分消耗，加碱主要消耗酸组分。亨德森—哈塞尔巴尔赫关系联系 pH、pKa 与共轭对活度比，但需相关平衡模型成立。缓冲容量有限，一种组分接近耗尽时，少量加入就可导致大幅 pH 改变。

滴定等当点表示计量消耗完成，并不自动等于 pH 七。

summary.en: A solubility product describes ion activities at equilibrium with a solid.
summary.zh: 溶度积描述与固体平衡的离子活度。

objectives.en: Describe Solubility product and its relationship to Ion product.

objectives.en: Explain Complex formation and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释配合物形成，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Solubility is a total dissolved amount under specified conditions, whereas a solubility product is an equilibrium constant written in terms of particular free-ion activities. For a salt producing unequal numbers of ions, the stoichiometric powers matter: AB2 gives a product involving one A activity and the square of B activity. In pure water with no other reactions, those activities can sometimes be related directly to a single molar-solubility variable.

A common ion changes the starting composition and usually suppresses dissolution in the simple model, so the pure-water square-root shortcut is no longer valid. Compare the current ion product with Ksp to predict whether a solution is undersaturated, saturated or thermodynamically supersaturated. Nucleation barriers can delay visible precipitation even when it is favorable.

Ligands form complexes with metal ions and reduce the free-ion activity at a given total metal concentration. This can drive additional solid dissolution. Acid–base reactions may similarly remove a dissolved ion, coupling pH and solubility.

Distinguish free metal, complexed metal and total dissolved metal, and use material balances to connect them.
body.zh:
溶解度是在指定条件下的总溶解量，溶度积则是用特定游离离子活度写成的平衡常数。若盐释放不等数目的离子，计量指数重要，例如 AB2 的离子积包含 A 活度一次方及 B 活度平方。纯水且无其他反应时，可把活度与单一溶解度变量联系。

加入共同离子改变初组成，在简单模型中通常抑制溶解，因此纯水平方根捷径不再适用。比较当前离子积与 Ksp，可判断未饱和、饱和或热力学过饱和；即使沉淀有利，成核势垒仍可延迟可见沉淀。配体络合金属会在给定总金属浓度下降低游离活度，驱动更多固体溶解。

酸碱反应也可移除某溶解离子，将 pH 与溶解度耦合。必须区分游离、配合及总溶解金属，并通过物料守恒连接。

body.en: A solubility product describes ion activities at equilibrium with a solid. Precipitation is favored when the ion product exceeds Ksp. Complexation can lower free-metal activity and thereby increase total dissolved metal.

body.en:

Ksp = s²; s = √(4×10^-6) = 0.002 mol/L.

summary.en: Multiple equilibria share species and must satisfy equilibrium relations together with total-material and charge balances.
summary.zh: 多个平衡共享物种，必须同时满足平衡关系、总物料守恒与电荷守恒。

objectives.en: Describe Mass balance and its relationship to Charge balance.
objectives.zh: 说明物料守恒与电荷守恒之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Approximation validity and identify the conditions behind the example.

body.en:
A coupled-equilibrium problem cannot usually be solved by treating every reaction as if the others did not exist. List the chemically distinct species first, then write independent equilibrium relations and analytical totals. A material balance counts each conserved element or component across all its species; a charge balance sums positive and negative ionic charge in the bulk solution.

Water autoionization may need inclusion when acid or base concentrations are very small. Choose unknowns that reduce redundancy, such as free hydrogen-ion concentration and free ligand concentration, and express other species through equilibrium ratios. Approximations are hypotheses: neglecting a dissociated amount against the starting concentration must be checked after obtaining the tentative result.

The common five-percent criterion is a rough classroom tolerance, not a universal scientific law. When it fails, retain the term and solve the resulting quadratic or numerical system. Also check positivity, conservation totals and whether the assumed dominant species actually dominates.

A mathematically real root can be physically impossible if it implies negative concentration or consumes more material than was available.
body.zh:
耦合平衡不能通常把每个反应当作其他反应不存在来解。先列不同物种，再写独立平衡关系与分析总量。物料守恒在所有物种中计数每个保守元素或组分，电荷守恒则平衡溶液正负离子电荷。

酸碱极稀时，须计入水自解离。可选择游离氢离子或配体浓度为未知量，通过平衡比表达其他物种，以减少冗余。近似是待检验假设：忽略解离量相对于初浓度，必须求出试算值后检查。

常见百分之五规则只是课堂粗略容差，不是普适科学定律。若不满足，应保留该项并解二次或数值方程。还须检查浓度非负、总量守恒以及假定优势物种是否真占优。

数学实根若给出负浓度或消耗量超过库存，便不具物理意义。

summary.en: An element contains one atomic-number type; a compound has chemically bonded elements in a characteristic composition.
summary.zh: 元素由同一原子序数类型构成，化合物由元素按特定组成化学结合而成。

objectives.en: Describe Elements and compounds and its relationship to Mixtures.
objectives.zh: 说明元素与化合物与混合物之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Physical separation and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释物理分离，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A substance has a reproducible chemical identity; its physical state may still change. Ice, liquid water and water vapour all contain H2O, whereas hydrogen peroxide contains different molecules and is a different substance. An element is defined by proton number, not by whether it appears as single atoms: oxygen gas commonly contains O2 molecules but is still an element.

A compound has constituent atoms chemically combined, so separating it into elements requires chemical change. Mixtures can have variable composition: salty water can be dilute or concentrated without creating a new compound. A homogeneous mixture looks uniform at the chosen scale; a suspension contains distinguishable dispersed material.

Physical separation exploits a property difference. Filtration retains particles too large for pores but does not remove dissolved ions. Distillation uses volatility differences, and chromatography uses different affinities for moving and stationary phases.

Select the method from particle size, solubility or volatility, rather than from the colour of the sample. A separation can fail when the relevant properties are too similar or when heating changes the substances chemically.
body.zh:
物质具有可重复的化学身份，但物态可以变化。冰、液态水和水蒸气都含 H2O；过氧化氢具有不同分子，是另一种物质。元素由质子数定义，不取决于是否以单原子存在；氧气通常含 O2 分子，仍是元素单质。

化合物中原子发生化学结合，拆成元素需要化学变化。混合物组成可变，盐水变浓或变稀不意味着产生新化合物。均相混合物在选定尺度上均匀，悬浊液则有可区分的分散物。

物理分离利用性质差异：过滤截留大于孔径的颗粒，却不能去除溶解离子；蒸馏利用挥发性差异，色谱利用对流动相与固定相的亲和差异。应根据粒径、溶解度或挥发性选择方法，而非只凭颜色。当性质过于相似，或加热引发化学变化时，分离方法可能失败。

body.en:
Chemical amounts require three distinct levels: the mass of one microscopic entity, a count of entities, and the mass of a macroscopic sample. Relative atomic mass compares an atom with one twelfth of the carbon-12 atomic mass; it is dimensionless. Molar mass instead has units such as grams per mole.

Isotopes share proton number but differ in neutron number, so a natural sample can contain atoms with different masses. A tabulated average is the abundance-weighted mean, not the mass of a special average isotope. The mole is a counting unit like a dozen but vastly larger.

Always specify atoms, molecules, ions or formula units. The molar mass of H2O is obtained by adding two hydrogen contributions and one oxygen contribution. To find elemental mass percentage, divide the element’s total mass contribution in one formula amount by the compound’s molar mass.

Conversely, empirical formulas follow by converting each elemental mass to moles, dividing by the smallest amount and seeking a simple whole-number ratio. An empirical formula gives a ratio; a molecular formula additionally needs molecular molar mass.
body.zh:
化学计量应区分单个微观实体质量、实体个数和宏观样品质量。相对原子质量以碳-12 原子质量的十二分之一为基准，是无量纲比值；摩尔质量则有 g/mol 等单位。同位素质子数相同、中子数不同，自然样品可能混有不同质量原子。

表列平均值是丰度加权平均，不代表一种特殊“平均同位素”。摩尔像打一样是计数单位，但数量巨大，必须指定原子、分子、离子或化学式单元。H2O 摩尔质量由两个氢和一个氧的贡献相加得到。

元素质量百分比等于一个化学式量中该元素的质量贡献除以化合物摩尔质量。反求实验式时，先把各元素质量换成摩尔数，再除以最小值，寻找简单整数比。实验式只给比例，分子式还需要分子摩尔质量。

summary.en: Balance equations by changing coefficients, never the formulas of participating species.
summary.zh: 配平时改变系数，不能改变参与物种的化学式。

objectives.en: Describe Atom balance and its relationship to Stoichiometric coefficients.

body.en:
A chemical equation states which species disappear and appear, along with their relative amounts. The formula of each species records its identity; changing a subscript changes that identity. Balancing therefore changes only the multipliers placed before formulas.

Start by listing the number of atoms of each element on both sides. Choose coefficients so each inventory agrees, then reduce to the smallest convenient whole-number set. For ions, perform a separate charge count: conserving atoms alone is insufficient.

State symbols such as solid, liquid, gas and aqueous distinguish phases and help determine whether a net ionic reaction occurs. In a net ionic equation, spectator ions that remain unchanged on both sides are removed. Coefficients describe amount ratios, not mass ratios; equal coefficients can correspond to very different masses because molar masses differ.

They also do not generally give a rate law: a reaction may occur through several hidden steps. In stoichiometric calculations, convert the supplied mass or concentration into amount first, apply the coefficient ratio, and only then convert to the requested final quantity.
body.zh:
化学方程说明哪些物种消失、哪些出现，以及相对数量。化学式记录物种身份，改变下标就改变物质，因此配平只改化学式前的系数。先列两侧各元素原子数，再选择系数使每项库存一致，最后化为方便的最简整数比。

离子反应还需独立计算总电荷，仅原子守恒不够。固、液、气、水溶液等状态符号区分相态，并帮助判断净离子反应。净离子方程中可约去两侧不变的旁观离子。

计量系数给物质的量比而非质量比，因为摩尔质量不同。系数通常也不能直接给速率定律，反应可能经历多个隐藏步骤。计算时先把给定质量或浓度转换为物质的量，使用系数比，再转为目标量。

body.en:
A balanced reaction can be imagined as a recipe applied repeatedly. If a recipe consumes two units of A for every one unit of B, three units of A cannot consume three units of B completely. Define a trial reaction extent by dividing each available reactant amount by the number of units it consumes per recipe.

The smallest value limits how many complete recipe units can occur. Multiply that extent by each product coefficient to obtain the theoretical amount, assuming the stated reaction goes to completion with no competing reaction. Remaining excess reactant equals its initial amount minus the coefficient times the extent.

Actual product may be lower because of incomplete reaction, side reactions, transfer losses or purification losses. Percentage yield compares an actual isolated amount with the theoretical amount on the same mass or mole basis. A value above one hundred percent often indicates wet or impure product, an incorrect assumed composition, or measurement error.

It is a reason to investigate the calculation and sample, not evidence that atom conservation failed.
body.zh:
配平方程可以看作反复使用的配方。若每份反应消耗两份 A 和一份 B，三份 A 不可能完全消耗三份 B。将各反应物初始物质的量除以其计量系数，最小值限制可进行的反应份数，即反应进度。

用该值乘产物系数得到理论产量，前提是所述反应完成且无竞争反应。过量试剂剩余量为初始量减去系数乘反应进度。实际产量可因未完全反应、副反应、转移或纯化损失而降低。

百分产率应在相同质量或摩尔基准上比较实际分离量与理论量。超过百分之百通常提示产物潮湿、不纯、组成假设错误或测量误差，应检查样品与计算，而不是认为原子守恒失效。

body.en: Compare initial amounts divided by stoichiometric coefficients to identify the limiting reagent. The smallest ratio sets maximum reaction extent. Actual isolated product divided by theoretical product defines fractional yield.
body.zh: 把初始物质的量除以计量系数并比较，最小比值确定限量试剂及最大反应进度。实际分离产物量除以理论产物量得到产率。

body.en:
A solution is a single phase containing a solvent and one or more dissolved solutes. Dissolution distributes particles through the solvent; it does not mean the particles have disappeared. Molarity is an amount concentration and depends on total solution volume, so temperature-driven expansion can change molarity even when solute amount remains fixed.

Mass fraction uses masses and is less directly sensitive to such volume changes. Molality uses moles per kilogram of solvent and must not be confused with molarity. To prepare a specified solution, determine the required solute amount, convert to mass if appropriate, dissolve it in less than the final volume, and then adjust the final solution volume.

The equation c1V1 = c2V2 is an amount balance, not an independent law of liquids. It requires the same conserved solute and no reaction or loss. Mixing different reacting solutions requires stoichiometric accounting before a final concentration is reported.

Keep volume units consistent within a ratio and convert to litres when multiplying a concentration expressed per litre to obtain moles.
body.zh:
溶液是溶剂与一种或多种溶质构成的单一相。溶解使粒子分散在溶剂中，并不是粒子消失。物质的量浓度使用溶液总体积，温度引起体积膨胀时，即使溶质量不变，浓度也会改变。

质量分数用质量，较少直接受体积变化影响。质量摩尔浓度用每千克溶剂中的摩尔数，不能与物质的量浓度混淆。配液时先确定所需溶质量，必要时换算为质量，先溶于少于终体积的溶剂，再定容。

c1V1 = c2V2 是物质的量守恒关系，要求同一溶质不反应也不损失。混合能反应的溶液时，应先做计量核算，再报告终浓度。比值中的体积单位要一致；若浓度单位为每升，乘体积求摩尔数时需使用升。

title.zh: 物质的量浓度 · 稀释 · 溶液体积

body.en: Molarity is dissolved amount per solution volume, usually mol/L. Dilution conserves solute amount when none reacts or is lost, so c1V1 = c2V2. Final solution volume is not always the sum of component volumes.
body.zh: 物质的量浓度为溶质物质的量除以溶液体积，常用 mol/L。无反应且无损失时，稀释保持溶质量不变，因此 c1V1 = c2V2。最终溶液体积不一定等于组分体积之和。

body.en:
Dilute 100 mL of 2 mol/L solution to 400 mL. Find final concentration in mol/L.

c2 = c1V1/V2 = 2 × 100/400 = 0.5 mol/L.
body.zh:

body.en:
Gas pressure results from particle momentum transfer to container walls. Increasing particle amount at fixed temperature and volume increases collision frequency and hence pressure in the ideal model. Increasing absolute temperature raises the typical particle kinetic energy, while increasing volume reduces the collision rate per area.

The ideal equation combines these trends with a proportionality constant R whose numerical value depends on the chosen pressure and volume units. Never mix a value of R in litre atmospheres with pressures in pascals without conversion. An ideal mixture treats each component as if it occupied the full container independently at the same temperature.

Its partial pressure is therefore proportional to its mole fraction, and summing all partial pressures returns the total. Gas collected over water includes water vapour; subtract the appropriate vapour pressure before attributing all pressure to the desired gas. At high density, finite molecular volume and intermolecular attractions become important.

Near condensation, the ideal approximation can fail dramatically, so always identify temperature, pressure and phase before using a simple gas calculation.
body.zh:
气体压强源于粒子向容器壁传递动量。理想模型中，温度与体积不变时粒子数增加，碰撞频率和压强增加；绝对温度升高增加典型粒子动能，体积增大则减少单位面积碰撞率。理想气体方程把这些趋势结合，R 的数值取决于压强与体积单位。

不能把以 L·atm 为单位的 R 与 Pa 压强未经换算混用。理想混合物中，每种组分都视为在同温下独立占满容器，因此分压与摩尔分数成正比，分压之和为总压。排水集气含水蒸气，应先减去对应蒸气压，不能把总压都归给目标气体。

高密度下，分子有限体积和吸引力变得重要；接近冷凝时理想近似可严重失效，列式前应识别温度、压强和相态。

body.en:
Rutherford-type scattering showed that most atomic volume does not contain concentrated positive mass: most fast projectiles pass through, while a small fraction undergo large deflections near a compact nucleus. Nuclear proton number identifies the element, and neutron number distinguishes isotopes. Electron number determines ionic charge together with proton number.

The classical picture of an orbiting charge cannot account for stable atomic spectra. In the quantum description, an orbital is a state with a spatial probability distribution and allowed energy. Principal shells contain subshells with different angular structure; each spatial orbital permits two electrons with opposite spin labels.

The Pauli principle forbids two identical electrons from occupying the same complete state. Hund’s rule favors separate occupation of equal-energy orbitals before pairing in the introductory ground-state model. Aufbau ordering is a useful construction rule, but closely spaced levels cause exceptions, especially for transition elements and ions.

An emitted photon carries the difference between two levels, so separate spectral lines provide evidence of energy differences. A line does not reveal an electron’s classical circular path.
body.zh:
卢瑟福式散射表明，原子大部分体积中没有集中正电质量：多数高速粒子直接穿过，少数靠近紧凑原子核时发生大角偏转。质子数识别元素，中子数区分同位素，电子数与质子数共同决定离子电荷。经典绕核运动不能解释稳定原子光谱。

量子描述中，轨道是具有空间概率分布和允许能量的态。主电子层包含角结构不同的亚层，每个空间轨道可容纳两个自旋标签相反的电子。泡利原理禁止电子占据同一完整状态，洪特规则在入门基态模型中使等能轨道先单独占据再配对。

构造原理是实用规则，但能级接近会造成例外，尤其在过渡元素与离子中。发射光子的能量等于两个能级差，离散谱线由此提供能量差证据，并不揭示电子经典圆轨道。

body.en:
Periodic organization follows the repeating pattern of valence-electron configurations. Elements in a group often show related chemistry because their outer-electron patterns resemble one another, although extra shells change size and shielding. Moving down a group generally adds a shell, placing outer electrons farther from the nucleus.

Moving across a period adds protons while electrons enter the same principal shell, so the effective attraction commonly rises. Atomic radius is not a uniquely sharp boundary; covalent, metallic and van der Waals radii are operational definitions obtained in different contexts. Ionization energy is the energy required to remove an electron from a gaseous species.

Successive ionizations become harder, and a large jump can reveal removal from a filled inner shell. Electron affinity concerns adding an electron and has sign conventions that must be checked. Electronegativity describes attraction to shared electron density within a bond, not an isolated-atom radius or charge.

Subshell energies, electron pairing and imperfect shielding create important exceptions to simple trends, so explain a comparison mechanistically instead of memorizing arrows alone.
body.zh:
周期组织来自价电子排布的重复。同族元素外层模式相似，常有相近化学性质，但新增电子层会改变大小与屏蔽。沿族向下通常增加电子层，外层电子离核更远；沿周期增加质子而电子仍进入相同主层，有效吸引通常加强。

原子半径并非唯一锐利边界，共价、金属和范德华半径是在不同情境中定义的操作量。电离能是从气态物种移去电子所需能量。连续电离越来越困难，大跃升可提示开始移除内层电子。

电子亲和能涉及加入电子，应检查符号约定；电负性描述成键时对共享电子密度的吸引，不等同孤立原子半径或电荷。亚层能量、电子配对与不完全屏蔽造成趋势例外，因此应解释机理，而非只背箭头。

body.en:
Chemical bonding reflects a lower total energy for some arrangements of nuclei and electrons than for the corresponding separated species. Attraction alone is insufficient: at very short separations, repulsion raises the energy and establishes an equilibrium bond distance. In an ionic lattice, each ion interacts with many surrounding ions, so one should not picture sodium chloride as isolated NaCl pairs.

Charge magnitude and ionic separation influence electrostatic lattice stabilization. A covalent description emphasizes shared electron density between nuclei, with single, double and triple bonds representing different idealized shared-electron patterns. A coordinate bond denotes a bookkeeping origin for the shared pair; after formation it is not a fundamentally different force.

Metallic bonding describes electrons distributed through a lattice, helping explain electrical conduction and the ability of layers to slide without destroying every bond. Electronegativity differences shift electron density continuously, so ionic and covalent labels are useful limits rather than rigid categories. Lewis structures track valence electrons and formal charges; formal charge is a bookkeeping assignment and should not automatically be interpreted as a measured atomic charge.

电荷大小与离子间距影响晶格静电稳定。共价描述强调核间共享电子密度，单、双、三键表示不同理想共享模式。配位键只说明共享电子对的记账来源，形成后不是另一种基本力。

金属键中电子遍布晶格，可帮助解释导电及晶层滑移时不至于破坏所有键。电负性差连续改变电子密度，离子和共价是有用极限而非硬类别。路易斯结构记录价电子与形式电荷，形式电荷是记账量，不应自动视为测得的原子真实电荷。

summary.zh: 电子域排斥提供初步几何模型。

objectives.en: Describe Electron domains and its relationship to Molecular shape.

body.en:
Molecular shape begins with connectivity: identify which atoms are joined before counting electron domains around a chosen central atom. In the basic VSEPR model, each single, double or triple bond counts as one directional domain, while each lone pair counts as another. Two domains favor a linear arrangement, three a trigonal planar arrangement and four a tetrahedral arrangement.

Molecular geometry names the positions of atoms rather than all electron domains, so four domains with one lone pair give a trigonal pyramidal molecule, not a tetrahedral molecular shape. Lone pairs and multiple bonds can shift angles away from ideal values because their electron distributions differ. A bond dipole combines magnitude and direction; determine molecular polarity by adding these dipoles as vectors in the actual geometry.

Linear carbon dioxide can have polar bonds whose dipoles cancel, whereas bent water does not have that cancellation. Symmetry is therefore as important as electronegativity. VSEPR is an introductory predictive model, not a universal quantitative theory: delocalization, transition-metal coordination and electronic-state changes may require orbital-based explanations or experimental structure data.
body.zh:
分子构型先从连接关系开始：先确定哪些原子相连，再数中心原子周围电子域。基础 VSEPR 模型中，单、双、三键各算一个方向性电子域，每对孤电子对另算一个。两个域倾向直线，三个域倾向平面三角形，四个域倾向四面体。

分子构型命名只看原子位置，所以四个域中含一对孤电子对时为三角锥形，而非四面体分子构型。孤电子对与多重键的电子分布不同，会使键角偏离理想值。键偶极有大小和方向，应按实际构型作矢量叠加判断分子极性。

直线 CO2 的极性键偶极可抵消，弯曲水分子则不能；对称性与电负性同样重要。VSEPR 是入门预测模型，不是普遍定量理论，离域、过渡金属配位与电子态变化可能需要轨道解释或实验结构。

summary.en: All atoms and molecules exhibit dispersion interactions from correlated charge fluctuations.
summary.zh: 所有原子分子都有由关联电荷涨落产生的色散作用。

objectives.en: Describe Dispersion and its relationship to Dipole interactions.

objectives.en: Explain Hydrogen bonding and identify the conditions behind the example.

body.en:
Intermolecular forces act between molecules and must be distinguished from the bonds that hold each molecule together. London dispersion arises because instantaneous charge fluctuations in one species correlate with fluctuations in another. Greater polarizability and favorable contact area often strengthen dispersion, which exists even in nonpolar substances.

Permanent molecular dipoles add interactions whose strengths depend on orientation and separation. Hydrogen bonding is a directional interaction involving a hydrogen attached to an appropriate electronegative donor and an available acceptor; merely containing hydrogen is insufficient. These interactions collectively influence boiling point, viscosity, surface tension, solubility and crystal packing.

A higher boiling point can indicate stronger effective cohesion, but molecular size, shape and phase structure must also be considered. Dissolution involves replacing solute–solute and solvent–solvent interactions with solute–solvent interactions, together with entropy changes, so “like dissolves like” is only a heuristic. A solid’s properties may instead be dominated by a covalent network, ionic lattice or metallic electrons.

Always identify the structural level before using the phrase weak intermolecular force to explain a material.
body.zh:
分子间作用与分子内部化学键必须区分。伦敦色散源于不同物种瞬时电荷涨落的关联；可极化性更大、接触面积更有利时，作用常更强，非极性物质也有色散力。永久偶极增加依赖取向与距离的相互作用。

氢键是有方向性的作用，需要氢连接适当电负性供体，并有可用受体，仅含氢并不足够。这些作用共同影响沸点、黏度、表面张力、溶解度和晶体堆积。较高沸点可提示更强内聚，但还须考虑大小、形状和相结构。

溶解把溶质—溶质、溶剂—溶剂作用替换为溶质—溶剂作用，同时涉及熵变，因此“相似相溶”只是经验指导。有些固体性质主要由共价网络、离子晶格或金属电子决定。解释材料时应先明确结构层次，不能一律归于弱分子间作用。

title.zh: 原子轨道与分子轨道入门

summary.en: Atomic orbitals combine into molecular orbitals with different energies and spatial distributions.
summary.zh: 原子轨道组合为能量与空间分布不同的分子轨道。

objectives.en: Describe Orbital overlap and its relationship to Bonding and antibonding.

objectives.en: Explain Bond order and identify the conditions behind the example.

body.en:
An atomic orbital describes an allowed one-electron spatial state associated with an atom. When atoms approach, compatible orbital combinations extend over more than one nucleus. Constructive combination can increase electron density between nuclei and lower energy, producing a bonding molecular orbital; destructive combination introduces a node and often raises energy, producing an antibonding orbital.

The number of molecular orbitals formed equals the number of atomic orbitals combined in the chosen basis. Fill the resulting states according to their energies, Pauli exclusion and the applicable spin rules. The introductory bond-order expression counts bonding electrons minus antibonding electrons, divided by two.

It summarizes net stabilization in simple cases but does not replace a complete energy calculation. Unpaired electrons imply paramagnetic behavior, which can distinguish molecular-orbital predictions from overly simple Lewis pictures, as in oxygen. Sigma orbitals have symmetry around the bond axis, while pi orbitals have a nodal plane containing that axis.

Orbital diagrams are model representations rather than photographs, and their ordering can depend on the atoms involved; copying one ordering indiscriminately across all molecules can give incorrect conclusions.
body.zh:
原子轨道描述与原子相关的允许单电子空间态。原子接近时，相容轨道组合可延伸到多个核。相长组合能增加核间电子密度并降低能量，形成成键轨道；相消组合引入节点，常抬高能量，形成反键轨道。

在选定基组中，形成的分子轨道数等于参与组合的原子轨道数。按能量、泡利原理与适用自旋规则填充。入门键级公式为成键电子数减反键电子数再除二，它概括简单情形的净稳定，但不能代替完整能量计算。

未成对电子意味着顺磁性，可区分分子轨道预测与过度简化路易斯图，如氧气。σ 轨道绕键轴对称，π 轨道有包含键轴的节点平面。轨道图是模型而非照片，其能量顺序依原子种类变化，不能把一张排序无差别套给所有分子。

summary.en: Generalized coordinates independently specify a configuration.
summary.zh: 广义坐标独立确定构型。

objectives.en: Describe Degrees of freedom and its relationship to Holonomic constraints.
objectives.zh: 说明自由度与完整约束之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Generalized coordinates and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释广义坐标，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A mechanical configuration is the collection of positions needed to specify a system at one instant. Cartesian coordinates are convenient but can include redundant variables when motion is constrained. A rigid pendulum bob moving in a plane has two Cartesian coordinates but one fixed-length relation, leaving one independent positional degree of freedom.

Its angle is a generalized coordinate that automatically respects the constraint. Generalized coordinates may be lengths, angles or other parameters, and their associated generalized forces have corresponding units. A holonomic constraint can be written as a relation among coordinates and possibly time; some velocity constraints cannot be reduced to this form and need additional treatment.

Constraints may be time independent or externally driven, changing the energy accounting. Choose coordinates that describe the allowed configurations without singularities in the region of interest. Then express kinetic and potential energy in those variables rather than assuming the Cartesian kinetic-energy form remains unchanged.

Constraint forces can disappear from the reduced equations when they do no virtual work along allowed variations, but this is an assumption to verify. Counting equations without checking independence can overestimate the number of constraints or leave hidden degrees of freedom.
body.zh:
构型是某时刻确定系统所需位置集合，笛卡尔坐标方便却在约束下冗余。平面刚摆球有两坐标和固定长关系，因此一个独立位置自由度，可用角自动满足约束。广义坐标可长度、角或其他参数，广义力单位相应变化。

完整约束可写坐标及可能时间关系，某些速度约束不能化成此式，需额外处理。约束可定常或外驱，影响能量。选坐标应描述允许构型且在研究区无奇点，再以其表达动势能，不能保留笛卡尔动能形式不变。

约束力若对允许虚位移不做虚功，可在约化方程消失，但须验证。只数方程而不查独立性，会错计约束或藏自由度。

body.en: Generalized coordinates independently specify a configuration. A holonomic constraint restricts positions through an equation; choosing coordinates on that constraint can eliminate unknown reaction forces.
body.zh: 广义坐标独立确定构型。完整约束通过位置方程限制运动；沿约束选择坐标可消去未知约束反力。
