body.en:
The ideal-gas model treats molecules as particles whose own volume is negligible compared with the container and whose interactions matter mainly during brief collisions. Pressure arises from momentum transfer to the walls, so more frequent or more forceful collisions raise pressure. In classical equilibrium, temperature is proportional to mean translational kinetic energy, not to every molecule having exactly the same speed.

Molecules follow a distribution of speeds, and heavier particles have lower typical speeds at the same temperature. Combining microscopic reasoning with amount counting gives pV = nRT, where n is measured in moles and R must match the pressure and volume units. The equation links state variables but does not specify the path taken between states.

Holding temperature fixed gives an inverse pressure–volume relation; holding volume fixed makes pressure proportional to absolute temperature. Real gases deviate when density is high or temperature is near condensation because excluded volume and attractive interactions become important. Internal energy can also include rotational and vibrational modes, so the monatomic translational model does not automatically describe every gas’s heat capacity.

State the particle and energy assumptions before using its formulas.
body.zh:
理想气体把分子自身体积视为相对容器可忽略，相互作用主要在短碰撞。压强来自向壁传动量，碰撞更频繁或更强会增压。经典平衡下温度正比平均平动动能，不是每分子速率一样；速率有分布，同温重粒子典型速率较低。

微观推理结合计数得 pV = nRT，n 用 mol，R 要匹配压强体积单位。状态方程联系变量，不指定状态间路径。恒温给压体反比，恒容给压强正比绝对温度。

高密度或近冷凝时，排除体积与吸引使真实气体偏离。内能还可含转动振动，因此单原子平动模型不能自动描述所有气体热容，列式前须说明粒子和能量假设。

title.en: Heat, work and the first law

summary.en: Heat is energy transferred because of a temperature difference.
summary.zh: 热是由温差引起的能量传递。

objectives.en: Describe Heat transfer and its relationship to Work.
objectives.zh: 说明热传递与功之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Internal energy and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释内能，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
The first law is energy conservation applied to a thermodynamic system. Define the boundary and sign convention before calculating: here Q is heat entering the system and W is work done by the system, so ΔU = Q − W. Internal energy U is a state function, meaning its change depends on the initial and final states.

Heat and work are transfers along a process and therefore are not properties stored in the state. Two paths between the same endpoints can involve different heat and work while giving the same ΔU. Compression does negative work by the system under this convention and can raise internal energy even without heat input.

For a quasistatic gas process, boundary work is the integral of external resisting pressure over volume change, with special care needed outside quasistatic conditions. Other forms of work, such as electrical work, require inclusion when present. A cyclic process returns U to its initial value, so net heat input equals net work output.

The first law alone does not determine which processes can occur spontaneously; that directional restriction requires the second law.
body.zh:
第一定律是热力学系统的能量守恒。先定边界符号：此处 Q 入系统为正，W 系统对外做功为正，因此 ΔU = Q − W。内能是状态函数，变化只依始末；热和功是沿过程传递，不是储存在状态里的性质。

相同端点不同路径可有不同热功而同 ΔU。压缩在此约定下系统做负功，即使无吸热也可增内能。准静态气体边界功可由抵抗外压对体积变化积分，非准静态需谨慎；有电功等必须计入。

循环 U 回初值，净吸热等于净输出功。第一定律独自不决定自发方向，此限制需第二定律。

title.zh: 热传递 · 功 · 内能

body.en: Heat is energy transferred because of a temperature difference. With W defined as work done by the system, the first law is ΔU = Q − W.
body.zh: 热是由温差引起的能量传递。若 W 定义为系统对外做功，第一定律为 ΔU = Q − W。

summary.en: Isothermal means constant temperature; adiabatic means no heat transfer.
summary.zh: 等温表示温度不变，绝热表示无热传递。

objectives.en: Describe Isothermal process and its relationship to Adiabatic process.

objectives.en: Explain Pressure–volume work and identify the conditions behind the example.

body.en:
A thermodynamic process is a path through states, and names such as isothermal, isobaric, isochoric and adiabatic specify different constraints. Isothermal means temperature stays constant; it does not mean no heat enters or leaves. Adiabatic means heat transfer is absent or negligible; temperature may change because work changes internal energy.

Isochoric means volume is fixed, so simple pressure–volume boundary work vanishes, while isobaric means pressure is fixed. On a pressure–volume diagram, the area under a quasistatic path represents work done during expansion, and reversing the path reverses its sign. The enclosed area of a cycle represents net work with an orientation-dependent sign.

For an ideal gas undergoing a reversible adiabatic process with suitable constant heat capacities, pV^γ is constant. That formula is not valid for every irreversible adiabatic event, such as unrestricted free expansion. A reversible path is an ideal limiting process that stays arbitrarily close to equilibrium and can be retraced without net changes elsewhere.

Always distinguish the state equation, which holds at each modeled equilibrium state, from a process relation that requires additional assumptions about the path.
body.zh:
热过程是状态路径，等温、等压、等容和绝热指定不同约束。等温是温度恒定，不等于无热交换；绝热是传热无或可忽略，做功仍可改温。等容使简单 pV 边界功为零，等压则压强固定。

pV 图中准静态路径下面积为膨胀功，反向变号；循环围面积是带方向的净功。理想气体可逆绝热且热容适当恒定时 pV^γ 不变，但不适用于所有不可逆绝热，如自由膨胀。可逆是无限接近平衡且可逆行不留外界净变化的理想极限。

须分每个平衡态满足的状态方程，与另需路径假设的过程方程。

body.en:
Entropy is a state function that gives a quantitative direction criterion when combined with the second law. For a reversible heat transfer, dS = δQrev/T; to calculate entropy change between two states, one may choose a hypothetical reversible path even when the actual process was irreversible. The actual heat divided by temperature is not automatically equal to entropy change for an irreversible process.

An isolated system’s total entropy cannot decrease, while a subsystem can decrease its entropy by exporting enough entropy to its surroundings. Heat flowing spontaneously from hot to cold raises the combined entropy because the same energy enters the colder body with a larger reciprocal-temperature factor. In microscopic terms, entropy relates to the number and probabilities of accessible states under stated constraints, which is more precise than simply calling it disorder.

Entropy production measures irreversibility and limits the amount of useful work obtainable from an energy transfer. Reversible processes produce no total entropy in the ideal limit; real friction, mixing and finite-temperature heat flow produce some. The second law does not prohibit local organization, including living systems, because such systems exchange energy and entropy with their environment.
body.zh:
熵是状态函数，与第二定律一起给定量方向判据。可逆传热 dS = δQ可逆/T；即使实际不可逆，也可选假想可逆路径算两态熵差。不可逆过程的实际热除温度不自动等于熵变。

熵产衡量不可逆并限制可用功，可逆极限总熵产零，摩擦、混合、有限温差传热产生熵。第二定律不禁止生命等局部组织，因为其与环境交换能量和熵。

summary.en: A cyclic heat engine converts part of heat input into work and rejects the rest.
summary.zh: 循环热机把部分输入热转为功，其余排出。

body.en:
A heat engine operates in a cycle, receiving heat from a hotter source, delivering some work and rejecting heat to a cooler sink. Because the working substance returns to its initial state, the first law gives W = Qhot − Qcold over a cycle. Efficiency is work output divided by heat input and cannot exceed the reversible Carnot limit 1 − Tcold/Thot for two thermal reservoirs, using absolute temperatures.

A refrigerator reverses the desired transfer by consuming work to move heat from cold to hot. Its coefficient of performance compares useful cooling with work input and can exceed one without violating energy conservation. A heat pump uses the heat delivered to the warm side as its useful output.

Phase changes add another energy-storage mechanism: latent heat changes phase fraction at coexistence rather than necessarily raising temperature. Heating curves therefore distinguish sensible temperature change from phase conversion, and pressure affects transition conditions. A real machine also has finite-rate losses, friction and imperfect heat exchange.

Compare devices using the same boundary and useful-output definition instead of confusing engine efficiency with refrigerator performance.
body.zh:
热机循环从高温源吸热，部分输出功，其余向低温放热。工质回初态，第一定律给 W = Q热 − Q冷。效率为功/吸热，两个热库间不超过可逆卡诺限 1 − T冷/T热，需绝对温度。

制冷机消耗功把热由冷搬热，性能系数为有用制冷量/功，可大于一而不违守恒。热泵把暖端放热作为有用输出。相变增加储能机制，潜热在共存条件下改相比例，不必升温，因此加热曲线区分显热和相变，压强影响转变条件。

真实设备还有有限速率、摩擦及不完美换热损失。比较须同边界和有用输出定义，不能混热机效率与制冷性能。

body.en:
Electric charge is a conserved property with positive and negative signs. In ordinary matter, protons and electrons carry opposite elementary charges, while an object’s net charge reflects an imbalance rather than creation of charge from nothing. Charging by contact transfers charge, and induction redistributes charges in response to another charged object.

Conductors permit mobile charges to rearrange readily, whereas insulators restrict that motion on the relevant timescale. Coulomb’s law gives the force between stationary point charges in vacuum as k|q1q2|/r², directed along the line joining them. Like signs repel and opposite signs attract.

Extended objects can sometimes be treated as point charges by symmetry or distance, but not merely because their total charge is known. For several sources, add forces as vectors, preserving direction; adding magnitudes alone fails when forces oppose or meet at angles. The surrounding material can change the effective interaction and may require a field description including polarization.

Check limiting behavior: doubling distance quarters the force, while doubling one charge doubles it. Newton’s third-law forces act on different charged bodies and do not cancel on one body’s force diagram.
body.zh:

导体电荷易移动，绝缘体在相关时间限制移动。真空静止点电荷库仑力 k|q1q2|/r² 沿连线，同斥异吸。扩展物体仅在对称或远距等条件可点化，不能只知总电荷就点化。

多源力按矢量叠加，反向或夹角时不能只加大小。介质可改作用，需含极化的场描述。检极限：距离加倍力四分之一，一电荷加倍力加倍。

第三定律对力作用不同物体，不在单物体受力图抵消。

body.en:
An electric field assigns to each position the force that a sufficiently small positive test charge would experience per unit charge. The test charge is imagined small enough not to appreciably disturb the source distribution. Because force has direction, electric field is a vector; field lines are a visualization whose tangent indicates direction and whose spacing convention suggests strength.

Electric potential is instead potential energy per charge relative to a chosen reference. Only potential differences affect electrostatic energy changes, so adding the same constant everywhere does not change the field. In one dimension E = −dV/dx, and in multiple dimensions the field is the negative gradient of potential.

Moving a positive charge toward lower potential lowers its potential energy, while a negative charge reverses that energy relation. Equipotential surfaces are perpendicular to electrostatic field lines where the field is nonzero. Zero potential at a point does not imply zero field there, and zero field at a point does not require the potential value to be zero.

For several sources, potentials add as scalars, which can simplify calculations compared with direct vector-field addition.

body.en:
In a conductor at electrostatic equilibrium, mobile charges have rearranged until the internal electric field vanishes. The conductor is then at one potential, and excess charge resides on its surface in the ideal electrostatic model. This statement does not apply unchanged inside a conductor carrying a resistive steady current.

Surface charge distribution depends on geometry and nearby objects, with stronger fields often occurring near sharp curvature. A capacitor stores separated charge on conductors; capacitance is the ratio of charge magnitude to potential difference for a specified linear arrangement. For parallel plates with negligible edge effects, C = εA/d, showing the roles of area, separation and material permittivity.

A dielectric polarizes rather than freely conducting all charge, reducing the field for a fixed free charge and increasing capacitance. Whether voltage or charge stays fixed during insertion depends on whether the capacitor remains connected to a source. Stored energy can be written Q²/(2C), CV²/2 or QV/2 under the ideal linear model.

Track the energy exchange with a battery or mechanical agent before interpreting a change in capacitor energy as an isolated gain or loss.

电容器在导体分离电荷，给定线性结构电容为电荷绝对量/势差。忽略边缘的平行板 C = εA/d，体现面积、间距和介电性。电介质极化而非让电荷全自由流动，固定自由电荷时减场增电容。

body.en:
Electric current is the rate at which net charge crosses a chosen surface. Conventional current follows the direction positive charge would move, which is opposite to electron drift in a typical metal. Charge carriers drift slowly compared with the propagation of the electromagnetic change that establishes a circuit response.

Resistance relates voltage and current for a specified component and conditions. An ohmic resistor has an approximately linear current–voltage relation over its operating range; diodes, lamps and many other devices do not have one constant resistance over all conditions. For a uniform conductor, resistance depends on resistivity, length and cross-sectional area.

Resistivity itself depends on material and often temperature. Electrical power transferred to a component is VI with a consistent sign convention; for an ideal resistor it is dissipated as thermal energy and equals I²R or V²/R. These equivalent expressions must use the voltage and current for that same resistor.

Compare fixed-voltage and fixed-current conditions carefully: increasing resistance lowers power in the former but raises it in the latter. A circuit’s total energy accounting includes sources and all receiving components, not only the most visible resistor.

body.en:
Kirchhoff’s junction rule is charge conservation for a circuit node under conditions where net charge accumulation is negligible. Assign current directions first; a negative solved value simply means the actual direction is opposite to the chosen arrow. The loop rule accounts for energy changes around a closed lumped-circuit path, with signs set consistently for source rises and resistor drops.

A changing magnetic flux may require an induced-emf term rather than an unqualified zero sum of electrostatic potential differences. Series elements share the same branch current because charge has no alternative route between them. Parallel branches share their endpoint voltage but can carry different currents.

Equivalent resistance simplifies the external current–voltage behavior of a resistive network, but it does not preserve every internal current or power without further calculation. Real sources can be modeled with internal resistance, causing terminal voltage to differ from the ideal emf under load. A voltmeter’s finite resistance and an ammeter’s nonzero resistance can alter the network.

After solving, verify junction balances, loop signs and total power supplied versus absorbed; these independent checks catch many algebraic or wiring-model errors.

body.en:
A resistor–capacitor circuit illustrates how a storage element and a dissipative element create time-dependent behavior. Capacitor voltage cannot jump instantaneously in the ideal finite-current model because Q = CV requires transferring charge. During charging through a resistor from a fixed source, the current is initially largest and decreases as capacitor voltage approaches the source voltage.

The time constant τ = RC sets the exponential timescale, not an exact finishing time. After one time constant, a charging capacitor reaches about sixty-three percent of the total voltage change, while a discharging capacitor retains about thirty-seven percent of its initial voltage. Initial conditions matter: the general exponential approaches a final value from the starting value rather than always beginning at zero.

Energy supplied by a source is divided between stored field energy and resistor heating. Measurements can modify τ if a probe adds significant resistance or capacitance. An oscilloscope trace must be interpreted with its sampling rate, bandwidth and grounding arrangement in mind.

Compare a measured curve with both early-time slope and long-time limit before concluding that one fitted time constant fully validates the circuit model.

τ = RC 是指数时间尺度，不是精确完成时间。一 τ 后充电完成约 63% 总变化，放电剩约 37%。初始条件重要，一般指数从初值趋终值，不总从零起。

summary.en: Magnetic force qv × B is perpendicular to velocity.
summary.zh: 磁力 qv × B 垂直于速度，改变方向但不对点电荷做功。

objectives.en: Describe Lorentz force and its relationship to Circular orbit.
objectives.zh: 说明洛伦兹力与圆轨道之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Magnetic work and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释磁力做功，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
The magnetic part of the Lorentz force on a point charge is qv × B. Its direction is perpendicular to both velocity and magnetic field, with the sign of q reversing the right-hand-rule direction. The magnitude is |q|vB sinθ, so a stationary charge or motion parallel to the field has no magnetic force from that field.

Because the force is perpendicular to instantaneous velocity, it does no work on the point charge and does not directly change its speed. In a uniform field, perpendicular motion can therefore be circular, with magnetic force supplying the required centripetal acceleration. A parallel velocity component remains unchanged in the simple model, producing a helical path when combined with circular motion.

The radius mvperpendicular/(|q|B) depends on momentum and field strength, while the nonrelativistic angular frequency |q|B/m is independent of speed. Electric fields, collisions or relativistic speeds require extensions. A current-carrying wire also experiences force because its moving charges transfer momentum to the material.

Do not confuse magnetic field direction with particle travel direction, and check the charge sign before drawing curvature.
body.zh:
点电荷洛伦兹磁力为 qv × B，垂直速度和磁场，q 正负反转右手方向，大小 |q|vB sinθ。因此静止或平行运动不受该磁力。力垂直瞬时速度，不对点电荷做功，不直接改速率。

均匀场中垂直运动可成圆，磁力供向心加速度；简单模型平行分速不变，与圆运动合成螺旋。半径 mv垂直/(|q|B) 依动量和场，非相对论角频率 |q|B/m 与速率无关。有电场、碰撞或相对论速度需扩展。

载流导线也受力，因为运动电荷向材料传动量。不能混场方向与粒子方向，画弯曲前检电荷符号。

summary.en: Steady currents produce magnetic fields.
summary.zh: 稳恒电流产生磁场。

objectives.en: Describe Biot–Savart law and its relationship to Ampere law.

objectives.en: Explain Symmetry and identify the conditions behind the example.

body.en:
Steady electric currents create magnetic fields whose geometry follows the current distribution. The Biot–Savart law adds vector contributions from current elements, each depending on orientation and distance. For an ideal infinitely long straight wire, symmetry gives circular field lines and magnitude μ0I/(2πr) in vacuum.

A finite wire near its ends does not satisfy that ideal expression exactly. A current loop produces an axial field and resembles a magnetic dipole far away; many turns arranged as a long solenoid can produce an approximately uniform interior field with reduced exterior field. Ampere’s circuital law relates the circulation of B around a closed path to enclosed steady current.

It is always a relation in its applicable magnetostatic setting, but it becomes an easy algebraic tool only when symmetry determines the field direction and constancy along the chosen loop. Enclosing zero net current does not imply zero magnetic field at every point. Magnetic materials modify the relationship through magnetization, so a vacuum formula may need a material model.

Use the right-hand rule consistently and distinguish a chosen mathematical integration loop from a physical wire.
body.zh:

电流环在轴上有场、远处似偶极，长螺线管多匝可给近均匀内场和较小外场。安培环路联系 B 环量与包围稳流，在适用静磁条件总成立，但只有对称已确定方向和沿路径恒定性时才化简单代数。包围净流零不意味着处处零场。

磁性材料通过磁化改变关系，真空式可能需材料模型。右手规则须一致，并区分数学积分回路与实体导线。

objectives.en: Describe Magnetic flux and its relationship to Faraday law.

objectives.en: Explain Induced emf and identify the conditions behind the example.

body.en:
Magnetic flux measures the field component passing through an oriented surface. For a uniform field and flat area, Φ = BA cosθ with θ measured from the surface normal, not from the surface itself. Reversing the chosen normal reverses the signed flux.

Faraday’s law relates induced electromotive force around a closed loop to the negative time derivative of magnetic flux through it; a coil with N similar turns uses the flux linkage NΦ. Flux can change because field strength changes, the loop area changes, the loop rotates or the loop moves through a nonuniform region. Thus a constant magnetic field can still produce induction in a moving circuit.

Electromotive force is work per unit charge around the loop, not necessarily an electrostatic potential difference defined independently of path. In a moving conductor, magnetic forces on charges contribute to the motional-emf description, while a changing field can create a circulating electric field even without a conductor present. Keep the loop orientation and flux sign consistent before applying the minus sign.

A flux change predicts emf; current additionally depends on whether a conducting path exists and on its impedance.
body.zh:
磁通量测穿过定向面的场分量。均匀场平面 Φ = BA cosθ，θ 从法线而非平面量；反法线则通量反号。法拉第定律把闭路感应电动势与穿面磁通负变化率联系，多匝用 NΦ 磁通链。

场强、面积、朝向或穿非均匀区移动都可改通量，因此恒 B 仍可在运动电路感应。电动势是绕回路单位电荷功，不一定是与路径无关静电势差。动导体中电荷磁力构成动生描述，时变场则无导体也可产生环形电场。

负号前应统一回路朝向与通量符号。通量变化预示电动势，电流还取决于闭合导电路及阻抗。

summary.en: Lenz’s law selects an induced-current direction whose magnetic effect opposes the change that caused it.
summary.zh: 楞次定律确定感应电流方向：其磁效应反抗引发感应的磁通变化。

objectives.en: Describe Opposition to flux change and its relationship to Mechanical work.
objectives.zh: 说明反抗磁通变化与机械功之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Induced current and identify the conditions behind the example.

body.en:
Lenz’s law determines the sign of induction by stating that the induced response opposes the change in magnetic flux that produces it. It does not say that the induced field always opposes the existing external field. If an upward flux is increasing, the induced field tends downward; if that upward flux is decreasing, the induced field tends upward to resist the decrease.

Use a right-hand rule to connect the required induced-field direction with current circulation. The opposition is consistent with energy conservation. Pulling a conducting loop from a field can require mechanical work because the induced current produces a force opposing the motion; the work can become thermal energy in the resistance.

If the induced effect instead amplified the original motion without an energy source, the model would predict unphysical self-generated energy. Eddy currents are distributed induced currents in bulk conductors and can produce braking or heating. Their strength depends on conductivity, geometry and time variation, not just magnetic-field magnitude.

Distinguish an open circuit, which can have an induced emf without sustained loop current, from a closed conducting path. Always identify precisely which flux change is being opposed.
body.zh:

反抗符合守恒：把导电环拉出磁场时，感应流力阻运动，机械功可变电阻热；若无能量源却放大原运动，会预测自生能。涡流是块导体中的分布感应电流，可制动发热，强度依电导、几何及时间变化，不只 B 大小。开路可有感应电动势却无持续环流，应与闭路分。

必须准确指出反抗的是哪种磁通变化。

summary.en: An inductor opposes current change with emf −L dI/dt and stores LI²/2 magnetic energy.

objectives.en: Describe Self-inductance and its relationship to Reactance.
objectives.zh: 说明自感与电抗之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Phase and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释相位，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
An inductor links circuit current with magnetic flux, and a changing current produces a self-induced emf that opposes the change. For a linear ideal inductor, the magnitude relation is v = L di/dt with a consistent passive sign convention; a constant current can have zero inductor voltage even while magnetic energy remains stored. The stored energy is LI²/2.

Connecting resistance and inductance creates an exponential current transient with a characteristic L/R timescale. In sinusoidal steady state, inductive reactance grows with angular frequency as ωL, while capacitive reactance decreases as 1/(ωC). Voltage and current may be out of phase, so average power is not generally the product of their peak values.

Root-mean-square values and the phase factor provide the appropriate resistive power comparison. An RLC circuit can resonate when inductive and capacitive effects balance, with resistance limiting the response. Real inductors also have winding resistance, parasitic capacitance and possible magnetic-core losses.

Keep transient behavior distinct from sinusoidal steady-state analysis, and do not replace every time-dependent relation with a simple DC resistance formula.
body.zh:
电感联系电流与磁通，变流自感反抗变化。线性理想元件按一致被动符号 v = L di/dt，恒流可电压零而磁能仍存，储能 LI²/2。RL 产生时间尺度 L/R 的指数暂态。

正弦稳态感抗 ωL 随频增，容抗 1/(ωC) 随频减。电压电流可不同相，平均功率不一般等峰值乘积，需有效值和相位因子。RLC 在感容平衡时可共振，电阻限制响应。

真实电感还含线阻、寄生容和芯损。须区分暂态与正弦稳态，不能把所有时间关系换为直流电阻公式。

title.zh: 电磁波与麦克斯韦概览

summary.en: Maxwell’s equations connect charges and currents with electric and magnetic fields.
summary.zh: 麦克斯韦方程把电荷、电流与电磁场联系起来。

objectives.en: Describe Displacement current and its relationship to Coupled fields.
objectives.zh: 说明位移电流与耦合场之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Wave speed and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释波速，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Maxwell’s equations unify electric and magnetic phenomena through four linked statements. Electric charge is a source of electric flux; closed surfaces have no net magnetic flux in the standard theory; changing magnetic flux produces electric circulation; and conduction current together with changing electric flux produces magnetic circulation. The displacement-current term is essential for consistency with charge conservation, including the region between charging capacitor plates where no conduction current crosses the gap.

In vacuum these coupled equations admit waves whose electric and magnetic fields sustain each other while propagating at c = 1/√(μ0ε0). For a plane wave, the fields are transverse to propagation and mutually perpendicular, with linked magnitudes. Electromagnetic waves carry energy and momentum, so they can transfer power and exert pressure without a material medium.

Radio, visible light and other bands differ in frequency, not in being fundamentally unrelated kinds of wave. Material response changes propagation speed, absorption and dispersion. The wave model explains many propagation effects, while quantized interactions require additional quantum ideas.

Treat the overview as a connected set of laws, not four isolated formulas to memorize without their source and flux meanings.
body.zh:
麦克斯韦四关系统一电磁：电荷源出电通量，标准理论闭面磁通零，变磁通生电环量，传导电流和变电通量生磁环量。位移电流对电荷守恒一致性必要，包括充电电容间隙无传导流区。真空耦合式允许 c = 1/√(μ0ε0) 的波，电磁场相互维持传播。

平面波场横向且彼此垂直，大小相联系。电磁波携能量动量，可无介质传功施压。无线电、可见等频段频率不同而非根本无关波。

材料响应改变波速、吸收和色散。波模型解释传播，量子化相互作用需量子思想。应把四式看成源、通量和环量的连接规律，而非四条孤立死记式。

body.en:
A wave is a propagating disturbance or field pattern, not necessarily a stream of material traveling with the pattern. In a transverse mechanical wave, particle displacement is perpendicular to propagation; in a longitudinal wave it is parallel. Wavelength is the spatial distance between equivalent phases, period is the time for one cycle at a fixed position and frequency is the reciprocal of period.

For a periodic traveling wave, speed equals frequency times wavelength. A sinusoidal expression separates amplitude, spatial phase and temporal phase, helping distinguish particle motion from movement of a crest. In a linear medium, superposition means overlapping displacements add algebraically with their signs.

Constructive and destructive interference depend on relative phase, but energy accounting involves the complete field and its transport rather than simply declaring energy destroyed at a node. Real media can be dispersive, meaning different frequencies propagate at different phase speeds; a wave packet’s envelope can then move differently from an individual crest. Boundaries can reflect and transmit waves, with phase changes depending on boundary conditions.

Always identify what physical quantity oscillates and what sets the propagation speed in the chosen model.

body.en:
Standing waves arise when traveling waves of suitable frequency and amplitude propagate in opposite directions and interfere. Nodes have zero displacement amplitude in the ideal pattern, while antinodes have maximum amplitude; the pattern does not translate like a traveling crest. Boundary conditions select allowed modes.

A string fixed at both ends must have displacement nodes at those ends, producing wavelengths 2L/n and harmonic frequencies nv/(2L) when wave speed is frequency-independent. An air column has different displacement and pressure boundary conditions: a displacement antinode corresponds to a pressure node, so the two diagrams must not be confused. Sound in ordinary air is a longitudinal pressure and density disturbance, while the air particles oscillate locally.

Pitch is associated with frequency, loudness depends on several perceptual and physical factors, and intensity is power per area. A decibel scale expresses a logarithmic ratio relative to a stated reference, not a linear amount of sound. Resonance can amplify a driven mode, but damping and coupling determine the actual amplitude.

Real instruments include end corrections, multiple modes and material effects beyond the simplest ideal string or tube.
body.zh:

分贝是相对指定参考的对数比，不是线性声量。共振可放大驱动模式，但阻尼耦合定真实幅。真实乐器还含端修正、多模式和材料效应。

body.en:
Reflection and refraction follow from how waves satisfy conditions at an interface. Draw the normal perpendicular to the surface before measuring any angle. The reflected angle equals the incident angle for a smooth stationary interface in the simple ray model.

Refraction changes direction when propagation speed changes, with n1sinθ1 = n2sinθ2. The refractive index n = c/v describes phase speed relative to vacuum and can depend on wavelength, producing dispersion. Frequency remains the same across a stationary boundary, while speed and wavelength change together.

Traveling from higher to lower refractive index can reach a critical angle where the refracted ray would be parallel to the surface. Above that angle, the ray model predicts total internal reflection, although an evanescent field extends a short distance beyond the boundary. This is not possible for incidence from lower to higher index in the same simple setting.

Surface roughness scatters light into multiple directions rather than invalidating energy conservation. Ray optics assumes structures large compared with wavelength, so very narrow apertures or fine features require wave analysis. Check direction qualitatively before calculating: entry into a higher index bends the ray toward the normal.
body.zh:
反射折射来自界面波条件。先画法线再量角，光滑静止界面简单射线反射角等入射角。速度变化可折向，满足 n1sinθ1 = n2sinθ2。

n = c/v 是相速比且可依波长产生色散。静界面频率不变，速度波长一起变。高 n 到低 n 达临界时折射平行面，超过后射线模型全反射，但边界外仍有短距倏逝场；反向低到高无此条件。

粗面向多方向散射，不违能量守恒。射线近似需结构远大于波长，窄孔细结构需波分析。计算前先定性检：入高 n 朝法线弯。

body.en:
A lens changes wavefront direction through refraction and can form an image by bringing rays together or making them appear to diverge from a point. In the thin-lens approximation, thickness is small compared with the relevant distances and paraxial rays make small angles with the axis. With a consistent sign convention, the object distance, image distance and focal length obey 1/f = 1/u + 1/v.

A real image occurs where rays actually converge and can be projected onto a screen; a virtual image is found by backward extensions of diverging rays and cannot be caught on a screen at that apparent location. Transverse magnification relates image and object heights and carries an orientation sign. A converging lens can make either real or virtual images depending on object position, while a diverging lens’s behavior also depends on whether the incident object is real or virtual.

Optical instruments combine elements, apertures and detectors, so magnification alone does not determine useful detail. Aberrations, diffraction and alignment limit performance. Trace a few representative rays and check the algebraic image location against the geometry rather than applying a formula without a drawing.
body.zh:
透镜折射波前，使光线会聚或看似从一点发散成像。薄透镜假设厚度相对距离小、近轴角小，一致符号下 1/f = 1/u + 1/v。实像是实际会聚，可投屏；虚像是发散线反延长交点，不能在该表观位置接屏。

横向放大率含正倒符号。会聚镜依物距可实可虚，发散镜也依入射物是实是虚。仪器组合元件、孔径和探测器，放大倍数不单定可用细节，像差、衍射和对准限制性能。

应画代表光线并用几何复核代数像位，而非无图套式。

summary.en: Coherent waves interfere according to phase difference.
summary.zh: 相干波按相位差发生干涉。

objectives.en: Describe Path difference and its relationship to Coherence.
objectives.zh: 说明光程差与相干性之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Diffraction scale and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释衍射尺度，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Interference compares the phase of waves that reach the same point through different paths. For equal-frequency coherent sources, a path difference of an integer wavelength gives constructive interference when their initial phases agree, while an odd half-wavelength gives destructive interference for equal amplitudes. Coherence means that the relative phase remains sufficiently stable over the observation; merely having the same approximate colour is not enough for a stable pattern.

Young’s double-slit geometry converts path differences into a spatial fringe pattern under suitable far-field and small-angle approximations. Diffraction is the spreading and interference associated with a finite aperture or obstacle. A narrower slit produces a broader central angular maximum, revealing a tradeoff between spatial confinement and directional concentration.

The double-slit pattern can be modulated by each slit’s own diffraction envelope, so not every predicted interference maximum has equal intensity. Interference redistributes energy rather than destroying it globally. Instrument resolution is limited partly by diffraction from its aperture, even if lenses are perfectly manufactured.

Always state whether a calculation uses exact geometry, a far-field approximation or a small-angle approximation, because those assumptions set its useful range.
body.zh:
干涉比较不同路径到同点的相位。等频相干源初相同，整数波长程差相长，等幅时奇数半波长相消。相干要求观察期间相对相位足够稳定，仅颜色近同不够。

杨氏双缝在远场小角等近似下把程差变空间条纹。衍射是有限孔或障碍相关扩散干涉，缝越窄中央角峰越宽，体现空间局限与方向集中权衡。双缝图可被单缝包络调制，因此干涉峰不都等强。

干涉重分能量而非全球毁能。即使透镜完美，孔径衍射也限制分辨。应说明精确几何、远场或小角近似，假设决定范围。

summary.en: Polarization describes the direction of transverse field oscillation.
summary.zh: 偏振描述横向场振动方向。

objectives.en: Describe Transverse polarization and its relationship to Malus law.
objectives.zh: 说明横波偏振与马吕斯定律之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Photon evidence and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释光子证据，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Polarization describes the direction and time dependence of transverse electric-field oscillation. Linearly polarized light oscillates along a fixed transverse direction, while circular and elliptical polarization involve changing direction with a phase relation between components. An ideal linear polarizer transmits the component along its axis.

For an already linearly polarized beam, transmitted intensity follows Malus’s law I = I0cos²θ, because field amplitude is projected and intensity is proportional to its square. Unpolarized light requires averaging over fluctuating orientations, so the same input interpretation must not be assumed without checking. Polarization supports the transverse nature of electromagnetic waves and is used in imaging, displays and material analysis.

It does not describe ordinary longitudinal sound in air in the same way. Classical wave optics explains propagation, interference and diffraction, but energy exchange in photoelectric and photon-counting experiments requires quantization. A photon description and a wave description are not mutually exclusive stories chosen arbitrarily; each captures aspects of one physical theory in an appropriate limit.

State what an experiment measures before claiming that it proves light is only a particle or only a wave.
body.zh:
偏振描述横向电场方向及随时变化。线偏沿固定横向，圆椭圆偏振由两分量相位关系使方向变化。理想线偏器透其轴分量；已线偏输入满足 I = I0cos²θ，因为场幅投影而强度与平方成正比。

非偏光需对波动取向平均，不能不查输入就套同解释。偏振支持电磁横波，用于成像、显示和材料；空气普通纵声不以同样方式偏振。经典波解释传播干涉衍射，光电和计数能量交换需量子。

光子与波并非随意二选互斥故事，而是同理论适当极限的不同方面。宣称“仅粒”或“仅波”前须说明实验实际测什么。

summary.en: For a constant force, work is Fs cos θ.
summary.zh: 恒力做功为 Fs cos θ。

objectives.en: Describe Force–displacement work and its relationship to Kinetic energy.
objectives.zh: 说明力与位移的功与动能之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Work–energy theorem and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释动能定理，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Work measures energy transferred by a force acting through displacement. For a constant force, only its component parallel to the displacement contributes: W=Fs cos θ. A force perpendicular to instantaneous motion does no work at that instant, even though it can bend the trajectory. A force opposing motion does negative work. For a changing force or a curved path, accumulate small contributions F·dr along the actual path.

The work–kinetic-energy theorem follows from Newton's second law for a constant-mass particle. For constant force along a straight displacement, v²−u²=2as and F=ma give Fs=m(v²−u²)/2. Thus total work equals the change in mv²/2. A changing force can be handled by adding contributions over many small displacements; calculus later makes this general argument precise. It is the work of the resultant, or the sum of work from all forces, that equals this change. One force's work need not equal the kinetic-energy change when other forces also act.

For a cart moving right under a rightward push and leftward friction, the push contributes positive work and friction negative work. If their magnitudes balance, kinetic energy can stay constant despite energy being transferred from the pusher into thermal energy. Power is work per unit time; instantaneous power is F·v. Two machines can deliver the same work with different power by taking different times.
body.zh:
功描述力通过位移转移的能量。恒力时，只有沿位移方向的分量贡献功，即 W=Fs cos θ。与瞬时运动方向垂直的力，在该瞬间不做功，但仍能使轨迹转弯；阻碍运动的力做负功。力变化或路径弯曲时，要沿实际路径累计微小贡献 F·dr。

对质量恒定的质点，动能定理可由牛顿第二定律推出。恒力沿直线位移作用时，由 v²−u²=2as 和 F=ma 得到 Fs=m(v²−u²)/2，即总功等于 mv²/2 的变化。对于变化的力，可以将许多小位移上的贡献相加，之后用微积分严格处理一般情况。这里必须是合力的功，或所有力所做功的和；还有其他力作用时，单个力做的功未必等于动能变化。

向右行驶的小车若受向右推力与向左摩擦力，推力做正功，摩擦力做负功。两者大小平衡时，动能可保持不变，但推动者的能量仍不断转移为热能。功率是单位时间的功，瞬时功率为 F·v。两台机器可以做相同的功，却因耗时不同而功率不同。

body.zh: 恒力做功为 Fs cos θ。所有力做功之和等于动能变化。垂直于位移的力不做功，却仍能改变运动方向。

summary.en: A conservative force permits a potential energy U with work W = −ΔU.
summary.zh: 保守力允许定义势能 U，满足 W = −ΔU。

objectives.en: Describe Conservative force and its relationship to Potential energy.
objectives.zh: 说明保守力与势能之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Energy accounting and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释能量账目，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A conservative force does work that depends only on the endpoints of a path. Its work around a closed path is zero. This allows a potential-energy function U to record the interaction: the force's work equals minus the change in U. Potential energy belongs to an interacting system, such as a mass and the Earth or a spring and the object attached to it, rather than to speed alone.

Near Earth's surface, with approximately constant g, raising a mass by height h changes gravitational potential energy by mgh. An ideal spring stretched or compressed by x stores kx²/2 relative to its relaxed state. The reference value of U is arbitrary, but differences are physically useful. Changing the zero shifts all stated energies by the same constant and does not alter forces or predicted speeds.

When conservative forces do all the work, the work–energy theorem becomes Δ(K+U)=0. With additional nonconservative work, use Δ(K+U)=Wnonconservative for the chosen particle model and explicitly tracked conservative potentials. Sliding friction can lower mechanical energy while increasing internal thermal energy; total energy has not disappeared. A force balance and an energy balance answer different questions: energy often relates speeds at two positions efficiently, while the time taken or contact forces may still require Newton's laws.
body.zh:
保守力所做的功只依赖路径端点，沿闭合路径一周的功为零。因此可以用势能函数 U 记录这种相互作用，保守力的功等于势能变化的负值。势能属于相互作用系统，例如物体与地球、弹簧与连接物体，而不是仅由速率决定。

近地面 g 可近似恒定时，升高 h 所对应的重力势能变化为 mgh。理想弹簧相对自然长度伸长或压缩 x，储存弹性势能 kx²/2。势能零点可任意选，但势能差有物理作用。更换零点只会给所有势能加同一个常数，不会改变力或预测速率。

只有保守力做功时，动能定理变为 Δ(K+U)=0。若还存在其他非保守力做功，在所选质点模型与已计入的势能项下，应使用 Δ(K+U)=W非保守。滑动摩擦可以降低机械能并提高内能，总能量并未消失。受力分析与能量分析回答的问题不同：能量常能高效联系两个位置的速率，但运动时间、支持力等仍可能需要牛顿定律。

title.en: Conservative force · Potential energy · Energy accounting
title.zh: 保守力 · 势能 · 能量账目

body.en: A conservative force permits a potential energy U with work W = −ΔU. Near Earth, gravitational U = mgh relative to a chosen zero. With only conservative forces, K + U is constant.
body.zh: 保守力允许定义势能 U，满足 W = −ΔU。近地面重力势能为相对选定零点的 mgh。只有保守力做功时，K + U 保持不变。

body.en: Dropping 2 kg through 5 m with g = 10 m/s² releases 100 J of gravitational potential energy.

summary.en: Impulse is force integrated over time, or average force times duration.
summary.zh: 冲量是力对时间的积分，也可用平均力乘作用时间。

objectives.en: Describe Impulse and its relationship to Momentum conservation.
objectives.zh: 说明冲量与动量守恒之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Elasticity and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释弹性程度，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Momentum combines mass with signed velocity. In more than one dimension it is a vector, so add components rather than speeds. Impulse is the accumulated force over a time interval; for a constant or correctly averaged force it is FΔt. Newton's law relates external impulse to the change in a system's total momentum. A large force acting briefly and a smaller force acting longer can produce the same impulse.

Choose the colliding objects together as the system. Their mutual impact forces are internal and cancel in the total momentum equation. If external impulse is negligible during the short collision, total momentum before and after is equal. This does not require kinetic energy to be conserved. In an elastic collision both momentum and kinetic energy are conserved; a perfectly inelastic collision has the objects stick together. Deformation, heating and sound account for the missing macroscopic kinetic energy.

For sticking in one dimension, the shared final velocity is the initial total momentum divided by combined mass. Signed directions matter: opposite momenta can cancel, leaving a stationary combined object even though both initially moved. The collision calculation does not automatically describe the later motion if external forces subsequently act. In injury protection, increasing stopping time for a fixed momentum change reduces average force, although the detailed peak force also depends on how the force varies.
body.zh:
动量是质量与带方向速度的乘积。在多维问题中它是向量，应按分量相加，不能直接加速率。冲量是某段时间内力的累计；恒力或正确取平均后可写为 FΔt。牛顿定律把外力冲量与系统总动量变化联系起来。大力短时作用与小力长时作用，可以产生相同冲量。

将碰撞的物体一起选为系统，它们之间的碰撞力是内力，在总动量方程中抵消。短暂碰撞过程中，若外力冲量可忽略，总动量前后相等，但这不要求动能守恒。弹性碰撞同时守恒动量与动能；完全非弹性碰撞中，物体碰后粘在一起。宏观动能的减少可对应形变、内能或声音等。

一维粘连碰撞的共同末速度，等于初始总动量除以总质量。必须保留方向符号：相反动量可相消，因此原先都运动的两物体粘连后可能静止。若碰后继续受外力，这次碰撞计算不自动给出后续全部运动。缓冲保护中，固定动量变化下延长停止时间可减小平均力，但峰值力仍取决于力随时间的具体变化。

title.en: Center of mass and many-particle systems

summary.en: The centre of mass has position Σmixi/Σmi.
summary.zh: 质心位置为 Σmixi/Σmi。

objectives.en: Describe Mass-weighted position and its relationship to External force.
objectives.zh: 说明质量加权位置与外力之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Internal interactions and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释内部相互作用，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
The centre of mass is a weighted average of positions, with each mass providing its weight in the average. In one dimension xCM=(m₁x₁+m₂x₂+⋯)/M, where M is total mass. Use the same origin for every coordinate. A heavier object pulls the average toward its own location. For an extended object, split it into small masses or use symmetry; a uniform ring's centre lies in its empty middle.

For a system of constant total mass, total momentum equals M times centre-of-mass velocity. Adding the particles' equations of motion cancels their internal action–reaction forces and gives M aCM=Fexternal. A complicated object may rotate, vibrate or break apart while its centre of mass follows a simple trajectory determined by the external resultant. After a projectile breaks into fragments, the centre of mass still follows the original gravity-only trajectory if drag is neglected.

This does not mean all of the system's kinetic energy is the kinetic energy of its centre. There can also be motion relative to that centre. Two equal masses moving oppositely have a stationary centre but positive total kinetic energy. If mass enters or leaves the chosen system, carefully account for momentum carried across its boundary; a rocket cannot be analyzed by blindly applying a constant-mass centre-of-mass formula to the shrinking rocket alone.
body.zh:
质心是以质量为权重的位置平均。一维中 x质心=(m₁x₁+m₂x₂+⋯)/M，M 为总质量，所有坐标必须使用同一个原点。较重物体会使平均位置更靠近自己。对有大小的物体，可分成小质量块或利用对称性；均匀圆环的质心位于中间没有材料的区域。

总质量恒定时，系统总动量等于 M 乘以质心速度。把各质点运动方程相加，内部相互作用力两两抵消，得到 M a质心=F外。复杂物体可以转动、振动、碎裂，但质心仍按外力合力决定的较简单轨迹运动。例如忽略阻力时，抛体破裂成碎片后，所有碎片的质心仍沿原来的重力抛物线运动。

这不代表系统全部动能都等于质心平动动能。系统还可以有相对质心的运动。两个等质量物体反向运动，质心可静止，总动能却为正。若质量穿过系统边界，还要考虑它带入或带出的动量；不能仅把质量不断减小的火箭本体，机械地代入恒定质量公式。

summary.en: Torque is the vector r × F; its magnitude is force times perpendicular lever arm.
summary.zh: 力矩为矢量 r × F，大小等于力乘垂直力臂。

objectives.en: Describe Torque and its relationship to Moment of inertia.
objectives.zh: 说明力矩与转动惯量之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Angular momentum and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释角动量，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A force's rotational effect depends on where it acts and on the axis being considered. Its torque magnitude is force times perpendicular distance from the axis to the force's line of action. Pulling directly toward a pivot gives zero torque about that pivot, even if the force is large. In three dimensions the cross product r×F encodes the perpendicular direction using the right-hand rule; opposite turning senses have opposite signs along a chosen axis.

Moment of inertia measures resistance to angular acceleration about a specified axis. For point masses it is the sum of mr², where r is each mass's perpendicular distance to that axis. Moving the same mass farther out increases I without changing total mass. For a rigid body rotating about a fixed axis with constant I, the net external torque component along that axis equals Iα, and rotational kinetic energy is Iω²/2.

Angular momentum about an origin is r×p for a particle. External torque changes total angular momentum about a fixed inertial origin. When that torque vanishes, angular momentum is conserved, even if internal motions redistribute mass. A skater pulling their arms inward can increase angular speed while reducing I. Their rotational kinetic energy need not stay constant: muscles do internal work. Always keep the axis and conservation conditions explicit rather than treating I as a property of mass alone.
body.zh:
力的转动作用取决于作用位置和所选转轴。力矩大小等于力乘以转轴到力作用线的垂直距离。即使力很大，若直接指向支点，对该支点的力矩仍为零。三维中的叉积 r×F 用右手定则表示垂直方向；沿指定转轴看，相反转动趋势应取相反符号。

转动惯量衡量绕指定轴改变角速度的难易程度。质点系中 I 为各个 mr² 之和，r 是质量点到转轴的垂直距离。将同样的质量移得更远，会增大 I，但不会改变总质量。刚体绕固定轴转动且 I 恒定时，外力矩沿该轴的分量等于 Iα，转动动能为 Iω²/2。

质点关于原点的角动量是 r×p。关于固定惯性原点的总角动量变化由外力矩决定；外力矩为零时，即使内部重新分配质量，总角动量仍守恒。滑冰者收拢双臂，I 减小，角速度可增大。但转动动能未必守恒，因为肌肉做了内功。应始终说明转轴和守恒条件，不能把 I 当成只由总质量决定的量。

summary.en: Pure rolling satisfies vCM = ωR at a stationary surface.
summary.zh: 在静止表面纯滚动时，v质心 = ωR。

objectives.en: Describe No-slip rolling and its relationship to Static equilibrium.
objectives.zh: 说明无滑动滚动与静力平衡之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Translational and rotational energy and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释平动与转动能，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Rolling combines translation of the centre of mass with rotation about that centre. For a circular wheel on a stationary surface, no slipping means the contacting material point has zero instantaneous velocity relative to the surface. The translational and rotational velocities cancel there, giving vCM=ωR. The top of the rim instead moves at twice the centre speed in this ideal picture. A slipping wheel does not satisfy the same relation.

The kinetic energy is the sum of centre-of-mass translation and rotation about the centre. For a uniform solid disk, ICM=MR²/2, so pure rolling has kinetic energy 3MvCM²/4. Different mass distributions produce different rotational energy at the same centre speed. On an ideal fixed rigid surface, static friction can provide the torque needed for rolling without dissipating mechanical energy at the stationary contact; deformation and rolling resistance are additional effects.

Rigid-body equilibrium requires both translational and rotational balance. Sum forces to zero and torques to zero about one convenient point, using consistent signs and perpendicular lever arms. Choosing a support as the torque origin removes that support's unknown force from the torque equation. Equal opposite forces at different locations can form a couple: zero resultant force but a nonzero turning effect. A zero force sum alone therefore cannot establish equilibrium.
body.zh:
滚动同时包含质心平动和绕质心转动。圆轮在静止表面上无滑动时，接触处的材料点相对表面的瞬时速度为零。该点的平动速度与转动速度抵消，得到 v质心=ωR；同一理想模型中，轮缘顶部的速率则是质心速率的两倍。发生打滑时不能继续使用这个约束。

动能是质心平动动能与绕质心转动动能之和。均匀实心圆盘 I质心=MR²/2，因此纯滚动动能为 3Mv质心²/4。相同质心速率下，不同质量分布会产生不同转动动能。理想静止刚性表面上的静摩擦可以提供滚动所需力矩，而不在瞬时静止的接触点耗散机械能；形变、滚动阻力等则是额外效应。

刚体平衡同时要求平动力与力矩平衡。将力的和、关于方便选定点的力矩和都设为零，统一正负号，并使用垂直力臂。把支点选为力矩原点，可让该支点未知支持力不出现在力矩方程中。不同位置的等大反向力可能构成力偶，合力为零却仍有转动作用，因此仅合力为零不足以证明平衡。

summary.en: Newtonian gravity has magnitude GMm/r².
summary.zh: 牛顿引力大小为 GMm/r²。

objectives.en: Describe Inverse-square gravity and its relationship to Circular orbit.
objectives.zh: 说明平方反比引力与圆轨道之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Orbital energy and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释轨道能量，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Newton's gravitational law describes an attractive force between point masses, with magnitude GMm/r² along the line joining them. Here r is centre-to-centre separation, not height above a surface. Outside a spherically symmetric body, its gravitational field is the same as if all its mass were at its centre. Inside the material, that shortcut generally changes. Fields from different sources add as vectors.

Near a planet's surface, g=GM/r² changes little over small height ranges, explaining the approximately constant g used in elementary mechanics. For a small satellite in a circular orbit about a much heavier body, gravity supplies the inward resultant. Equating GMm/r² to mv²/r cancels the satellite mass and gives v²=GM/r. The orbital period is circumference divided by speed, so its square is proportional to r³.

Orbiting is free fall with enough sideways motion that the object keeps missing the planet. Apparent weightlessness does not imply absent gravity. With gravitational potential zero at infinity, U=−GMm/r: moving outward increases U toward zero. Escape requires enough initial energy to reach infinity with nonnegative kinetic energy in the ideal isolated model. Real orbits can be elliptical, involve additional bodies, or require relativistic corrections; the circular Newtonian formulas have specific assumptions.
body.zh:
牛顿引力定律描述质点间沿连线的吸引力，大小为 GMm/r²。r 是两质量中心间的距离，不是离表面的高度。在球对称天体外部，引力场等效于质量集中在球心；进入天体内部后，一般不能原样使用这种捷径。多个引力源的场要按向量叠加。

近地表的小高度范围内，g=GM/r² 变化不大，因此基础力学常把 g 看成常量。小卫星绕远重于自己的天体作圆轨道运动时，引力提供径向合力。令 GMm/r²=mv²/r，卫星质量约去，得到 v²=GM/r。周期是圆周长除以速率，因此周期平方与 r³ 成正比。

轨道运动是带有足够侧向速度的自由落体，使物体不断“落空”天体表面。表观失重并不表示没有引力。将无穷远势能设为零时，U=−GMm/r；向外移动使势能趋近零。在理想孤立模型中，逃逸要求初始能量足以使物体到无穷远时动能非负。真实轨道还可能是椭圆，受多个天体影响，或需要相对论修正；圆轨道牛顿公式有明确适用条件。

summary.en: In a constant-density fluid, pressure rises by ρgh with depth.
summary.zh: 恒定密度流体中，压强随深度增加 ρgh。

objectives.en: Describe Hydrostatic pressure and its relationship to Buoyant force.
objectives.zh: 说明静水压强与浮力之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Displaced volume and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释排开体积，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Pressure is normal force per unit area. In a fluid at rest, a small parcel must have balanced forces; otherwise it would accelerate. The lower surface of a vertical parcel must support the downward pressure force from above as well as the parcel's weight. For constant density this balance gives p=pSurface+ρgh, with depth h measured downward from the free surface. Pressure depends on depth, not on the container's shape. Absolute pressure includes the atmosphere; gauge pressure subtracts the surrounding atmospheric pressure.

Pressure forces act perpendicular to every part of an immersed object's surface. Because pressure increases downward, the upward force on the lower parts exceeds the downward contribution on the upper parts. The resultant buoyant force equals the weight of the fluid displaced. One way to justify this is to replace the object with an imaginary parcel of the surrounding fluid: that parcel would be in equilibrium under the same surface-pressure forces and its own weight.

An object floating freely at rest displaces fluid whose weight equals its own. Its submerged volume adjusts until buoyancy balances gravity. For a uniform object in one liquid, the submerged fraction is object density divided by liquid density, provided this ratio is below one. A fully submerged object has a fixed displaced volume; if its weight exceeds buoyancy, another upward force is needed for equilibrium.
body.zh:
压强是单位面积上的法向力。静止流体中的小流体块必须受力平衡，否则就会加速。竖直流体块的下表面所受压力，需要同时平衡上表面向下的压力和自身重力。密度恒定时，由平衡得到 p=p表面+ρgh，其中 h 从自由液面向下计量。压强取决于深度，而不是容器形状。绝对压强包含大气压，表压则扣除了周围大气压。

压力垂直作用于浸没物体的各处表面。由于越深压强越大，下部向上的压力超过上部向下的贡献，合成的浮力等于被排开流体的重力。可以用一个想象的同形流体块替换物体来说明：这个流体块在相同表面压力和自身重力作用下本应平衡，因此表面压力的合力就是其重力的相反数。

自由漂浮且静止的物体，排开流体的重量等于自身重量；浸没体积会调整到浮力与重力平衡。均匀物体漂浮于一种液体时，浸没体积分数等于物体密度与液体密度之比，前提是比值小于一。完全浸没后，排开体积固定；若重力大于浮力，需要额外向上的力才能平衡。

title.zh: 流动、连续性与伯努利模型

summary.en: Steady incompressible flow satisfies Av = constant along a tube.
summary.zh: 稳定不可压缩管流满足 Av 不变。

objectives.en: Describe Continuity and its relationship to Bernoulli relation.
objectives.zh: 说明连续性与伯努利关系之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Model limitations and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释模型限制，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A flow rate tells us how much fluid crosses a section per unit time. If the average perpendicular speed is v across area A, volume flow rate is Av and mass flow rate is ρAv. Conservation of mass in a steady pipe without leaks requires equal mass flow rates at successive sections. For an incompressible fluid the density is unchanged, so narrowing the area increases the average speed. For a compressible fluid, density changes must also be included.

Bernoulli's relation expresses mechanical energy balance per unit volume along a streamline: p+ρv²/2+ρgh stays constant in steady, incompressible, effectively inviscid flow without a pump or turbine adding or removing energy along the segment. Pressure represents the work exchanged as neighbouring fluid pushes the parcel. The other terms represent kinetic and gravitational contributions. All three have units of pressure. In a horizontal section, a speed increase therefore corresponds to a pressure decrease under these assumptions.

Continuity and Bernoulli answer different questions and are often used together: first relate the speeds using areas, then compare pressures or heights using energy. Do not conclude that every fast-moving fluid has low pressure regardless of context. Viscosity dissipates mechanical energy, pumps supply it, and unsteady flow changes the balance. Pressure comparisons across unrelated streamlines can require additional conditions. State the model before applying the formula.
body.zh:
流量表示单位时间内穿过截面的流体有多少。若面积为 A、垂直于截面的平均速率为 v，体积流量为 Av，质量流量为 ρAv。无泄漏管道中的稳定流动必须满足质量守恒，因此不同截面的质量流量相等。不可压缩流体的密度不变，于是截面变窄时平均速率增大；可压缩流体则还必须考虑密度变化。

伯努利关系给出沿流线的单位体积机械能平衡：稳定、不可压缩、可忽略黏性的流动中，若途中没有泵或涡轮输入、取走能量，则 p+ρv²/2+ρgh 保持恒定。压强项对应相邻流体推动流体块时交换的功，另外两项对应动能与重力势能，三项都具有压强单位。在满足这些条件的水平流段中，速率增大就对应压强降低。

连续性关系与伯努利关系回答不同问题，常配合使用：先用截面积联系速率，再用能量比较压强或高度。不能脱离情境就断言所有高速流体的压强都低。黏性会耗散机械能，泵会输入能量，非稳定流动也会改变平衡。不同流线之间的比较可能需要额外条件，应先说明模型，再套用公式。

summary.en: For a spring, F = −kx gives simple harmonic motion with angular frequency √(k/m).
summary.zh: 弹簧回复力 F = −kx 产生角频率 √(k/m) 的简谐运动。

objectives.en: Describe Linear restoring force and its relationship to Period.
objectives.zh: 说明线性回复力与周期之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Energy exchange and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释能量交换，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Simple harmonic motion occurs when acceleration points toward an equilibrium position and is proportional to displacement from it: a=−ω²x. The minus sign makes the acceleration restoring. An ideal spring obeying Hooke's law exerts F=−kx, so a mass m attached to it has ω=√(k/m). The angular frequency ω is measured in radians per second; ordinary frequency is ω/(2π), and the period is 2π/ω. Amplitude describes how far the object travels from equilibrium, not how frequently it repeats.

A sinusoidal displacement describes the motion, with a phase specifying where in the cycle it begins. At a turning point the speed is zero but the restoring acceleration has its largest magnitude. At equilibrium the acceleration is zero while the speed is largest. Energy shifts between spring potential energy kx²/2 and kinetic energy mv²/2. With no losses, the total is kA²/2 for amplitude A, and the maximum speed is ωA.

The same model can approximate other systems near stable equilibrium. A simple pendulum at small angular amplitude has period approximately 2π√(L/g), because sinθ is approximately θ when θ is measured in radians. Large swings invalidate that approximation. Friction, nonlinear spring behaviour, or external driving can also change the motion; calling something an oscillator does not automatically make it simple harmonic.
body.zh:
简谐运动的特征是加速度总指向平衡位置，并且与离开平衡位置的位移成正比：a=−ω²x。负号表示恢复作用。理想弹簧满足胡克定律 F=−kx，所以质量为 m 的物体具有角频率 ω=√(k/m)。ω 的单位为弧度每秒，普通频率为 ω/(2π)，周期为 2π/ω。振幅描述离开平衡位置的最大距离，而不是重复频率。

位移随时间呈正弦变化，相位说明运动开始时处于周期的哪个位置。在转折点速率为零，但恢复加速度的大小最大；经过平衡位置时，加速度为零，速率却最大。能量在弹性势能 kx²/2 和动能 mv²/2 之间转化。无损耗时总能量为 kA²/2，其中 A 是振幅，最大速率为 ωA。

这个模型还能近似描述许多系统在稳定平衡位置附近的运动。小角度摆动的单摆周期约为 2π√(L/g)，因为角度以弧度计且足够小时 sinθ≈θ。大幅摆动不再满足该近似。摩擦、非线性弹簧或外界驱动也可能改变运动，因此有振荡并不自动意味着是简谐运动。

body.en: For a spring, F = −kx gives simple harmonic motion with angular frequency √(k/m). Position varies sinusoidally and period is 2π√(m/k). Kinetic and elastic potential energy exchange while their sum remains constant without damping.
body.zh: 弹簧回复力 F = −kx 产生角频率 √(k/m) 的简谐运动。位移按正弦变化，周期为 2π√(m/k)。无阻尼时，动能与弹性势能相互转换，总和不变。

prompt.en: An ideal spring has k=32 N/m and carries mass 0.5 kg. The oscillation amplitude is 0.1 m. Find the maximum speed in m/s.
prompt.zh: 理想弹簧 k=32 N/m，所连质量为 0.5 kg，振幅 0.1 m。最大速率是多少 m/s？

hints.en: First find ω=√(k/m), then use vmax=ωA.

summary.en: Damping transfers oscillation energy into other forms.
summary.zh: 阻尼把振动能转移为其他形式。

objectives.en: Describe Dissipation and its relationship to Driven oscillation.
objectives.zh: 说明耗散与受迫振动之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Resonance width and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释共振宽度，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Real oscillators lose mechanical energy through friction, fluid drag, electrical resistance, or other processes. In a common spring model, a damping force −bv opposes velocity. The free-motion equation is m x″+b x′+kx=0. With weak enough damping the object still oscillates, but its displacement envelope decays as exp(−bt/(2m)). The damped angular frequency is √(k/m−b²/(4m²)), lower than the undamped value. This formula only describes the underdamped regime.

At critical damping the system returns toward equilibrium without oscillating, as quickly as this linear model permits without crossing equilibrium for a simple release from rest. Stronger damping is overdamped and can produce a slower return. Initial conditions still matter. Energy associated with a vibration's amplitude is proportional to the square of that amplitude, so halving the amplitude reduces that energy scale to one quarter, not one half.

A periodic driving force supplies energy while damping removes it. After transients decay, a linear oscillator responds at the driving frequency with an amplitude and phase determined by frequency and damping. Resonance means a large response near a characteristic frequency; damping keeps the steady response finite and shifts the displacement-amplitude peak. Resonance is not unrestricted energy creation: the driver supplies the energy. Distinguish a free system's decaying natural oscillation from the continuing forced response.
body.zh:
真实振子会通过摩擦、流体阻力、电阻等过程损失机械能。常见弹簧模型用 −bv 表示与速度反向的阻尼力，自由运动方程为 m x″+b x′+kx=0。阻尼足够弱时，物体仍振荡，但位移包络按 exp(−bt/(2m)) 衰减。阻尼角频率为 √(k/m−b²/(4m²))，小于无阻尼值；这个表达式仅适用于欠阻尼。

临界阻尼时，系统不振荡地返回平衡位置；对于从静止释放的简单情形，它在该线性模型中实现不越过平衡位置的最快返回。阻尼更强为过阻尼，返回反而可能更慢。初始条件仍然重要。振动振幅对应的能量尺度与振幅平方成正比，因此振幅减半时，相应能量尺度变为四分之一，而不是一半。

周期驱动力输入能量，阻尼消耗能量。瞬态衰减后，线性振子以驱动频率响应，其振幅和相位取决于频率与阻尼。共振指特征频率附近出现较大响应；阻尼使稳态响应有限，并改变位移振幅峰值的位置。共振并不凭空创造能量，能量来自驱动源。应区分自由系统逐渐衰减的固有振动与持续的受迫响应。

title.zh: 耗散 · 受迫振动 · 共振宽度

body.en: Damping transfers oscillation energy into other forms. A periodic driving force can replace that loss. The steady response depends on driving frequency; a lightly damped system has a large response near its natural frequency. Stronger damping usually broadens and reduces the resonance peak.
body.zh: 阻尼把振动能转移为其他形式。周期驱动力可补充损失。稳态响应依赖驱动频率；弱阻尼系统在固有频率附近响应较大。阻尼增大通常使共振峰降低并变宽。

body.en: If amplitude decays by a factor of one half each second, an initial 8 mm becomes 2 mm after two seconds.

hints.zh: 转折点处能量为 kA²/2，将振幅比平方。

explanation.en: The energy ratio is (1/2)²=1/4, so the later energy is 80/4=20 J.
explanation.zh: 能量比为 (1/2)²=1/4，因此后来能量为 80/4=20 J。

summary.en: Coupled oscillators exchange energy through their interaction.
summary.zh: 耦合振子通过相互作用交换能量。

objectives.en: Describe Coupling and its relationship to Normal modes.
objectives.zh: 说明耦合与简正模之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Superposition and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释叠加，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Coupled oscillators exchange forces, so the motion of one affects the other. Consider two equal masses m on a frictionless line. Each mass is attached to its own fixed support by a spring of stiffness k, and an additional spring of stiffness kc joins the masses. Measure both displacements x1 and x2 from equilibrium in the same direction. The coupling spring's extension change is x2−x1, so its forces on the two masses are equal and opposite.

Two especially simple motions are normal modes. In the symmetric mode the masses move together with x1=x2. The coupling spring does not change length, and each mass has angular frequency √(k/m). In the antisymmetric mode x1=−x2. The coupling spring stretches or compresses twice as much as either displacement, increasing the restoring force; the angular frequency is √((k+2kc)/m). Each mode has a fixed relative pattern of motion.

Because the ideal equations are linear, their solutions can be added. A general initial displacement and velocity can be decomposed into the two modes, whose phases then evolve at different frequencies. Energy can appear to pass back and forth between the masses even though the total is conserved. When modal frequencies are close, this gives a slowly varying beat pattern. The same normal-mode idea connects mechanical vibrations to molecular motion and to eigenvectors in linear algebra.
body.zh:
耦合振子彼此施加作用力，因此一个振子的运动会影响另一个。考虑在无摩擦直线上运动的两个相同质量 m：每个质量分别通过劲度系数 k 的弹簧连到固定支点，两个质量之间再用劲度系数 kc 的弹簧相连。以同一方向测量偏离平衡位置的位移 x1、x2，耦合弹簧的伸长变化为 x2−x1，对两质量的力等大反向。

两种特别简单的运动称为简正模式。对称模式中 x1=x2，两质量同向同步移动，耦合弹簧长度不变，每个质量的角频率为 √(k/m)。反对称模式中 x1=−x2，耦合弹簧的伸缩是单个质量位移的两倍，恢复作用增强，角频率为 √((k+2kc)/m)。每个模式都保持固定的相对运动图样。

由于理想运动方程是线性的，可以将解相加。一般的初始位移与速度可分解到这两个模式，它们的相位随后按不同频率变化。能量看起来会在两个质量之间往返转移，而总能量仍守恒。当模式频率接近时，会形成缓慢变化的拍现象。相同的简正模式思想还连接了机械振动、分子运动和线性代数中的特征向量。

title.zh: 耦合 · 简正模 · 叠加

body.en: Coupled oscillators exchange energy through their interaction. A normal mode is a collective pattern in which all coordinates oscillate at one frequency with fixed amplitude ratios. Linear systems permit a general motion to be decomposed into such modes.
body.zh: 耦合振子通过相互作用交换能量。简正模是一种集体运动模式：各坐标以同一频率振动，振幅比固定。线性系统的一般运动可以分解为这些模式的叠加。

body.en: Two identical masses connected symmetrically can move together or oppositely. The coupling spring stretches differently in the two patterns, so their frequencies differ.
body.zh: 对称连接的两个相同质量可以同相或反相运动。两种模式使耦合弹簧伸长不同，因此频率不同。

body.en: Normal-mode decomposition relies on linearized equations. Common misconception: “Every coupled nonlinear system is an exact sum of independent fixed modes.”
body.zh: 简正模分解依赖线性化方程。常见误解：“所有耦合非线性系统都能精确写成独立固定模式的和。”

summary.en: Displacement is final position minus initial position.
summary.zh: 位移等于末位置减初位置。

objectives.en: Describe Position and displacement and its relationship to Velocity and acceleration.
objectives.zh: 说明位置与位移与速度与加速度之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Constant-acceleration conditions and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释匀加速条件，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
Choose an origin and a positive axis before assigning a position x. Position is a coordinate; displacement is the final coordinate minus the initial one. Distance counts the whole path and cannot be negative. A runner going 6 m right and 2 m left travels 8 m but has displacement +4 m. Average velocity uses displacement divided by elapsed time, whereas average speed uses distance. They answer different questions.

On a position–time graph, slope gives velocity. A horizontal segment represents rest, not motion along a horizontal road. On a velocity–time graph, slope gives acceleration and signed area gives displacement. Negative area means travel in the negative coordinate direction. The magnitude of velocity is speed; velocity and acceleration with opposite signs reduce speed until velocity reaches zero.

When acceleration is constant, the velocity graph is a straight line, so its area is a rectangle plus a triangle. This gives displacement ut+at²/2 and final velocity u+at. Eliminating time gives v²=u²+2as, but squaring loses information about velocity's sign. Check the direction separately. These formulas cannot be used with one instantaneous acceleration when acceleration varies throughout the interval; then graph areas or integration are required.
body.zh:
先选原点与正方向，再给位置 x 赋值。位置是坐标，位移是终坐标减初坐标；路程则累计整条路径，不会为负。一个人先向右走 6 m，再向左走 2 m，路程为 8 m，位移却为 +4 m。平均速度用位移除以时间，平均速率用路程除以时间，两者回答的问题不同。

位置—时间图像的斜率表示速度，水平线段表示静止，而不是沿水平道路行驶。速度—时间图像的斜率表示加速度，有符号面积表示位移。负面积代表向负方向移动。速率是速度的大小；速度与加速度异号时，速率减小，直至速度降到零。

加速度恒定时，速度图像为直线，面积可分成矩形与三角形，得到位移 ut+at²/2 和末速度 u+at。消去时间可得 v²=u²+2as，但平方丢失了速度的符号，方向需另行判断。如果加速度随时间变化，就不能把某一瞬间的加速度直接代入这些公式，应使用图像面积或积分。

title.en: Position and displacement · Velocity and acceleration · Constant-acceleration conditions
title.zh: 位置与位移 · 速度与加速度 · 匀加速条件

body.en: Displacement is final position minus initial position. Average velocity divides displacement by elapsed time; average speed instead uses total path length. Acceleration is velocity change per time. When acceleration is constant, v = u + at and displacement s = ut + at²/2. The signs must refer to the same axis throughout.
body.zh: 位移等于末位置减初位置。平均速度用位移除以时间；平均速率则使用总路程。加速度是速度随时间的变化。加速度恒定时，v = u + at，位移 s = ut + at²/2。所有正负号必须始终对应同一坐标轴。

body.en: Starting from rest with a = 2 m/s² for 3 s gives v = 6 m/s and s = 9 m. The velocity–time graph is a straight line; its triangular area is also 9 m.
body.zh: 从静止开始，以 2 m/s² 加速 3 s，末速度为 6 m/s，位移为 9 m。速度—时间图像是一条直线，其下三角形面积同样为 9 m。

body.en: Negative acceleration need not mean slowing down: negative velocity becoming more negative increases speed. The constant-acceleration equations fail when acceleration varies.
body.zh: 负加速度不一定表示减速：负速度变得更负时，速率反而增加。加速度变化时不能直接套用匀加速公式。

prompt.zh: 从静止开始，以 3 m/s² 匀加速 4 s，位移为多少米？

title.en: Motion in two and three dimensions

summary.en: Resolve position, velocity and acceleration along perpendicular axes.
summary.zh: 把位置、速度和加速度分解到互相垂直的坐标轴。

objectives.en: Describe Vector components and its relationship to Projectile motion.
objectives.zh: 说明矢量分量与抛体运动之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Independent axes and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释各轴独立，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A position vector tells how far to move along each chosen coordinate axis. Different axes describe the same physical path with different components. At every instant, velocity points along the tangent to the path, while acceleration describes a change of velocity that may affect magnitude, direction, or both. A curved path can therefore have acceleration even when speed is constant.

Resolve every vector equation into perpendicular components and solve all components with the same clock. For a projectile close to Earth's surface, assume uniform downward gravity and negligible air resistance. Then horizontal acceleration is zero and vertical acceleration is −g if upward is positive. The horizontal coordinate is x₀+uₓt, and the vertical coordinate is y₀+uᵧt−gt²/2. The flight time comes from the vertical condition for landing; substitute that same time into the horizontal equation.

At the highest point of an angled projectile, vertical velocity is zero but horizontal velocity generally is not. Acceleration remains downward. In three dimensions, there are three component equations rather than a new kind of force law. A vector's magnitude is found by the Pythagorean sum of its perpendicular components; adding component magnitudes would describe a different quantity. With drag, the force may depend on the full velocity, so the simple separated projectile formulas require revision.
body.zh:
位置向量说明沿各坐标轴分别移动多少。换一组坐标轴，会给同一条物理路径不同的分量。每一瞬间，速度沿轨迹切线；加速度描述速度的变化，可能改变大小、方向，或两者都改变。因此即使速率不变，曲线运动也可能有加速度。

把向量方程分解到垂直坐标轴上，并对所有分量使用同一个时钟。近地抛体的简化模型假设重力均匀向下且空气阻力可忽略。若向上为正，水平加速度为零，竖直加速度为 −g。于是 x=x₀+uₓt，y=y₀+uᵧt−gt²/2。先由落地的竖直位置条件求时间，再把同一时间代入水平式。

斜抛最高点的竖直速度为零，但水平速度一般不为零；加速度仍然向下。三维运动只是多出一个分量方程，并没有换一套力学定律。向量大小由垂直分量的平方和开平方得到，不能直接把分量大小相加。若考虑阻力，力可能依赖完整速度，此时简单的分离抛体公式必须修改。

title.en: Vector components · Projectile motion · Independent axes
title.zh: 矢量分量 · 抛体运动 · 各轴独立

body.en: Resolve position, velocity and acceleration along perpendicular axes. Without air resistance near Earth, a projectile has constant horizontal velocity and downward acceleration g. Horizontal and vertical motions share the same time, which links their equations. In three dimensions a third independent component is added; vector magnitude uses the square root of the sum of squared components.
body.zh: 把位置、速度和加速度分解到互相垂直的坐标轴。近地面忽略空气阻力时，抛体水平速度恒定，竖直加速度为向下的 g。两个方向共用同一个时间，由此联系方程。三维情形增加第三个分量；矢量大小等于各分量平方和的平方根。

body.en: A horizontal launch at 8 m/s falls for 2 s, travelling 16 m horizontally. With g = 10 m/s² it drops 20 m. Combining displacements gives a diagonal displacement, not the curved path length.
body.zh: 水平以 8 m/s 抛出，飞行 2 s 后水平前进 16 m。取 g = 10 m/s²，下降 20 m。分位移合成得到斜向总位移，而不是弯曲轨迹的路程。

body.en: Horizontal and vertical positions are independent equations, but the elapsed time is shared. Air resistance would couple motion through the velocity-dependent force.
body.zh: 水平与竖直位置分别列式，但时间相同。若考虑空气阻力，依赖速度的阻力会使运动分量发生耦合。

prompt.en: A vector has perpendicular components 6 and 8. What is its magnitude?
prompt.zh: 一个矢量的两个垂直分量为 6 和 8，其大小是多少？

text.zh: 矢量大小总是各分量绝对值之和。

text.en: Perpendicular components combine using the Pythagorean relation.
text.zh: 垂直分量通过勾股关系合成大小。

explanation.en: Perpendicular components combine using the Pythagorean relation. Horizontal and vertical positions are independent equations, but the elapsed time is shared. Air resistance would couple motion through the velocity-dependent force.
explanation.zh: 垂直分量通过勾股关系合成大小。水平与竖直位置分别列式，但时间相同。若考虑空气阻力，依赖速度的阻力会使运动分量发生耦合。

prompt.en: A ball is launched horizontally at 6 m/s from a height of 20 m. Neglect drag and use g=10 m/s². Find its horizontal range in m.
prompt.zh: 小球从 20 m 高处以 6 m/s 水平抛出，忽略空气阻力，g=10 m/s²，水平射程是多少米？

hints.en: Find fall time from 20=gt²/2, then use horizontal speed.
hints.zh: 先由 20=gt²/2 求下落时间，再乘水平速度。

explanation.en: 20=5t² gives t=2 s. The horizontal range is 6×2=12 m.
explanation.zh: 20=5t² 得 t=2 s，水平射程为 6×2=12 m。

summary.en: In an inertial frame, zero net force means constant velocity.
summary.zh: 在惯性系中，合力为零意味着速度恒定。

objectives.en: Describe Inertia and its relationship to Net force.
objectives.zh: 说明惯性与合力之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Action–reaction pairs and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释作用力与反作用力，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A free-body diagram isolates one chosen object and lists forces exerted on it by other objects. Draw weight from the Earth, contact forces from surfaces, tension from a taut string, and any specified applied forces. Velocity and acceleration are not forces and do not belong in the force sum. Label each force by its interaction partner to avoid accidentally counting the same interaction twice.

Newton's first law identifies inertial frames: without a resultant force, velocity is constant, including the possibility of zero velocity. Newton's second law then relates resultant force to acceleration for a constant-mass body. Resolve the force sum along convenient axes. A zero vertical acceleration gives a vertical balance even while a horizontal resultant produces horizontal acceleration. This is why the normal force sometimes equals weight, but only after other vertical forces and vertical acceleration have been considered.

The third law compares an interaction across two bodies. If a hand pushes a cart, the cart pushes the hand equally and oppositely; only the hand-on-cart force belongs on the cart's diagram. When both bodies are included in one system, their mutual forces cancel in the total momentum balance. An object moving left with acceleration right initially slows down; the net force describes the change of velocity, not its current direction.
body.zh:
受力图要先孤立一个研究对象，再列出其他物体对它施加的力，包括地球施加的重力、接触面施加的接触力、绷紧绳子的拉力，以及题目给出的外力。速度和加速度不是力，不能加入力的总和。标明每个力的施力对象，可避免把同一相互作用算两遍。

牛顿第一定律识别惯性参考系：合力为零时，速度不变，包括速度为零的情形。对质量恒定的物体，第二定律把合力与加速度联系起来。可沿方便的轴分别列方程。竖直加速度为零意味着竖直方向力平衡，而水平方向仍可有合力和加速度。因此支持力有时等于重力，但必须先检查其他竖直力与竖直加速度，不能直接套用。

第三定律比较两个物体之间的一次相互作用。手推车时，车也以等大反向的力推手；车的受力图中只画手对车的力。若把两者一起选为系统，它们之间的内力会在总动量方程中抵消。向左运动却向右加速的物体会先减速；合力说明速度如何改变，而不是速度当前朝向哪里。

title.zh: 惯性 · 合力 · 作用力与反作用力

body.en: In an inertial frame, zero net force means constant velocity. Newton’s second law is the vector equation ΣF = ma for constant mass. Draw only forces acting on the chosen body. Newton’s third law pairs equal opposite forces on different bodies; these do not cancel within a single body’s force diagram.
body.zh: 在惯性系中，合力为零意味着速度恒定。质量恒定时，牛顿第二定律为矢量方程 ΣF = ma。受力图只画作用在所选物体上的力。第三定律的一对等大反向力作用在不同物体上，不会在单个物体的受力图中互相抵消。

body.en: A 2 kg cart pulled right with 7 N and left with 3 N has net force 4 N right, hence acceleration 2 m/s² right. Its current velocity may nevertheless point left.
body.zh: 2 kg 小车受到向右 7 N、向左 3 N 的力，合力为向右 4 N，因此加速度向右，为 2 m/s²；此时速度仍可能向左。

body.en: A force changes velocity, not necessarily position in its own direction immediately. Weight and normal force are not a third-law pair because both act on one body.
body.zh: 力改变速度，并不保证物体立即沿力的方向运动。重力与支持力都作用在同一物体上，因此不是第三定律力对。

prompt.en: A 4 kg cart has a 19 N force to the right and a 7 N force to the left. Taking right as positive, find acceleration in m/s².
prompt.zh: 4 kg 小车受向右 19 N 与向左 7 N 两个力，以右为正，加速度是多少 m/s²？

hints.en: Sum signed horizontal forces before dividing by mass.
hints.zh: 先求带符号的水平合力，再除以质量。

explanation.en: The resultant is 19−7=12 N, so a=12/4=+3 m/s².

summary.en: A normal force is perpendicular to a contact surface.
summary.zh: 支持力垂直于接触面。

objectives.en: Describe Normal force and its relationship to Static friction.
objectives.zh: 说明支持力与静摩擦之间的联系。

objectives.en: Explain Kinetic friction and identify the conditions behind the example.
objectives.zh: 解释滑动摩擦，并指出例子所依赖的条件。

body.en:
A contact force can be separated into a normal component perpendicular to the surface and a friction component tangent to it. Neither component is automatically equal to the object's weight. On an incline, choosing axes along and perpendicular to the slope makes the weight components easy to distinguish: the perpendicular balance determines the normal force, while the parallel balance determines possible acceleration or friction.

For dry static contact, first solve the equilibrium or no-slip equations to find the friction that would be needed. Then compare its magnitude with the limit μₛN. If the required value is below the limit, that required value is the actual static friction. Setting friction equal to its maximum from the beginning would usually give a wrong force balance. If the required value exceeds the limit, the no-slip assumption fails and a sliding model must be considered.

Sliding friction in the simple Coulomb model has magnitude μₖN and opposes relative sliding of the touching surfaces. That direction may differ from the direction opposite the object's centre-of-mass velocity: a moving belt can accelerate a box through forward friction. Friction coefficients are empirical approximations, affected by materials and conditions. Adhesion, lubrication, deformation and high-speed effects can make the simple constant-coefficient model unsuitable. Always state which contact regime you are using.
body.zh:
接触力可分解为垂直于表面的支持力和沿表面的摩擦力，两者都不自动等于物体重力。斜面问题中，沿斜面及垂直斜面选轴，可以清楚区分重力分量：垂直方向方程决定支持力，平行方向方程决定加速度或所需摩擦力。

对干燥静接触，应先按平衡或无相对滑动条件求所需摩擦力，再与上限 μₛN 比较。若所需大小不超过上限，实际静摩擦力就是这个所需值。若一开始就令静摩擦力等于最大值，通常会列错方程。若所需值超过上限，无滑动假设失效，需要改用滑动模型。

简单库仑模型中的滑动摩擦力大小为 μₖN，方向阻碍两个接触面之间的相对滑动。这未必等同于阻碍物体质心运动，例如运动的传送带可通过向前的摩擦力使箱子加速。摩擦系数是受材料与条件影响的经验近似；黏附、润滑、形变或高速效应可能让恒定系数模型失效。解题时应说明采用哪一种接触状态。

title.en: Normal force · Static friction · Kinetic friction
title.zh: 支持力 · 静摩擦 · 滑动摩擦

body.en: A normal force is perpendicular to a contact surface. Static friction adjusts to prevent relative slipping up to |f| ≤ μsN; it is not always at that limit. In a simple dry-contact model, sliding friction has magnitude μkN and opposes relative sliding. Surface geometry and other forces determine N.
body.zh: 支持力垂直于接触面。静摩擦力会调整大小以阻止相对滑动，但满足 |f| ≤ μsN，并非总等于最大值。简单干摩擦模型中，滑动摩擦力大小为 μkN，方向与相对滑动相反。支持力 N 由表面几何和其他力共同决定。

body.en: A horizontal 10 N push on a stationary box is balanced by 10 N static friction if the maximum is 15 N. A 20 N push exceeds that limit and slipping begins in this idealized model.
body.zh: 若最大静摩擦力为 15 N，水平推力 10 N 会被 10 N 静摩擦力平衡。若推力增为 20 N，则超过极限，在此理想模型中开始滑动。

body.en: Friction opposes relative slipping or its tendency, not necessarily the centre-of-mass velocity. A driven wheel can receive forward static friction.
body.zh: 摩擦力阻碍相对滑动或滑动趋势，不一定与质心速度相反。主动轮可以受到向前的静摩擦力。

prompt.en: A sliding object has N = 40 N and μk = 0.25. Find friction magnitude in N.
prompt.zh: 滑动物体受到 40 N 支持力，μk = 0.25，摩擦力大小为多少 N？
